canonical_source: I believe the goods have been delivered to you.
current_cn: 我相信货物已经交付给您了。

canonical_source: Yes commander, I have brought your Geweer, Minieru, and cartridges as you requested.
current_cn: 是的，指挥官，我已经按照您的要求带来了您的蓋貝爾槍、米涅步枪和弹药筒。

canonical_source: Ichijodani is a fortified town in western Hokuriku, surrounded on all sides by the natural defences of rivers and mountains, making it a difficult target for any besieger. Built by the Asakura clan, Ichijodani has grown into a centre of culture, craftsmanship and religion thanks to the hospitality afforded by the Asakura clan to refugees fleeing Kyoto during the Ōnin War, making it a jewel rivaling the Imperial Capital itself.
current_cn: 一乘谷是北陆西部的一座防御城镇，四面被河流和山脉的天然防御所包围，使其成为任何围攻者的困难目标。一乘谷由朝仓氏建造，由于朝仓氏在应仁之乱期间热情接待了逃离京都的难民，一乘谷已发展成为文化、工艺和宗教的中心，使其成为与皇都本身相媲美的一颗宝石。

canonical_source: No doubt a sad state of affairs. So what do you do?
current_cn: 毫无疑问，这是一种悲伤的状况。那你怎么办？

canonical_source: We hear a lot of complaints about you lately. You better start behaving or you'll get yourself a good flogging.[if:convo_mocking_revenge]
current_cn: 最近我们听到很多关于你的抱怨。你最好开始表现得好，否则你会挨一顿鞭打的。[if:convo_mocking_revenge]

canonical_source: The merchant and artisan caste, Chonin, or 'Townsman', was the term applied to those of the peasant caste who lived in castle towns or cities. The Chonin were the core of the cultural flourishing in the Edo period, forming a wealthy middle class, to the point where the only people wealthier than them were the Daimyo themselves. Despite sumptuary laws enforced by the Shogunate, the Chonin were responsible for a trend of conspicuous consumption that led to ever more elaborate and refined artwork, literature, and theater, as well as the development of a form of proto-Capitalism, independent of the rest of the world. Nowhere were the Chonin more prominent then in the city of Edo itself, which had a population of some 600,000 Chonin, on top of 700,000 Samurai, making up roughly 1/28 of the entire popualtion of Japan at the time. Even so, the Chonin were highly restricted, as members of the peasant class, and were forced to always be below samurai. Historically speaking, there was no legal difference between {HYAKUSHO_LINK} and Chonin. However, their roles were so different that they were often considered two different classes by philosophers of the time, a split also used in the mod.{newline}{newline}Pros: None{newline}{newline}Resistrictions:{newline}Cannot command personal retinue (-33% party size from clan tier and Steward){newline}Cannot hold a fief as a vassal of a kingdom{newline}Cannot enter keep of towns and castles unless a vassal of the owner kingdom
current_cn: 商人和工匠种姓“Chonin”或“城镇居民”这个术语适用于居住在城堡城镇或城市的农民种姓。长忍是江户时代文化繁荣的核心，形成了富裕的中产阶级，以至于比他们富裕的人只有大名本身。尽管幕府颁布了奢侈法律，但长宁家族还是造成了一种炫耀性消费的趋势，这种趋势导致了更加精致和精致的艺术品、文学和戏剧，以及一种独立于世界其他地方的原始资本主义形式的发展。江户城内的长忍族最为突出，江户市内约有 60 万长忍族人口，另外还有 70 万武士，约占当时日本总人口的 1/28。即便如此，作为农民阶级的成员，长忍人仍受到高度限制，被迫始终处于武士之下。从历史上看，{HYAKUSHO_LINK} 和 Chonin 之间没有法律上的区别。然而，他们的角色是如此不同，以至于当时的哲学家经常将他们视为两个不同的阶级，这种分裂也在mod中使用。{newline}{newline}优点：无{newline}{newline}限制：{newline}不能指挥个人随从（来自氏族层和管家的-33％队伍规模）{newline}不能作为王国的附庸持有封地{newline}不能进入城镇和城堡的要塞，除非所属国的附庸

canonical_source: On second thought, I'll wait some time
current_cn: 再考虑一下，我会等一段时间

canonical_source: While many raged at the foreigners' arrival, you took a colder view. Their ships and guns could not simply be wished away. Alongside other forward-thinking retainers, you studied Western drill, firearms, and knowledge, believing that only by mastering these new methods could Japan hope to stand as an equal among nations.
current_cn: 当许多人对外国人的到来感到愤怒时，你却持冷淡的态度。他们的船只和火炮不可能凭空消失。您与其他有远见的家臣一起研究了西方的演习、枪械和知识，相信只有掌握这些新方法，日本才有希望在各国中平等立足。

canonical_source: Then you will swear the keppan. You will place your name in blood, and vow before the school.[ib:confident][if:convo_concentration]
current_cn: 然后你就会发誓 血判。你将把你的名字刻在血中，并在流派面前宣誓。[ib:confident][if:convo_concentration]

canonical_source: A notable display of technique, {PLAYER.LINK}. You faced {OPPONENT_COUNT} fellow students with control and determination. Persist in attentive practice, and your abilities will be solidified.
current_cn: 技艺展现得相当出色，{PLAYER.LINK}。你面对 {OPPONENT_COUNT} 名同门时沉着而坚定。继续专心练习，你的能力将日益扎实。

canonical_source: All profitable trade routes of the foreign merchant are blocked by recent wars. He has decided to return until the situation gets better. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} was happy with your service and sent you {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} as promised.
current_cn: 外国商人所有有利可图的贸易路线都因最近的战争而被封锁。他决定回来，直到情况好转。 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 对您的服务感到满意，并按照承诺向您发送了 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}。

canonical_source: Benefiting from its position along key maritime trade routes and its proximity to the island’s northern provinces, Nyushima has grown into a prosperous castle town, also thanks to the influence of the Ōtomo clan, that has promoted the town as a center of local governance.
current_cn: 得益于其在主要海上贸易路线上的位置以及靠近该岛北部省份的优势，入岛已发展成为一个繁荣的城下町，这也得益于大友氏族的影响力，该镇已成为地方治理的中心。

canonical_source: It's not many who ask that question.
current_cn: 问这个问题的人并不多。

canonical_source: Greetings. These goods are secured by His Majesty, Wilhelm I, German Emperor and King of Prussia, and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we help you?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。这些货物由德国皇帝兼普鲁士国王威廉一世陛下担保，并由 {MERCHANT.LINK} 或 {SETTLEMENT} 担保。我们能为您提供什么帮助？[if:convo_normal]

current_cn: 是的。我这里有货。按照我们约定，我带了{REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}步枪{?}步枪{\\?}{.%}。

canonical_source: The Zokuron-ha cannot be allowed to keep fooling the lord.
I am sure your men are as capable as you are and will look after my guest. Thanks again for your help, my friend.
current_cn: 我相信你们的手下和你们一样有能力，会照顾我的客人。再次感谢您的帮助，我的朋友。

canonical_source: {SKILL} skill isn't high enough. Should be {AMOUNT}

Kishu, alternatively named Kii or Wakayama, is a powerful shinpan domain and the fifth richest domain in Japan. It is ruled by one of the three Gosanke houses, descendants of Tokugawa Ieyasu who exist as backups in case the main Tokugawa line ever falters. Despite providing the current Shogun, Iemochi, Kishu domain will go on to surrender to and join the Imperial side
current_cn: 纪州，也称为纪伊或和歌山，是一个强大的新盘藩，也是日本第五富有的藩。它由德川家康的后裔御三家之一统治，他们作为后备力量存在，以防德川主线动摇。尽管提供了现任将军，家茂，纪州藩将继续投降并加入帝国一方

canonical_source: Rising out of humble roots, Tsu domain was founded by Todo Takatora, a low ranking ashigaru who later became a daimyo under Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Oda Nobunaga. Due to their loyalty to the Shogunate, samurai in the Edo period often state that 'If the battle occurs, the vanguard is the Hikone's Ii clan and the Todo clan of Ise.'
current_cn: 津藩出身卑微，由藤堂高虎创建，藤堂高虎是一位低阶足轻，后来成为丰臣秀吉和织田信长手下的大名。江户时代的武士由于对幕府的忠诚，经常说“如果发生战斗，前锋是彦根的井伊氏和伊势的藤堂氏”。

canonical_source: Hikone sits along the shores of Lake Biwa, dominated by its sprawling castle and the Ii clan, whose samurai are famous for their bright red armor and fierce discipline. The Ii have long been loyal to the Tokugawa, serving as both military leaders and administrators of the shogunate. The assassination of Ii Naosuke sent shockwaves through the domain, and his retainers seethe with outrage against the Sonno-joi movement.
current_cn: 彦根市坐落在琵琶湖沿岸，以其庞大的城堡和井伊氏族为主导，井伊氏族的武士以其鲜红色的盔甲和严格的纪律而闻名。井伊家族长期以来忠于德川幕府，担任军事领导人和幕府行政人员。井伊直介的刺杀事件在整个藩引起了轩然大波，他的家臣们对尊王攘夷运动充满了愤怒。

canonical_source: Ruled by the Hisamatsu Matsudaira, the Kuwana domain is fiercely loyal to the Shogunate, with members of the domain fighting through the end of the war in the North and in Ezo. During the war, their soldiers will be some of the best trained and drilled among all the Shogunate troops.
current_cn: 由松平久松统治的桑名藩对幕府极其忠诚，该藩成员在北方和虾夷地区战斗到战争结束。在战争期间，他们的士兵将是所有幕府军队中训练和训练最好的。

canonical_source: One of the 'One Hundred Surnames', your father was a farmer in a rural village. His farm was larger than most in the village, making him highly influential. Even so, he had to pay almost half of his harvest in the nengu tax to the daimyo each year.
current_cn: 你的父亲是“百姓”之一，是一个农村的农民。他的农场比村里大多数农场都大，这使他很有影响力。即便如此，他每年还是要向大名缴纳近一半的年宫税。

canonical_source: Recruiting and upgrading firearm troops are 10% more expensive.
current_cn: 招募和升级火器部队的费用要高出 10%。

canonical_source: A match, then. Very well. Words alone do not decide such things. Speak plainly. What kind of match do you seek?[rb:unsure][if:convo_grave]
current_cn: 那就来一场比试吧。很好。单靠言语并不能决定这些事情。说清楚点。您寻求什么样的匹配？[rb:unsure][if:convo_grave]
目前，{PRISONER_NAMES} {?IS_PLURAL}are{?}is{\\?} 被囚禁在这里。

canonical_source: 'O'er the whale-road she sped \n She were manned by the dead  \n And the clouds followed black in her wake'
current_cn: “在她飞驰的鲸鱼路上 她被死者操纵着 乌云追随着她的轨迹”

canonical_source: Antique metal guns from the Sengoku Jidai. They're long since outdated, but a cannon is a cannon.
current_cn: 战国时代的古董金属枪。它们早已过时了，但火炮就是火炮。

canonical_source: You are about to lose sight of the caravan. Find the caravan before they are in danger!
current_cn: 你即将看不到商队了。在商队陷入危险之前找到他们！

canonical_source: Sets the number of Naval Cannons you have in custom battles
current_cn: 设置您在自定义战斗中拥有的海军火炮的数量

canonical_source: Respectfully, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, I must protest this. But of course you are free to do what you will.
current_cn: 尊敬的，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}，我必须对此表示抗议。但当然，你可以自由地做你想做的事。

canonical_source: Tōhoku, the northernmost region of Honshū, was the home of the last holdouts of the Shogunate cause in the Boshin war. The domains here are some of the oldest and most entrenched in Japan, with clans such as the Date of Sendai, the Nanbu of Morioka, and the Tsugaru of Hirosaki having ruled in the same region for centuries. Tōhoku, due to its isolation, is also fairly conservative. Few domains have truly begun reforming, leaving them far behind the rapidly modernizing domains of the southwest.
current_cn: 东北是本州最北端的地区，是戊辰战争中幕府最后坚持者的所在地。这里的藩是日本最古老、最根深蒂固的藩，仙台伊达氏、盛冈南部氏和弘前津轻氏等氏族已经在同一地区统治了几个世纪。东北地区由于地处偏僻，也相当保守。真正开始改革的藩很少，远远落后于西南地区快速现代化的藩。
来势汹汹的女帝国帮主
您已从 {QUEST_GIVER.NAME} 交付了 {DELIVERED_ITEM_COUNT} 步枪。

canonical_source: Good to hear that! Safe journeys.
current_cn: 很高兴听到这个消息！旅途安全。

canonical_source: My honor has been attacked. I request a Shinken-shobu to redeem it.
current_cn: 我的荣誉受到了攻击。我请求神剑菖蒲来兑换它。

canonical_source: Kantō is the heart of the Shogunate. Within it is Edo, the capital of the Bakufu, and in which all daimyo were required to live in off years until 1862. Despite that, the region is not as stable as the Shogun wishes it to be. The samurai of Mito, ruled by one of the chief branches of the Tokugawa, are fierce advocates of expelling the foreign barbarians, a stance that the Shogunate is unable to take, leading to constant agitation and the ongoing Mito rebellion. Even so, the region remains loyal to the Tokugawa, with even the Mito samurai wishing to reform, rather than overthrow the Shogunate.
current_cn: 关东是幕府的中心。其中包括幕府的首都江户，直到 1862 年，所有大名都必须在晚年居住。尽管如此，该地区并不像将军希望的那样稳定。德川幕府的主要分支之一统治的水户武士强烈主张驱逐外国野蛮人，但幕府无法采取这一立场，导致不断的骚动和持续不断的水户叛乱。即便如此，该地区仍然忠于德川，甚至水户武士也希望改革，而不是推翻幕府。

canonical_source: 'My love is far \n I know not where \n Perhaps the winds shall tell me'
current_cn: “我的爱很远 我不知道在哪里 也许风会告诉我”

canonical_source: It's quiet. Too quiet. Things never stay quiet around here for long.
current_cn: 很安静。太安静了。这里的一切永远不会安静太久。

canonical_source: Your technique is sound and your control commendable. Continue in this manner, and you will surpass even your current abilities.
current_cn: 你的技术很不错，你的控制力值得称赞。继续这样下去，你甚至会超越你现在的能力。

canonical_source: I served a small fudai domain for twelve years. My lord was a decent man, but his chief councillors were parasites who spent more time arguing over stipends than preparing for the storm that is coming.
current_cn: 我在一个小小的福代藩服务了十二年。我的主人是一个正派的人，但他的首席议员都是寄生虫，他们花更多的时间争论津贴，而不是为即将到来的风暴做准备。

canonical_source: Modern troops are unlocked during the period when they would historically be created.
current_cn: 现代军队是在历史上创建的时期解锁的。

canonical_source: I'm sure what you did was an honest mistake, but there are laws. Hand over the contraband to me, and this will be the end of it.
current_cn: 我确信你的所作所为是无心之过，但法律是有的。把违禁品交给我，事情就到此为止了。

canonical_source: Very well. But every day he's out there spreading sedition make things more dangerous for all of us.[if:convo_undecided_closed]
current_cn: 很好。但他每天都在那里散布煽动叛乱，这让我们所有人的处境变得更加危险。[if:convo_undecided_closed]

canonical_source: Your actions have started a war with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}'s faction. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} cancels your agreement and the quest is a failure.
current_cn: 你的行为已经引发了与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 派系的战争。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?}取消你的协议，任务失败。

canonical_source: When the Black Ships appeared and the country trembled, you saw not fear but opportunity. While domains argued and officials scrambled, you joined rough men who profited from the confusion: smuggling, raiding poorly guarded storehouses, and waylaying those too slow to adapt. You became skilled at striking quickly and disappearing just as fast. Though many would call you little better than a bandit, you know you simply survived where others hesitated.
current_cn: 当黑船出现、国家颤抖时，你看到的不是恐惧，而是机遇。当藩发生争执、官员争先恐后时，你却加入了从混乱中获利的粗暴之徒：走私、袭击守卫薄弱的仓库，以及伏击那些行动迟缓而无法适应的仓库。你变得擅长快速攻击和快速消失。尽管很多人会说你比强盗好不了多少，但你知道你只是在其他人犹豫不决的时候活了下来。

canonical_source: Located along a key mountain pass, Sannohoe is a fortified town that serves as a military outpost, guarding vital routes for trade and troop movements on the borders of competing powers.
current_cn: 三户市位于一个重要的山口沿线，是一座坚固的城镇，是军事前哨基地，守卫着竞争大国边界上的贸易和军队调动的重要路线。

canonical_source: A small, final reform, this represents the units that were formed in the Meiji era, such as the Battotai or marines, that were added to the mod. While the time these units were created is somewhat outside the scope of the mod, and took place after these reforms actually happen, they were added into the game to fill their specific niches.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are unlocked with the Implement Conscription policy instead.
current_cn: 这是最后一轮规模较小的改革，用来表现本模组加入的明治时期部队，例如拔刀队与海军陆战队。严格来说，这些部队的出现时间已经略超出模组主要年代范围，而且部分单位实际形成得更晚；之所以仍加入游戏，是为了补足相应的战术定位。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种由“实施征兵制”政策解锁。

canonical_source: you swore the foreigners would be expelled.

The arrival of the Black Ships was an unforgivable insult to the realm. Like many hot-blooded patriots, you embraced the cry of sonnō jōi: revere the Emperor, expel the barbarians. Whether through secret meetings, militant drilling, or open defiance of the shogunate's policy of compromise, you prepared yourself for the day the outsiders would be driven from Japan's shores.
current_cn: 黑船的到来对藩国来说是不可原谅的侮辱。你们和许多热血爱国志士一样，拥抱着尊皇、驱逐夷狄的“尊皇逐夷”的呼声。无论是通过秘密会议、军事演习，还是公开蔑视幕府的妥协政策，你都为外来者被赶出日本海岸的那一天做好了准备。

canonical_source: A disappointing thing, that so few are willing to die for His Imperial Majesty.
current_cn: 令人失望的是，愿意为皇帝陛下而死的人太少了。

canonical_source: Master, I have completed all that is written in the scroll. If my grasp is sufficient, I ask to be granted Menkyo.
current_cn: 师父，卷轴上所写的我都已经完成了。如果我的掌握足够，我请求授予免许。

canonical_source: The Heavens will grant victory to the just![ib:warrior][if:convo_contemptuous]
You're a nosy one, I see.
current_cn: 我看你是个爱管闲事的人。

canonical_source: {QUEST_GIVER}{.o} informants reported that {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}{.o} party has been seen near {VILLAGE}.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER}{.o} 线人报告说，{MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}{.o} 队伍在 {VILLAGE} 附近被发现。

canonical_source: Construction is a constant throughout your life, as samurai and daimyo build and rebuild their fortified estates. You chose to work in construction, building these mighty works along teams of laborers.
current_cn: 建筑是你一生中的常态，因为武士和大名会建造和重建他们的防御庄园。你选择从事建筑工作，与工人团队一起建造这些宏伟的工程。

canonical_source: You know the dark hearts of men... Those who start as rebels end up turning bandit. Rebellion brings anarchy, not justice.
current_cn: 你知道人心的黑暗……那些一开始是叛逆者的人最终会变成强盗。叛乱带来的是无政府状态，而不是正义。

canonical_source: I am honored to be received here. If you wish to examine arms or equipment, I am prepared to present them.
current_cn: 我很荣幸能在这里受到接待。如果您想检查武器或装备，我准备好向您展示。

canonical_source: The Shogunate is imperfect. So is every government ever created by men. I have no love for corrupt magistrates, but I fear chaos more than I fear reformers.
current_cn: 幕府是不完美的。每一个由人类创建的政府也是如此。我不喜欢腐败的地方官员，但我害怕混乱胜过害怕改革者。
萨摩在幕末末期占有独特的地位。岛津诸侯保持半独立，按照自己的条件加入幕府，同时基本上保持不可征服的状态。该藩高度军事化，拥有密集的五子武士网络和独特的城堡系统。萨摩武士以其忠诚而闻名，首先被认为是萨摩男人，该藩在支持明治时代的亲帝国运动中发挥了关键作用。{newline}{newline}外国商人：英国人

canonical_source: Sakata is a a key port in the northern part of the Tōhoku region, the castle town has grown into a vital hub for trade, particularly due to its access to the Sea of Japan and its proximity to the rich agricultural lands of the surrounding region.
current_cn: 坂田是东北地区北部的一个重要港口，这座城下町已发展成为重要的贸易枢纽，特别是因为它通往日本海并靠近周边地区肥沃的农田。

canonical_source: First built in the Heian period,  the castle town of Utsunomiya was the seat of the clan of the same name for centuries and one of the most important centres in the Kantō region which exerts control over many of the local land routes.
current_cn: 宇都宫城下町始建于平安时代，几个世纪以来一直是同名氏族的所在地，也是关东地区最重要的中心之一，控制着许多当地的陆路。

canonical_source: Be it your status as a Samurai or your family's wealth, you were able to study martial arts in a Ryuha. Under the guidance of your soke and instructors, you became an inheritor of a legacy of mastery.
current_cn: 无论是武士的身份，还是家族的财富，都能够在龙羽学习武术。在您的导师和导师的指导下，您成为了大师遗产的继承人。

canonical_source: Can't talk right now. Got to keep my eye on things around here.
current_cn: 现在不能说话。我必须留意周围的事情。

canonical_source: If you carry enough letters, you begin to understand the people who write them.
current_cn: 如果你携带足够多的信件，你就会开始了解写信的人。

canonical_source: You spent your adolescence working in a forge as the apprentice of a master swordsmith, learning the secrets of forge and blade in equal measure. By the end of your apprenticeship, you were able to forge a sword discreetly on your own, and why not, even swing it around.
current_cn: 你的青春期是在一家锻造厂里作为一位剑匠大师的学徒度过的，同时学习锻造和剑刃的秘密。学徒期结束时，你已经能够自己谨慎地锻造一把剑了，为什么不呢，甚至可以挥舞它。

canonical_source: Great. I will be heading out soon.
current_cn: 伟大的。我很快就要出发了。

canonical_source: Your father was a court noble, advising the emperor himself. While he held no actual power, none dared touch him, and even Daimyo would turn their ears to listen when he spoke. He made his living tutoring noble sons, and he taught you alongside them.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位宫廷贵族，亲自为皇帝提供建议。他虽然没有实权，却没有人敢碰他，就连大名也会侧耳倾听。他以辅导贵族子弟为生，并与他们一起教导你。

canonical_source: I wish to join your school
I suppose the laws of this town bind me as well. You can take the guns.
current_cn: 我想这个镇的法律也对我有约束力。你可以拿枪。

canonical_source: Some swore the Emperor must rule directly. Others said the Tokugawa alone kept the peace. I came to master the blade, not speeches.
current_cn: 有些人发誓必须由皇帝直接统治。其他人则说德川独自维持了和平。我是来掌握刀锋的，而不是演讲的。

canonical_source: Enables historical events, must be enabled from the start of the campaign.
current_cn: 启用历史事件，必须从活动开始时启用。

canonical_source: The smiths are watching the merchants fiercely. I bet {QUEST_GIVER.NAME} is planning a way to sell off their foreign stock right now.
current_cn: 铁匠们正严密地盯着商人。我敢打赌，{QUEST_GIVER.NAME} 此刻正在设法把手中的外国货物库存出手。

canonical_source: Koyama is strategic stronghold in Southern Kyushu, nestled in the rugged terrain of Higo Province, where mountain passes connect inland domains to the western coast.
current_cn: 小山是九州南部的战略要塞，坐落在肥后省崎岖的地形上，山口将内陆地区与西海岸连接起来。

canonical_source: Maybe {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} will help you to remember me.
current_cn: 也许 {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} 会帮助你记住我。

canonical_source: The castle town of Sadowara, located in the southern portion of Kyushu, has served as the seat of the Itō clan for generations. Benefiting from fertile plains and proximity to maritime routes, Sadowara has flourished as both an administrative and agricultural center becoming the epicenter of the Itō clan's expansion attempts in the region.
current_cn: 位于九州南部的城下町佐渡原，世代以来都是伊藤氏族的居所。得益于肥沃的平原和靠近海上航线的优势，佐渡原作为行政和农业中心而蓬勃发展，成为伊藤氏族在该地区扩张尝试的中心。

canonical_source: The turmoil stirred by the Black Ships threatened to tear the country apart. Rather than embrace reckless extremism, you supported the policy of kōbu gattai: Unification of the Imperial Court and Bakufu. Through careful service and measured loyalty, you worked to preserve order in an age that seemed determined to abandon it.
current_cn: 黑船引发的骚乱威胁着国家的分裂。您没有拥抱鲁莽的极端主义，而是支持“宫部合体”政策：宫廷与幕府的统一。通过细心的服务和谨慎的忠诚，你们努力在一个似乎决心放弃秩序的时代维持秩序。

canonical_source: I decide how the law here is applied, merchant.
current_cn: 我决定这里的法律如何适用，商人。

canonical_source: The more I learned, the clearer it became that the outside world was changing faster than we were. Some say Western knowledge is poison. Others worship it without question. I think both are fools.
current_cn: 我了解得越多，就越清楚外部世界的变化比我们更快。有人说西方知识是毒药。其他人毫无疑问地崇拜它。我觉得两个都是傻子。

canonical_source: Kansai is the centermost region of Japan, and the origin of most strife in the Bakumatsu. Here sonno-joi radicals and shogunate loyalists clash in the streets of Kyoto and in the court of the Emperor. From here arose Tokugawa Iemochi, the current Shogun, and Ii Naosuke, the Tairo who dominated the Bakufu throughout the period until his assassination in 1860. The domains of Kansai were once some of the strongest for the Shogun, but many are being pushed away by their political rivals, forcing them into joining the Imperial cause.
current_cn: 关西是日本的最中心地区，也是幕末冲突最多的发源地。在这里，尊王攘夷的激进分子和幕府的忠诚者在京都的街道和天皇的宫廷中发生冲突。从这里诞生了现任幕府德川家茂，以及在整个幕府时期一直统治幕府直至 1860 年被暗杀的井伊直弼。关西地区曾经是幕府最强大的藩之一，但许多藩都被政治对手排挤，迫使他们加入帝国事业。

canonical_source: Your companion has protected the foreign merchant from {SETTLEMENT} as promised. {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} was happy with your work.
current_cn: 你的同伴已经按照承诺保护了外国商人免受{SETTLEMENT}的侵害。 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 对您的工作感到满意。

canonical_source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} asks you to provide them firearms for their military campaign.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 要求您为他们的军事行动提供枪支。

canonical_source: You spent much of your youth at the domain school, learning etiquette, the classics, rhetoric, and of course swordsmanship. You spend your days drilling forms and sparring under the watchful eyes of senior retainers. Though still young, the constant practice hardened your body and sharpened your instincts in close combat.
current_cn: 你年轻时的大部分时间都在藩校里度过，学习礼仪、经典、辞藻，当然还有剑术。你每天都在高级随从的注视下练习表格和陪练。虽然还年轻，但不断的练习锻炼了你的身体，磨砺了你的近战本能。

canonical_source: The Shogunate signs treaties with foreigners, bows to foreign demands, and allows foreign ships into our waters. Every year the old order grows weaker, yet the officials tell us to remain calm.
current_cn: 幕府与外国人签订条约，屈服于外国的要求，并允许外国船只进入我们的水藩。旧秩序一年比一年弱，但官员却告诉我们要保持冷静。

canonical_source: Present the catalogue of firearms and artillery presently in your possession.
current_cn: 出示您目前拥有的枪支和火炮目录。

canonical_source: Excellent. I'll have the goods delivered to you right away.[if:convo_nonchalant]
current_cn: 出色的。我会马上把货送到您手中.[if:convo_nonchalant]

canonical_source: A seemingly quiet castle town built atop Mount Kinugasa, Kannonji has been repeatedly embroiled in the conflicts of its ancestral owners, the Rokkaku clan, and only the castle’s natural defenses have allowed it to resist several sieges.
current_cn: 观音寺是一座看似安静的城堡小镇，建在衣笠山顶上，但它却屡次卷入其祖先六角氏的冲突，只有城堡的天然防御才使它能够抵御数次围攻。

canonical_source: If there is more you would ask of me, speak
current_cn: 如果您还有更多问题想问我，请说

canonical_source: You spent long hours copying reports and tax ledgers for domain officials. The work was tedious but taught you careful bookkeeping and administrative discipline.
current_cn: 您花了很长时间为藩官员复制报告和税务分类帐。这项工作很乏味，但教会了你仔细的记账和行政纪律。

canonical_source: The Emperor sits in Kyoto while weak men rule in his name.
current_cn: 天皇坐在京都，弱者以他的名义统治。

canonical_source: Dojos are neutral settlements where the player and AI can recruit students, purchase martial manuals that improve combat skills, join a specific school, or duel instructors for rank and reputation. Each dojo follows a distinct martial lineage. Improving relations with a dojo strengthens relations with all dojos of that lineage, and may improve standing with their sponsoring domain.
current_cn: 道场是中立地点，玩家和AI可以在这里招收门生、购买能够提升战斗技能的武术手册、加入特定流派，或与师范进行决斗以提升段位和声望。每个道场都传承着独特的武术流派。改善与某一道场的关系，会加强与该流派所有道场的关系，并可能提升你在其所属藩的地位。

canonical_source: The Caste Mechanic is an optional mechanic added in Bakumatsu to reflect the caste system of Edo period Japan. This caste system, put into place at the founding of the Tokugawa Shogunate, reflected the Tokugawa clan's deep paranoia and fear of being replaced. Due to this, it is often more of a restriction than a boon, and is not recommended if you want to enjoy a simple, easy playthrough.
current_cn: 身分机制是《Bakumatsu》加入的可选规则，用于表现江户时代的身分秩序。游戏将这种秩序理解为德川幕府建立统治后，为维持既有政治结构而形成的一系列限制。因此，它带来的约束通常多于收益；如果只想进行较轻松、直接的游戏流程，可以关闭这一机制。

canonical_source: Right to command a personal retinue
I will talk no more. Get ready to fight.
current_cn: 我不再说话了。准备好战斗吧。

canonical_source: You have persuaded {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} to disband his party and return home. You received {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} in return for your service.
current_cn: 您已说服 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 解散他的政党并返回家园。您收到 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 作为您服务的回报。
升级至 {UPGRADE_TARGET}{newline}需要：{REQUIRED_ALIGNMENT} 阵营（你属于 {PARTY_ALIGNMENT} 阵营）

canonical_source: You are a new face. This is the dojo of our school. State your business.
current_cn: 你是一张新面孔。这是我们流派的道场。说明您的业务。

canonical_source: Things have gotten a lot worse recently with the shishi radicals on the roads around town. I cannot risk the safety of my guest when he leaves the city.
current_cn: 最近，城镇周围道路上的尊攘激进派的情况变得更糟。当我的客人离开这座城市时，我不能拿他的安全冒险。

canonical_source: I'll assign one of my companions and {NEEDED_MEN_COUNT} of my men to protect your guest for {RETURN_DAYS} days.
current_cn: 我将指派一名同伴和 {NEEDED_MEN_COUNT} 名手下保护您的客人 {RETURN_DAYS} 天。

canonical_source: You failed to stop {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} before he stirred up unrest in the countryside. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} will be very upset about this.
current_cn: 在 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 在乡村煽动骚乱之前，你没能阻止他。 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 会对此感到非常不安。

canonical_source: Welcome to {SETTLEMENT_NAME}. I think you'll find these are good, law-abiding folk, for the most part.
current_cn: 欢迎来到{SETTLEMENT_NAME}。我想你会发现这些人大部分都是守法的好人。

canonical_source: Okayama is a castle town located in the western part of the Chūgoku region, providing both military and economic advantages through access to maritime trade routes and strategic passage between Honshu and Shikoku
current_cn: 冈山是位于中国地区西部的城下町，通过海上贸易路线以及本州和四国之间的战略通道提供军事和经济优势

canonical_source: I must take my leave, sensei.

Unable to make a living by regular means, you chose to join a group of bandits to make a living at the expense of the very people who lived in the countryside. Killing and looting together with your gang, one step ahead of the samurai, you became a ruthless raider.
current_cn: 由于无法正常谋生，你选择加入土匪队伍，以牺牲农村人民的利益为生。与你的帮派一起杀戮和掠夺，比武士领先一步，你成为一名残酷的掠夺者。

canonical_source: I feel safe knowing that you're looking after us. Please continue to follow us my friend!
current_cn: 知道你在照顾我们，我感到很安全。请朋友继续关注我们！

canonical_source: Sir, I have been granted leave to attend within the castle. If you have business with me, I will answer as I am able.
current_cn: 先生，我已获准在城堡内参加活动。如果您有事找我，我会尽力回答。

canonical_source: The enemy side in field battles will have the same field artillery you do.
current_cn: 野战中敌方将拥有与你相同的野战炮兵。

canonical_source: Your father was a hatamoto, a direct retainer of the Tokugawa Shoguns themselves. One of the roughly five thousand hatamoto spread throughout Japan, he held an administrative rank in the Bakufu, administering a village on behalf of the Shogun.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位旗本，是德川幕府将军的直属家臣。他是遍布日本的大约五千人之一，在幕府担任行政职务，代表幕府管理一个村庄。

canonical_source: I will examine your Western-style uniforms and military equipment.
current_cn: 我会检查你们的西式制服和军事装备。
皇家海軍陸戰隊輕步兵老兵

canonical_source: Shinkage-ryu is a transformative kenjutsu lineage that emphasizes strategy, posture, and subtlety. Practitioners wield katana and wakizashi, focusing on psychological control and precision. In the Bakumatsu period, Shinkage-ryu influenced many derivative schools, including Taisha-ryu, and trained elite duelists and samurai instructors.
current_cn: 新阴流是一种变革性的剑术传承，强调策略、姿势和微妙。练习者使用武士刀和胁差，注重心理控制和精准度。在幕末时期，新阴流影响了包括大社流在内的许多衍生流派，并培养了精英决斗者和武士导师。

canonical_source: A younger son of a samurai family, I was sent to Edo to study at a famous d┼ìj┼ì. Every evening the students argued politics more fiercely than they crossed swords.
current_cn: 我是一个武士家庭的小儿子，被送到江户去著名的道场学习。每天晚上，学生们的政治争论比剑拔弩张还要激烈。

canonical_source: Refill my glass and I'll tell you.
current_cn: 给我的杯子续满，我会告诉你。

canonical_source: Tameshi-ai, the 'assessment match,' are matches between two students with wooden blades. These matches, inside or between dojos, are meant to improve oneself, not to harm, though their results may reflect upon the school. Only those who have received a Mokuroku may participate.
current_cn: 试合，即“试合”，是两名学生用木刀进行的比试。这些比试，无论是在道场内还是在道场之间，都是为了提高自己，而不是为了伤害，尽管他们的结果可能会影响到流派。只有收到目録的人才能参加。

canonical_source: Owari Kan-ryu specializes in the sliding kuda-yari, offering innovative spear techniques. Practitioners train in precision, timing, and footwork. The school's unique weapons and methods were valued by Owari samurai for both ceremonial and battlefield purposes.
current_cn: 尾张贯流 专注于滑动 管枪，提供创新的矛技术。练习者训练精确度、时机和步法。该流派独特的武器和方法受到尾张武士的重视，用于仪式和战场目的。

canonical_source: Strategically located in the westernmost part of the San'yō region, near the Kanmon Straits that separate Honshu from Kyushu, Kushizaki is a port castle town originally by the Naitō clan, from which it is possible to control the sea and the flow of trade and people across the western provinces.
current_cn: 串崎位于山阳地区最西端，靠近分隔本州和九州的关门海峡，地理位置优越，是内藤氏族最初的港口城堡城镇，可以控制西部省份的海洋以及贸易和人员流动。

canonical_source: It is as it must be. This dojo has been vanquished, {PLAYER.LINK}. Our signboard shall be removed, and my students must follow where honor now permits. You have claimed what was once ours.
current_cn: 事情就是这样。这个道场已经被征服了，{PLAYER.LINK}。我们的招牌将被拆除，我的学生必须在荣誉允许的情况下遵循。你已经夺走了曾经属于我们的东西。

canonical_source: Fukuoka is very prominently Sonno-joi, so much so that the Shogunate is considering arresting their daimyo on suspicion of rebellion. However, they are unwilling to actually dedicate their own troops to the cause, instead using forces they consider expendable, cobbled together from what the dregs of society to war against the Shogunate.
current_cn: 福冈是非常著名的尊王攘夷，以至于幕府正在考虑以涉嫌叛乱为由逮捕他们的大名。然而，他们并不愿意真正将自己的军队投入到这项事业中，而是使用他们认为可以消耗的、从社会渣滓中拼凑出来的军队来对抗幕府。

canonical_source: Nestled in the valleys of southern Kyushu, Hitoyoshi is a small but proud domain, its hills and rivers shaping life as much as the Sagara clan that rules it. Their samurai, like so many others in the period, are deeply split between the Shogunate and Emperor, leading to their own internal clashes.
current_cn: 人吉坐落在九州南部的山谷中，是一个虽小但令人自豪的藩，它的山丘和河流与统治它的相良氏族一样塑造着人们的生活。他们的武士，就像那个时期的许多其他武士一样，在幕府和天皇之间存在着深深的分歧，导致了他们自己的内部冲突。

canonical_source: One of the wealthiest domains in Japan, Kumamoto is ruled by the Hosokawa clan, one of the most powerful clans in Japan. They are more hesitant to join the Emperor than many of the more radical domains, but are still a powerful modern domain.
current_cn: 熊本是日本最富有的藩之一，由日本最强大的氏族之一细川氏族统治。他们比许多更激进的藩更犹豫是否加入皇帝，但仍然是一个强大的现代藩。

canonical_source: Kurume domain is a fierce battleground between Sonno-Joi and Shogunate supporters, both originating from the Tenpo School. Following the death of Arima Yorinaga in 1846, they split into the Gai-doshi, a radical sonno-joi traditionalist faction, and Nai-doshi, a reformer, pro-western, pro-shogunate factions. Currently, the Nai-doshi hold sway, but who knows if that will change.
current_cn: 久留米藩是来自天保派的尊王攘夷派和幕府支持者之间的激烈战场。 1846 年有马赖永去世后，他们分裂为激进的尊王攘夷传统派系外道士和改革派、亲西方、亲幕府派系内道士。目前，内导师占据主导地位，但谁知道这种情况是否会改变。

canonical_source: Saga is perhaps the most modern domain in Japan. The Nabeshima have invested in steam engines, steel refining, artillery, and modern firearms, alongside vaccination programs and significant domain reforms, modernizing even before the Black Ships arrived in 1853. There are few domains friendlier to the west than Saga.
current_cn: 佐贺也许是日本最现代化的藩。锅岛家族投资了蒸汽机、炼钢、火炮和现代火器，同时还进行了疫苗接种计划和重大藩改革，甚至在 1853 年黑船抵达之前就实现了现代化。很少有藩比佐贺对西方更加友好。

canonical_source: Satsuma occupies a unique position in the late Bakumatsu. The Shimazu joined the shogunate under their own terms due to their distance from the rest of Japan and their military power, providing them with a semi-independent status. The domain is highly militarized, with more samurai than any other domain in Japan, and samurai renowned for their loyalty, identifying first as Satsuma men before anything else. They are also rapidly reforming, forming some of the most modern troops in Japan.
current_cn: 萨摩在幕末末期占有独特的地位。由于与日本其他地区的距离及其军事实力，岛津氏按照自己的条件加入了幕府，为他们提供了半独立的地位。该藩是高度军事化的，拥有比日本任何其他藩都多的武士，武士以忠诚而闻名，首先被认为是萨摩男人。他们也在迅速改革，组建了日本最现代化的军队。

canonical_source: Kokura is the rare Shogunate loyalist in the southwest, supporting the Shogun even despite being surrounded by larger, more pro-Imperial domains. This attitude remains ever despite losses against the sonno-joi forces, an almost admirable attitude if it didn't end up with a burning castle.
current_cn: 小仓是西南地区罕见的幕府忠诚者，尽管周围被更大、更尊王的藩包围，但他仍然支持幕府。尽管在与尊王攘夷军队的战斗中遭受损失，这种态度仍然存在，如果最终没有导致一座燃烧的城堡，这种态度几乎是令人钦佩的。

canonical_source: While in essence the same as the {BOSHIN_REFORMS_LINK} in their timing and reasoning, Aizu domain took a rather unique approach to reforming their military. Still unwilling to allow peasants in their military, Aizu instead implemented their 4 Gods Organization, classifying the samurai of their domain into one of four units, based on age. The Byakkotai were the youngest, made up of 16-17 year olds, followed by the Suzakutai (18-35), Seiryutai (36-49), and the Genbutai (50+), alongside a number of volunteer units that sprung up across the domain. Ultimately, however, these units were not enough to stave off the invasion of their domain and brutal siege of their castle.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are unlocked with the Western Drill policy instead.
current_cn: 会津藩的改革在时间和动因上与{BOSHIN_REFORMS_LINK}大体相同，但其军制重组采取了相当独特的方式。会津仍不愿让农民进入军队，于是按年龄把藩内武士编入“四神”诸队：最年轻的白虎队由16至17岁者组成，其后依次为朱雀队（18至35岁）、青龙队（36至49岁）与玄武队（50岁以上），此外还有遍布全藩的多支志愿部队。最终，这套编制仍不足以阻止敌军入侵，也未能避免若松城遭到惨烈围攻。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种由“西式操练”政策解锁。

canonical_source: You served as a simple spearman, guarding places valued by your lord and putting down the occasional bandit group.
current_cn: 你作为一个简单的枪兵，守卫着你的领主所重视的地方，并镇压偶尔出现的强盗团伙。

canonical_source: Hailing from a modest samurai background in Kagoshima, the Ōkubo are bureaucrats rather than warriors—but it is in politics that they sharpen their blades. Ōkubo Toshimichi, pragmatic and sharp-tongued, is fast becoming one of the most feared minds in Satsuma. A staunch ally of Saigō Takamori, he believes that only radical reform can save Japan from subjugation by the West. While others cry for war against foreign powers, Ōkubo sees the greater enemy in Japan's own corruption and feudal stagnation. As the Satsuma domain balances on the edge of rebellion, the Ōkubo clan builds networks, forges alliances, and prepares to steer the storm. In 1864, they are the hidden hand guiding the future of a crumbling shogunate.
current_cn: 大久保家族出身于鹿儿岛，出身普通武士，与其说是武士，不如说是官僚——但他们正是在政治中磨砺了自己的刀锋。务实且言辞尖锐的大久保俊道正迅速成为萨摩最令人畏惧的人物之一。作为西乡隆盛的坚定盟友，他认为只有激进的改革才能使日本免遭西方的征服。当其他人呼吁对外国列强发动战争时，大久保认为更大的敌人是日本自身的腐败和封建停滞。萨摩藩处于叛乱边缘，大久保氏建立网络、结成联盟，准备驾驭风暴。 1864 年，他们是指导摇摇欲坠的幕府未来的幕后之手。

canonical_source: The Saigō are not daimyō, but few wield as much influence in Satsuma as Saigō Takamori. A samurai of humble origin and towering presence, Saigō is a leading voice in the sonnō jōi movement. Beloved by the lower samurai and feared by political rivals, he walks a tightrope between personal loyalty to the Shimazu clan and his growing vision for a reformed Japan. In 1864, Saigō has returned from exile to help Satsuma crush the Chōshū rebellion, but his heart lies with imperial cause. Torn between duty and destiny, the Saigō family rises not through land or armies, but through the charisma and ideals of its reluctant champion.
current_cn: 西乡家族虽然不是大名，但在萨摩藩却很少有人能像西乡隆盛那样拥有如此大的影响力。西乡是一位出身卑微、风度翩翩的武士，是尊王攘夷侍卫运动的领军人物。他受到下层武士的爱戴和政治对手的恐惧，他在对岛津氏的个人忠诚和他对改革日本日益增长的愿景之间走钢丝。 1864 年，西乡流亡归来，帮助萨摩藩镇压长州叛乱，但他的心却是帝国事业。西乡家族在责任和命运之间左右为难，他们的崛起不是通过土地或军队，而是通过其不情愿的冠军的魅力和理想。

canonical_source: Invite British advisors to train troops and officers in modern military tactics and logistics, leading to more professional and skilled units.
current_cn: 邀请英国顾问对部队和军官进行现代军事战术和后勤方面的培训，从而培养出更加专业和技术精湛的部队。

canonical_source: Introduce a modern national currency system based on paper bills and minted coins. This replaces the feudal koku rice standard, streamlining commerce and aligning the economy with Western financial practices.
current_cn: 引入基于纸币和铸造硬币的现代国家货币体系。这取代了封建的石米标准，简化了商业并使经济与西方金融实践保持一致。

canonical_source: Abolish the privileges of the samurai class, stripping them of stipends and exclusive rights. Their former domains are reorganized under new laws and modern administration.
current_cn: 废除武士阶级的特权，剥夺他们的津贴和专有权。他们以前的藩根据新的法律和现代管理进行了重组。

canonical_source: Reignite sonnō-jōi sentiment and expel foreign advisors and missionaries. This policy unifies conservatives and traditionalists, but causes economic setbacks.
current_cn: 重燃尊王攘夷情绪，驱逐外国顾问和传教士。这项政策将保守派和传统主义者联合起来，但却造成了经济挫折。

canonical_source: Invite French advisors to train troops and officers in modern military tactics and logistics, leading to more professional and skilled units.
current_cn: 邀请法国顾问对部队和军官进行现代军事战术和后勤培训，打造更加专业和技术精湛的部队。

canonical_source: Elevate the Emperor as a living symbol of divine unity. Troops fight not for domain or province, but for the restoration of Imperial rule.
current_cn: 将皇帝提升为神圣统一的活生生的象征。军队不是为了领土或省份而战，而是为了恢复帝国统治。

canonical_source: Implement conscription to create a standing modern army. By requiring all able-bodied men to serve, the military grows rapidly, though at the cost of social unrest and economic strain.
current_cn: 实行征兵制，建设现代化常备军。通过要求所有身体健全的男子服役，军队迅速发展，尽管代价是社会动荡和经济紧张。

canonical_source: Given how outdated our current firearms are, it is better to import modern ones from across the sea to arm our troops, whatever the cost to our own domestic industry.
current_cn: 鉴于我们目前的枪支已经过时，最好从大洋彼岸进口现代枪支来武装我们的军队，无论我们国内工业付出什么代价。

canonical_source: Invest heavily in modern industries, with towns fostering ironworks, textiles, and modern construction. Villages grow as they supply food and manpower to new urban centers.
current_cn: 大力投资现代工业，城镇大力发展钢铁厂、纺织业和现代建筑业。村庄随着向新的城市中心提供食物和人力而不断发展。

canonical_source: Promote a national ideology rooted in loyalty, discipline, and Bushidō. Through ceremonies, oaths, and state rhetoric, soldiers and citizens alike are bound to the cause of unifying and strengthening the nation.
current_cn: 弘扬以忠诚、纪律和武士道为基础的国家意识形态。通过仪式、誓言和国家言论，士兵和公民都致力于统一和加强国家的事业。

canonical_source: Establish modern officer academies to educate young samurai in Western military tactics, strategy, and leadership. These institutions lay the foundation for a professionalized command structure.
current_cn: 建立现代军官学院，对年轻武士进行西方军事战术、战略和领导力教育。这些机构为专业化的指挥结构奠定了基础。

canonical_source: Establish a nationwide school system to educate children of all classes in literacy, arithmetic, and civics. By fostering an informed and disciplined populace, the nation prepares future soldiers, administrators, and industrial workers.
current_cn: 建立全国性的流派系统，对各阶层的儿童进行识字、算术和公民教育。通过培养知识渊博、纪律严明的民众，国家可以培养未来的士兵、行政人员和产业工人。

canonical_source: Embrace Western medical science, known as Ranpo, derived from Dutch texts and modern anatomy. Hospitals and domain physicians begin applying these foreign techniques to improve public health and treat battlefield wounds.
current_cn: 引入西方医学，即所谓“兰学”，源自荷兰文献和现代解剖学。医院和战地医生开始应用这些外国技术来改善公共卫生和治疗战场伤口。

canonical_source: Reinstitute the closed country policy of previous centuries, isolating the nation from foreign influence while bolstering internal cohesion and traditional values.
current_cn: 重新实行前几个世纪的封闭国家政策，使国家免受外国影响，同时增强内部凝聚力和传统价值观。

canonical_source: Reaffirm loyalty to the Tokugawa Shogunate. Troops and administrators act in service to the established bakufu, preserving order and tradition.
current_cn: 重申对德川幕府的忠诚。军队和行政人员为既定的幕府服务，维护秩序和传统。

canonical_source: Adopt standardized uniforms for modern units. These make units easier to identify, coordinate, and supply, while promoting discipline and unity among troops.
current_cn: 采用现代化单位标准化制服。这些使得部队更容易识别、协调和补给，同时促进部队之间的纪律和团结。

canonical_source: Reform and fund kenjutsu dojos to train young samurai in traditional swordsmanship. These schools preserve martial heritage while preparing warriors for the shifting nature of modern warfare.
current_cn: 改革并资助剑术道场，以培训年轻武士传统剑术。这些流派保留军事遗产，同时为战士们做好应对现代战争不断变化的性质的准备。

canonical_source: No matter how much we adopt modern technology, war must not change. We are samurai, and we shall fight like it.
current_cn: 无论我们如何采用现代技术，战争都不能改变。我们是武士，我们要像武士一样战斗。

canonical_source: Adopt military practices from Western powers, emphasizing drill, discipline, and battlefield maneuver. Lords begin training their retainers to fight in formation, rather than relying on traditional melee tactics.
current_cn: 借鉴西方列强的军事做法，强调训练、纪律和战场机动。领主们开始训练他们的家臣以队形作战，而不是依赖传统的近战战术。

canonical_source: Encourage the rise of powerful merchant families to organize and centralize industrial production, at the cost of diminishing local tax revenue.
current_cn: 鼓励强大的商人家族的崛起来组织和集中工业生产，但代价是地方税收收入减少。

canonical_source: At the very bottom of Edo society sat the outcastes. Often forced into these roles by hereditary profession, there were myriad different terms for these outcastes depending on which profession they descended from. But by far the most numerous were the Eta and the Hinin. Eta, a term meaning 'very polluted' or 'abundance of filth' applied to the descendants of leatherworkers, who were considered ritually impure due to their association with blood and death, while Hinin, meaning 'not human', applied to the descendants of mendicants and beggars. Despite their role on the fringes of society and the immense distaste that even peasants held towards them, these castes played vital roles in Edo society. Eta made all of the leather products used and worn in society, and took care of dead animals for nearby villages, making them often quite wealthy in the process, while Hinin acted as guards and policemen for the daimyo and managed the beggars and performers in an area, ensuring that only Hinin under their local organization could beg in each neighborhood, and only in the allotted ways.{newline}{newline}These lower castes built various complicated internal governing structures, most notable with Danzaemon in Kanto, a hereditary name passed down among a family of Eta who controlled all outcastes in the Kanto region. 13 men held the name of Danzaemon throughout the Edo period, and he was estimated to be worth roughly 50,000 kokudaka, making him the equivalent of a mid ranking Daimyo. Even so, the social stigma and discrimination against members of these castes was incredibly intense, to the point that aftereffects are felt even in the modern day, 160 years later.{newline}{newline}Pros: None{newline}{newline}Resistrictions:{newline}Cannot command personal retinue (-33% party size from clan tier and Steward){newline}Cannot hold a fief as a vassal of a kingdom{newline}Cannot enter keep of towns and castles unless a vassal of the owner kingdom{newline}Cannot engage in commerce (No workshops or caravans)
current_cn: 江户社会的最底层是贱民。这些被遗弃者通常是因世袭职业而被迫担任这些角色，根据他们的职业后裔，对这些被排斥者有无数不同的术语。但到目前为止人数最多的是埃塔人和希宁人。 Eta，这个词的意思是“严重污染”或“大量的污物”，适用于制革工人的后裔，由于他们与鲜血和死亡有关，他们在仪式上被认为是不纯洁的，而Hinin，意思是“非人类”，适用于托钵僧和乞丐的后裔。尽管他们处于社会边缘，甚至农民也对他们深恶痛绝，但这些种姓在江户社会中发挥着至关重要的作用。埃塔制造了社会上使用和穿着的所有皮革制品，并为附近的村庄照顾死去的动物，在这个过程中他们往往变得相当富有，而希宁则充当大名的警卫和警察，管理一个地区的乞丐和表演者，确保只有当地组织下的希宁才能在每个社区乞讨，而且只能以指定的方式进行。{newline}{newline}这些较低的种姓建立了各种复杂的内部管理结构，最著名的是在关东，是控制关东地区所有贱民的埃塔家族所传承的世袭名称。整个江户时代，有13名男子拥有团左卫门的名字，据估计他的身价约为50,000石高，相当于中级大名。即便如此，对这些种姓成员的社会耻辱和歧视仍然非常严重，以至于即使在 160 年后的现代，也能感受到后遗症。{newline}{newline}优点：无{newline}{newline}限制：{newline}不能指挥个人随从（氏族等级和管家的政党规模为-33%）{newline}不能作为封臣持有封地王国{newline}不能进入城镇和城堡的要塞，除非拥有者王国的封臣{newline}不能从事商业（没有作坊或商队）

canonical_source: You have yet to fully learn any new techniques
current_cn: 你还没有完全学会任何新技术

canonical_source: When using {FIELD_ARTILLERY_LINK}, each type of cannon has a default ammunition type, and a handful of special ammunition types. For example, the La Hitte Mountain Gun can shoot shells, round shot, or canister shot. For you or members of your party to be able to use specialized ammo in battle, the overall commander of your side in the battle must have the 'Stonecutters' or 'Siege Engineer' perk.{newline}{newline}You can switch ammo by hitting P before reloading the artillery in battle.
current_cn: 使用{FIELD_ARTILLERY_LINK}时，每种火炮都有默认弹药，并可能使用若干特殊弹种。例如拉希特山炮可以发射榴弹、实心弹或霰弹。若要让玩家或队伍成员在战斗中使用特殊弹药，本方总指挥必须拥有“石匠”或“攻城工程师”相关技能。{newline}{newline}战斗中，在火炮重新装填前按P键可以切换弹种。

canonical_source: Taryu-shiai, 'inter-school matches,' are the true competitions. Fought between schools, usually without sharp weapons. Blows are often pulled, but serious injury can occur. A win can bring us great renown, while a loss will shame us deeply, so only Menkyo may fight in a Taryu-shiai.
current_cn: 他流试合，“校际比试”，才是真正的他流试合。流派之间的战斗，通常没有利器。经常会受到打击，但可能会造成严重伤害。胜利可以为我们带来巨大的声誉，而失败则可以让我们深感耻辱，所以只有免许可以参加他流试合战斗。

canonical_source: Of course I can supply you with weapons. What do you need?
current_cn: 当然，我可以为你提供武器。你需要什么？

canonical_source: 'Oh my pocket's been picked \n And my shirt's drenched with sick \n And my head feels like it's come a fit to bursting'
current_cn: “哦，我的口袋被扒了 我的衬衫被病菌浸湿了 我的头感觉快要爆炸了”

canonical_source: A practitioner of another school I see. While you are here, you will observe the customs of our style.[ib:aggressive][if:convo_concentration]
current_cn: 另一流派的修习者。当您在这里时，您将观察到我们风格的习俗。[ib:aggressive][if:convo_concentration]

canonical_source: You have defeated our representative, {PLAYER.LINK}. While your skill is clear, this dojo's honor remains intact, and we shall prepare anew.
current_cn: 你击败了我们的代表{PLAYER.LINK}。虽然你的实力已经很清楚了，但这个道场的荣誉仍然完好无损，我们将重新准备。

canonical_source: Kishu domain, ruled by the Kishu Tokugawa, one of the Gosanke, or 'Three Noble Houses', of the Tokugawa Shogunate, reformed far later than most of Japan. Rather than taking inspiration from Britain or France like the rest of Japan, Kishu instead built their army along the Prussian model, implementing a conscript system that required a few years in active duty, then a few in the reserves, followed by service in the militia. However, these reforms occurred after the Boshin War, and ultimately came to naught as the Bakuhan system was dissolved and the private armies of the daimyo were folded into the new Imperial army.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are unlocked with the Implement Conscription policy instead.
current_cn: 纪州藩由德川御三家之一的纪州德川家统治，其军制改革比日本多数地区都来得更晚。与多以英国或法国为范本的诸藩不同，纪州选择仿效普鲁士军制，实行征兵制度：服若干年现役，随后转入预备役，最后编入民兵。然而，这些改革发生在戊辰战争之后；随着幕藩体制解体，大名私军最终并入新的官军体系，纪州的改革也未能继续发展。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种由“实施征兵制”政策解锁。

canonical_source: Canon de Montagne de 4 La Hitte
You've sucessfully achieved the required level of mastery for Mokuroku. Return to your teacher to formally rank up.
current_cn: 您已成功达到目録所需的掌握水平。返回老师处正式升级。

canonical_source: fell in with a group of bandits.
current_cn: 跟一群强盗混在一起了。
商人不能出售外国枪支

canonical_source: Resentment is poison to a friendship. Men must learn to follow the natural flow.
current_cn: 怨恨是友谊的毒药。男人必须学会顺应自然潮流。

canonical_source: Oshima-ryu is a multi-weapon school specializing in yari, naginata, and variations such as jumonji and kagi yari. Practitioners develop complex thrusting and footwork techniques, serving as capable battlefield instructors during the late Tokugawa period.
current_cn: 大岛流是一所多武器流派，专门研究弓、薙刀以及十文字和钩镰枪等变体。练习者发展复杂的刺击和步法技术，在德川时代后期担任有能力的战场教练。

canonical_source: The Kosanji rebels have prevailed, and Choshu will once again reject the Shogunate’s authority. The conservatives have all been purged or cast aside, and the sonno joi have once again taken power in Choshu.
current_cn: 耕三寺叛军取得了胜利，长州将再次拒绝幕府的权威。保守派全部被清洗或被抛弃，尊王党再次在长州掌权。

canonical_source: The Tengu-to Rebels have won out. While the Shogunate remains open to foreigners, Mito has unified around the Sonno-joi.
current_cn: 天狗岛叛军取得了胜利。虽然幕府仍然对外国人开放，但水户已经统一在尊王攘夷周围。

canonical_source: Choshu has forced back the Shogunate forces, showing the weakness of the Shogunate more clearly than ever before.
current_cn: 长州将幕府势力逼退，幕府的弱点比以往任何时候都更加明显。

canonical_source: Despite being outnumbered, Choshu has achieved a crushing victory against the forces of the Bakufu. Their modern infantry has proven superior over the half-hearted reforms of the Bakufu. The Shogunate is weak, and the wolves have begun to gather.
current_cn: 尽管寡不敌众，长州还是取得了对幕府军队的压倒性胜利。事实证明，他们的现代步兵优于幕府半心半意的改革。幕府衰弱，狼群开始聚集。

canonical_source: The {Reform} have begun, as various domains have begun refining their militaries once more into a more modern form.
current_cn: {Reform} 已经开始，各藩再次着手将军队整编为更加现代化的形态。

canonical_source: The First Choshu Expedition has ended with a whimper, rather than a roar. Under the leadership of Saigo Takamori, a light punishment has been enforced, and several retainers of Choshu have committed seppuku to apologize for the Kinmon Incident.
current_cn: 第一次长州远征是在一声呜咽中结束的，而不是一声咆哮。在西乡隆盛的带领下，实行了轻刑，多名长州家臣纷纷切腹，为禁门之变道歉。

canonical_source: The Tengu-to Rebels have failed, and the Shogunate will remain open to foreigners. The ringleaders have been executed or forced to commit seppuku, and the Conservatives shall rule in Mito.
current_cn: 天狗岛叛军失败了，幕府仍将向外国人开放。头目已被处决或被迫切腹，保守党将统治水户。

canonical_source: Choshu's assault on Kyoto has ended in defeat. Repelled at the Forbidden Gates, the domain is now condemned as a rebel force. With imperial approval secured, the Shogunate has called its allied domains to arms and begun a grand punitive campaign. If they crush Choshu's remaining resistance, the Bakufu's authority will be restored across Japan.
current_cn: 长州进攻京都以失败告终。该藩在禁门被击退，现在被谴责为叛军。在获得天皇批准后，幕府已号召其盟国武装起来，并开始了一场大规模的惩罚性战役。如果他们粉碎了长州剩余的抵抗，幕府的权威将在日本各地恢复。

canonical_source: The Seigi-ha have risen up at Kosanji Temple, challenging the conservative faction in Choshu, who have been cracking down on the radicals ever since the domain's loss in the First Choshu Expedition.
current_cn: 清仪派在高山寺崛起，挑战长州的保守派，自第一次长州远征以来，长州的保守派一直在镇压激进分子。

canonical_source: The Second Choshu Expedition has ended with the success of the Bakufu. Choshu has been thoroughly crushed, never to rise again, and the Bakufu has shown to the world that it is not weak.
current_cn: 第二次长州远征随着幕府的胜利而结束。长州已被彻底击垮，再也无法崛起，而幕府向世人表明了它的不弱。

canonical_source: On the 29th day of the 8th month, the Shōgun, {oldShogun}, passed away at Osaka Castle. By solemn decree of the Bakufu, a mourning period has been declared, and military operations are paused to honor his memory. His successor, {newShogun}, has been named, with authority confirmed by senior officials.
current_cn: 八月二十九日，将军{oldShogun}在大阪城去世。根据幕府的幕府法令，宣布哀悼期，并暂停军事行动以纪念他。他的继任者 {newShogun} 已被任命，并得到了高级官员的确认。

canonical_source: It is hereby announced that His Majesty has passed from this life and joined the Imperial Ancestors. The Heir Apparent has now assumed the Throne. All domains and officials shall observe mourning and maintain order.
current_cn: 特此宣布陛下已圆寂，归入太祖。法定继承人现已登上王位。各藩、各官员应当默哀，维持秩序。

canonical_source: The Shogunate has formally declared a second punitive expedition against the Choshu domain, ordering its allied forces to advance at once in response to Choshu's continued defiance and failure to comply with shogunal commands.
current_cn: 幕府正式宣布对长州藩进行第二次讨伐，命令其联军立即进军，以回应长州的持续蔑视和不遵守幕府命令。

canonical_source: Battle has ignited at Toba–Fushimi between newly declared Imperial troops and the Shogunate. The peace is broken, and both sides call upon their allies. All domains will be expected to declare their stance.
current_cn: 新宣布的帝国军队与幕府之间的战斗在鸟羽伏见爆发。和平被打破，双方都呼吁盟友。所有藩都应声明其立场。

canonical_source: You have joined the {SCHOOL} as an Keppan!
current_cn: 您已作为 血判 加入 {SCHOOL}！

canonical_source: Welcome, my lord. This dojo stands by your favor alone. How may we serve you today?[if:nervous][if:convo_pleased]
current_cn: 欢迎，大人。这个道场全赖您的庇护。今日有何吩咐？[if:nervous][if:convo_pleased]

canonical_source: Menko-Kaiden holders may attempt dojo-yaburi, 'dojo breaking.' One challenges the head of another school. Victory can abolish that dojo, while failure brings dishonor, loss of status, or exile. Such trials are rare, and often involve many students or careful strategy.
current_cn: Menko-Kaiden 持有者可以尝试 道场破り，即“打破道场”。其中一个挑战另一所流派的校长。胜利可以废除道场，而失败则带来耻辱、失去地位或流放。此类试验很少见，并且通常涉及许多学生或采取谨慎的策略。

canonical_source: Nestled within the rugged highlands of northern Kyushu, Kiidani has long served as a fortified settlement, guarding the access to the western island of Japan. Its position overlooking vital inland routes has given it strategic relevance amid the growing contest for control over Kyushu and has already turned Kiidani into a conflict point between the Ouchi and Otomo in the past.
current_cn: 木谷谷坐落在九州北部崎岖的高地上，长期以来一直是一个防御工事的定居点，守卫着通往日本西部岛屿的通道。它俯瞰重要内陆路线的位置使其在九州控制权争夺日益激烈的情况下具有战略意义，并且过去已经使木井谷成为大内氏和大友氏之间的冲突点。

canonical_source: Your performance against {OPPONENT_COUNT} of your fellow students demonstrates growing competence. Remember, mastery is achieved through repetition and mindful correction of one's mistakes.
current_cn: 你与 {OPPONENT_COUNT} 名同门的交手展现出日益增长的实力。请记住，精通技艺来自反复练习，以及认真纠正自己的错误。

canonical_source: The Shogunate will stand with or without me. It has reigned for 250 years, and it will undoubtedly rule for another 1000.
current_cn: 无论有没有我，幕府都会支持。它已经统治了250年，而且毫无疑问还将再统治1000年。

canonical_source: Iwo-Matsuyama, ruled by the Matsudaira clan, occupies a coastal and mountainous region of Shikoku, where fertile river valleys meet rocky hills. Its towns are modest but well-organized, with local markets supporting both farmers and samurai households. The domain has a long history of managing these challenging lands, emphasizing careful administration and fortification rather than sheer military strength. While its samurai maintain traditional martial training, the domain also leans on commerce, fishing, and regional trade to sustain its people.
current_cn: 由松平氏族统治的硫磺松山占据了四国的沿海山区，这里肥沃的河谷与岩石山丘交汇。它的城镇规模不大，但组织良好，当地市场为农民和武士家庭提供支持。该藩管理这些充满挑战的土地有着悠久的历史，强调谨慎的管理和防御工事，而不是纯粹的军事实力。虽然武士们维持传统的武术训练，但该藩也依靠商业、渔业和区藩贸易来维持人民的生计。

canonical_source: Tokushima Domain, despite their strong connections to the Shogunate, remained neutral during the Bakumatsu. Instead of supporting the Shogun or Emperor, they advocated for the kōbu gattai movement, which proposed the unification of the Imperial court and Shogunate against the western powers. Even so, many Tokushima samurai were rather radically pro-Imperial.
current_cn: 德岛藩尽管与幕府关系密切，但在幕末时期保持中立。他们不支持幕府或天皇，而是提倡“古武合体”运动，该运动提出统一朝廷和幕府以对抗西方列强。即便如此，许多德岛武士仍然相当激进地支持帝国。

canonical_source: Uwajima domain is led by a branch of the Date clan, located far from their homeland in Sendai. During the Bakumatsu period, their Daimyo, Date Munenari, was considered one of the Four Wise Lords of the Bakumatsu, alongside Yamauchi Toyoshige, Shimazu Nariakira, and Matsudaira Yoshinaga. During the Bakumatsu, they remained neutral, acting as a go between between the two sides, a stance which ultimately left them less relevant in the Meiji era.
current_cn: 宇和岛藩由伊达氏族的一个分支领导，远离家乡仙台。在幕末时代，他们的大名伊达宗成与山内丰重、岛津齐彰、松平义长并称为幕末四贤主之一。在幕末时期，他们保持中立，充当双方之间的中间人，这种立场最终使他们在明治时代的影响力下降。

canonical_source: The warrior caste, Buke, or 'Warrior House', was the formal term applied to the samurai caste. In name, the samurai existed solely as warriors. However, in practice, by the late Edo period they were closer to a bureaucrat class, with most serving as domain officials. All samurai, except in Satsuma and Hitoyoshi domains, were required to live in their castle town, and required permission to even visit the villages. This was due to the Tokugawa Shogunate's paranoia, as they feared a rebellion or civil war that would unseat them. The samurai were themselves essentially split into two classes: high ranking samurai, such as the Shogunate's Hatamoto, consisted of families that earned more than 100 koku in stipends and served as ranking officials, and low ranking samurai, who served largely as guards and enforcers for their daimyo. By the Bakumatsu period, most low ranking and some high ranking samurai were broke, in debt, and struggling to make ends meet.{newline}{newline}Pros:{newline}Earns daily stipend based on clan tier{newline}Right to command a personal retinue (+50% party size from clan tier and Steward){newline}{newline}Resistrictions:{newline}Cannot engage in commerce (No workshops or caravans)
current_cn: 武士种姓，Buke，或“武士之家”，是武士种姓的正式术语。从名义上来说，武士只是作为战士而存在。然而，实际上，到了江户时代后期，他们更接近于官僚阶层，其中大多数担任藩臣。除萨摩藩和人吉藩外，所有武士都必须居住在他们的城下町，甚至访问村庄也需要获得许可。这是由于德川幕府的偏执，因为他们担心叛乱或内战会推翻他们。武士本身基本上分为两个阶级：高级武士，如幕府的旗本，由收入超过 100 石的家庭组成，并担任高级官员；低级武士，主要担任大名的护卫和执法者。到了幕末时期，大多数低级别武士和一些高级武士都破产了，负债累累，入不敷出。{newline}{newline}优点：{newline}根据氏族等级赚取每日津贴{newline}指挥个人随从的权利（氏族等级和管家的队伍规模+50%）{newline}{newline}限制：{newline}不能从事商业（没有车间或大篷车）

canonical_source: You accompanied a merchant as his apprentice, learning his trade and acquiring the skills of a good salesman. After an adolescence spent between markets and warehouses, you learnt the secrets of bargaining and commerce.
current_cn: 你作为一名商人的学徒陪伴他，学习他的生意并获得一名优秀推销员的技能。在市场和仓库之间度过了青春期之后，你学会了讨价还价和商业的秘密。

canonical_source: Growing up, you spent most of your time...
current_cn: 成长的过程中，你大部分的时间都花在...
为当事人提供经济帮助

canonical_source: The most deadly of all duels are Shinken-Shobu, 'win-lose by real sword,' which are duels to the death. These are usually illegal, and the government only allows them under strict circumstances: a legal vendetta, the orders of a lord, or to right an honorable wrong. These reflect greatly upon our dojo, so none but those who have reached the rank of Menkyo-Kaiden may fight them.
current_cn: 所有决斗中最致命的招式是 真剑胜负，即“以真剑胜负”，即生死决斗。这些通常是非法的，政府只在严格的情况下允许它们：合法的仇杀、领主的命令或纠正光荣的错误。这些对我们的道场影响很大，所以除了那些达到免许皆传等级的人之外，没有人可以与他们战斗。

canonical_source: {ISSUEGIVER.LINK}, a merchant from {SETTLEMENT}, has told you about {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} recent problems with shishi radicals. {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}She{?}he{\\?} asked you to guard {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} foreign guest for a while and deal with any attackers. In return {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} offered you {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} for each day your troops spend on escort duty.{newline}You agreed to lend {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}her{?}him{\\?} {NEEDED_MEN_COUNT} men. They should be enough to turn away most of the radicals. Your troops should return after {RETURN_DAYS} days.
current_cn: 来自{SETTLEMENT}的商人{ISSUEGIVER.LINK}向您讲述了{?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?}最近的尊攘激进派的问题。 {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?}要求你暂时看守{?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?}外宾并处理任何袭击者。作为回报，{?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 为您的部队每天护送任务提供 {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON}。{newline}您同意借出 {?ISSUEGIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他{\\?} {NEEDED_MEN_COUNT} 人员。它们应该足以赶走大多数激进分子。你的部队应该在 {RETURN_DAYS} 天后返回。

canonical_source: Sets the number of Napoleon Guns you have in custom battles
current_cn: 设置你在自定义战斗中拥有的拿破仑枪的数量

canonical_source: I want to speak with a prisoner.

A Nanao, the stronghold of the Hatakeyama clan, is one of the most important castle towns along the Noto Peninsula. Surrounded by mountains and the sea, its defenses are strong, and its harbor allows for active maritime trade.
current_cn: 七尾是畠山氏的据点，是能登半岛最重要的城下町之一。依山傍海，防御坚固，港口贸易活跃。

canonical_source: Sorry, I have to do it.
At any rate, I'll fight for any man willing to take the same risks that his men face.
current_cn: 无论如何，我会为任何愿意承担与他的手下所面临的同样风险的人而战。

canonical_source: Te-awase, or 'linking hands,' is simple sparring within the dojo. Through these, students may improve themselves without fear.
current_cn: 手合（手拉手）是道场内的简单的切磋。通过这些，学生可以无所畏惧地提高自己。

canonical_source: You have returned. Your bearing has changed—you have not neglected your training.[if:convo_concentration]
current_cn: 你回来了。你的态度已经改变——你并没有忽视你的训练。[if:convo_concentration]

canonical_source: Here in the {CURRENT_RYUHA}, we practice {ARTS}, as handed down in the tradition of {SCHOOL}. {SCROLLS}
current_cn: 在{CURRENT_RYUHA}这里，我们实践{ARTS}，正如{SCHOOL}的传统所传承的那样。 {SCROLLS}

canonical_source: Ogasawara-ryu is the classical school of mounted archery and etiquette, teaching yumi mastery on horseback. Practitioners develop poise, precision, and ceremonial bearing, serving as both martial and noble instructors in the late Tokugawa period.
current_cn: 小笠原流是马术射箭和礼仪的古典流派，在马背上教授弓技巧。练习者培养沉着、精确和礼仪举止，在德川后期担任武术和贵族导师。

canonical_source: What weapon will you be using?

Your father was a prominent rice trader whose warehouses and counting houses stood at the heart of a bustling castle town. In an age when rice was the very measure of wealth, his keen eye for markets and relentless bargaining brought the family immense prosperity—indeed, far greater wealth than that possessed by most samurai. Though officially beneath the buke, your household enjoyed comforts that many samurai could only envy.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位著名的大米商人，他的仓库和账房位于繁华的城下町的中心。在一个以大米为财富衡量标准的时代，他对市场的敏锐洞察力和不懈的讨价还价为家族带来了巨大的繁荣——事实上，比大多数武士所拥有的财富要多得多。尽管正式属于武士，但您的家人却享受着许多武士只能羡慕的舒适。

canonical_source: For that scroll, it's customary to give a gift of {COST} {GOLD_ICON}
current_cn: 对于该卷轴，通常会赠送 {COST} {GOLD_ICON} 的礼物

canonical_source: This town has laws about unauthorized trade. Turn over the guns to me now.
current_cn: 这个镇有关于未经授权的贸易的法律。现在把枪交给我。

canonical_source: Not that I can think of. But if you don't want to do it, you can nominate someone from your party. It's not going to be easy, though. Whoever you name should be a good leader and have a good knowledge of tactics, and should take along at least {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_NEEDED_MAN_COUNT} men. I'm ready to pay {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for your service. And if it comes to a fight, you can take whatever loot you want as spoils of war.[if:convo_thinking]
current_cn: 我想不到。但如果您不想这样做，您可以提名您所在政党的某人。但这并不容易。无论您指定的人是谁，都应该是一位优秀的领导者，并且具有丰富的战术知识，并且应该至少带领 {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_NEEDED_MAN_COUNT} 人。我已准备好为您的服务支付 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 费用。如果发生战斗，你可以拿走任何你想要的战利品作为战利品。[if:convo_thinking]

canonical_source: The merchant you are protecting is ambushed by shishi radicals!
current_cn: 你所保护的商人遭到了狮狮激进分子的伏击！

canonical_source: Cannons weren't just used to siege fortresses anymore in the 19th century. Every modern military would field a battery of artillery, and heavy guns were worth their weight in gold in Bakumatsu era Japan. Pieces of field artillery can be purchased from {FOREIGN_MERCHANTS_LINK}, but are very expensive and very heavy, meaning that too many cannons will bankrupt even an endgame player and slow the party's progress to a crawl. To use these pieces in battle, you must have artillerist troops, marked by a cannon icon on their unit. You can only have 1 artillerist for every 10 men in your army, and can deploy a number of pieces equal to half your artillerists. These guns also start in your reserves when you start a siege, and will not be lost even if the deployed versions are destroyed.{newline}{newline}Artillery can be deployed while pressing K during the deployment phase
current_cn: 到了19世纪，火炮早已不只用于攻城。任何近代军队都会编制炮兵，而在幕末日本，重炮更是价值极高的军备。玩家可以从{FOREIGN_MERCHANTS_LINK}处购买野战炮，但其价格昂贵、重量也很大；携带过多火炮不仅会耗尽资金，还会严重拖慢队伍。战斗中使用火炮需要炮兵单位，其兵种图标带有火炮标记。军队中每10人最多配置1名炮兵，可部署的火炮数量最多为炮兵人数的一半。攻城开始时，火炮会从预备队中部署；即使战场上的炮位被摧毁，也不会永久损失对应装备。{newline}{newline}部署阶段按K键可布置火炮。

canonical_source: Kōfu, a castle town in the heart of Kai Province in the southern part of the Tōsan region, has been the home of the Takena clan since its beginnings, but has only recently grown considerably thanks to Takeda Shingen, who has made it the centre of his expanding domain and undertaken major flood control projects to increase agricultural production and quality of life
current_cn: 甲府是东山地区南部甲斐国腹地的一座城下町，自武田氏兴起以来一直是其根据地，但直到武田信玄将其作为不断扩张的藩中心，并实施重大治水工程以提高农业产量和生活质量后，这里才得到显著发展。

canonical_source: Very well. Don't worry, all your expenses will be covered.
current_cn: 很好。不用担心，您的所有费用都会得到补偿。

canonical_source: The merchant is traveling between ports, and you do not have enough ships to follow. Your agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} was canceled and they have paid you for the merchant's progress.
current_cn: 商人正在港口之间航行，而你没有足够的船只可以跟随。您与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的协议已取消，他们已向您支付商家进度费用。

canonical_source: Return to your dojo to rankup
current_cn: 返回你的道场进行排名

canonical_source: Iwami is famed for its rich silver mines, which have made it one of the most valuable settlements in Japan. The most powerful daimyos of the region have long battled for control of the Iwami ginzan, which has most recently fallen to the Mōri clan.
current_cn: 石见以其丰富的银矿而闻名，这使其成为日本最有价值的定居点之一。该地区最强大的大名长期以来一直在争夺石见银山的控制权，该地区最近落入毛利氏族之手。

canonical_source: You issued a decree to remove the restrictions on the sale of firearms, as the merchants had requested.
current_cn: 按照商人的要求，您发布了一项法令，取消了对枪支销售的限制。

canonical_source: From now on, you are one of us.[ib:warrior][rf:convo_focused_happy]
current_cn: 从现在开始，你就是我们中的一员了.[ib:warrior][rf:convo_focused_happy]

canonical_source: Still, it was impossible not to notice the country changing. Every road carried more soldiers than merchants. Every castle wanted rifles, powder, or foreign books. Men who smiled at one another in spring refused to speak by autumn.
current_cn: 尽管如此，我们还是不可能不注意到这个国家的变化。每条道路承载的士兵都多于商人。每个城堡都需要步枪、火药或外国书籍。春天里相视一笑的人们，到了秋天就不再说话了。

canonical_source: A small but strategically located settlement, Uchi serves as a waypoint for travelers and merchants moving through its province. The town’s location makes it valuable to any daimyo seeking control over the surrounding region.
current_cn: 内奇是一个规模虽小但地理位置优越的定居点，是穿越该省的旅行者和商人的中转站。该镇的地理位置对于任何寻求控制周边地区的大名来说都很有价值。

canonical_source: Takashima-ryu teaches modern firearms techniques, emphasizing disciplined firing methods and unit coordination. Practitioners prepared for the changing nature of war during the Bakumatsu period, integrating Western rifles into traditional martial education for domain forces.
current_cn: 高岛流教授现代枪械技术，强调纪律严明的射击方法和单位协调。练习者为幕末时期战争性质的变化做好准备，将西方步枪融入藩部队的传统武术教育中。

canonical_source: Nanbu-ryu is a mounted martial school emphasizing bow and sword techniques. Practitioners develop horseback combat skills, coordination, and precision. In the Bakumatsu period, Nanbu-ryu kenshi served as cavalry instructors and domain retainers.
current_cn: 南部流是一所强调弓箭和剑术的骑马武术流派。练习者培养马术格斗技巧、协调性和精确度。幕末时期，南部流剑士担任骑兵教官和藩士。

canonical_source: You have left {QUEST_GIVER_FACTION}. Your agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} is terminated.
current_cn: 您已离开 {QUEST_GIVER_FACTION}。您与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的协议终止。

canonical_source: I wish hold a Te-awase practice match. I want to practice my technique and timing.
current_cn: 我希望举办一场手合练习赛。我想练习我的技术和时机。

canonical_source: Good. We need them as soon as possible.
current_cn: 好的。我们尽快需要它们。

canonical_source: If there is something else, ask it plainly.
current_cn: 如果还有什么事情，就直白的问吧。

canonical_source: Our student has claimed victory. This outcome reaffirms the superiority of our training and the rigor of our discipline.
current_cn: 我们的学生宣布胜利。这一结果再次证明了我们训练的优越性和纪律的严格性。

canonical_source: Hirosaki, perched near the northern tip of Honshu, is defined as much by its rivalry with Morioka as by its own lands. The Tsugaru clan governs fertile plains crossed by rivers, supporting villages and castle towns that thrive despite the harsh climate. Its samurai are fewer than Morioka's but disciplined, and the domain often shifts alliances to avoid being dominated by neighbors. Festivals, shrines, and the rhythms of local life give Hirosaki a cultural identity distinct from its northern rivals.
current_cn: 弘前市位于本州北端附近，其与盛冈的竞争和其自己的土地一样重要。津轻氏统治着河流穿过的肥沃平原，支持着尽管气候恶劣但仍蓬勃发展的村庄和城下町。它的武士数量比盛冈的武士少，但纪律严明，而且该藩经常改变联盟以避免被邻国统治。节日、神社和当地生活节奏赋予弘前不同于北方竞争对手的文化特征。

canonical_source: What? That's a breach of contract. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} will certainly hear about this...[if:convo_grave][ib:aggressive]
current_cn: 什么？这就是违约行为。 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 肯定会听说这个...[if:convo_grave][ib:aggressive]

canonical_source: Maybe. What do you need exactly?
{QUEST_GIVER.LINK} has left {KINGDOM}. Your agreement with {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}him{\\?} has been canceled.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 已离开 {KINGDOM}。您与 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他{\\?} 的协议已取消。

canonical_source: Count my troops. Then count yours. You have no chance.
current_cn: 清点我的兵力。然后数一下你的。你没有机会。

canonical_source: We transmit our teachings through a single mokuroku scroll.
current_cn: 我们通过一个目録卷轴来传播我们的教义。

canonical_source: You aren't from a high enough social class to enter a lord's hall.
current_cn: 你的社会阶层还不够高，无法进入领主的大厅。

canonical_source: Master, I have finished all the scrolls of this school. There is nothing left unseen. If you deem me worthy, I ask to receive Menkyo-Kaiden.
current_cn: 主人，我已经完成了这个流派的所有卷轴。没有什么是看不见的。如果你认为我值得，我请求接受免许会。

canonical_source: Upgrade to {UPGRADE_TARGET}{newline}You have too many artillerists
current_cn: 升级到{UPGRADE_TARGET}{newline}你的炮兵太多了

canonical_source: I'll deliver {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} Geweer muskets as soon as possible {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}lady{?}sir{\\?}, and try to find some Minieru and cartridges as you requested.
current_cn: 我会尽快交付{SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} 蓋貝爾槍步枪{?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\\?}，并按照您的要求尽力找到一些米涅步枪和弹药筒。

canonical_source: Shinshin-ryu is a kenjutsu school teaching katana and wakizashi techniques with an emphasis on timing and adaptability. Practitioners excel in duels and personal defense, maintaining a respected position among samurai in the late Bakumatsu.
current_cn: 神心流 是一所剑术流派，教授武士刀和胁差技术，强调时机和适应性。练习者擅长决斗和个人防御，在幕末末期的武士中保持着受人尊敬的地位。

canonical_source: Yes... As you know, this realm is deeply divided between the Imperial and Shogunate cause. Despite the stance taken by the great lords, many of our lower retainers hold an opposing stance. A few of us, myself included, wish to take a stronger stance. I don't know how we will end up acting, but rumors of it have gotten out in my district, and many of the kachi are growing restless. Now, most of us are doing their part to keep a lid on things. But there's one, {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}, who I am ashamed to say was once a {TOP_TIER_CAV_TITLE} under my banner, who's been going around the countryside, stirring up trouble. He's gathered a following and they have a whole list of demands, including a requirement that our domain take a {OPP_STANCE} stance. I'd take care of him myself, but that would imply I can't control my own men. Maybe you can help?[if:convo_thinking][ib:closed2]
current_cn: 是的……如你所知，这个藩在帝国和幕府之间有着深刻的分歧。尽管各大领主都采取了立场，但我们的许多下级家臣却持反对立场。我们中的一些人，包括我自己，希望采取更强硬的立场。我不知道我们最终会如何行动，但有关此事的谣言已经在我的地区流传开来，许多卡奇人变得焦躁不安。现在，我们大多数人都在尽自己的一份力量来控制事情的发展。但有一个{MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}，说来惭愧，他曾经是我旗下的{TOP_TIER_CAV_TITLE}，一直在乡下闹事。他聚集了一批追随者，他们提出了一整套要求，包括要求我们的藩采取 {OPP_STANCE} 立场。我会亲自照顾他，但这意味着我无法控制自己的手下。也许你能帮忙？[if:convo_thinking][ib:closed2]
幕末开国以后，在日西方人并不属于日本原有的身分制度。随着通商口岸开放和条约体系建立，外国旅行者、商人与技术人员大量进入日本；其中一些成功的商人，尤其是军火商，与各藩和幕府建立了密切关系，取得了相当优越的社会地位，个别人甚至获赐日本名号或家纹。{newline}{newline}优点：无{newline}{newline}限制：不可作为玩家初始身分

canonical_source: Please tell me of your school

Jigen-ryu, originating in Satsuma, is known for ferocious, lightning-fast attacks with katana and odachi. Practitioners cultivate power, speed, and relentless offense. In the late Bakumatsu, Jigen-ryu kenshi were recognized for their role in domain defense and martial competitions, embodying the martial spirit of southern Japan.
current_cn: 示现流起源于萨摩，以使用武士刀和大刀进行凶猛、闪电般的攻击而闻名。练习者培养力量、速度和无情的进攻。幕末末期，示现流剑士因其在藩防卫和武术比试中的作用而受到认可，体现了日本南部的武术精神。

canonical_source: You showed courage, yet your form faltered in key moments. Take this to heart, and refine your movements in preparation for the next encounter.
current_cn: 你表现出了勇气，但在关键时刻你的状态却出现了动摇。牢记这一点，并完善你的动作，为下一次遭遇做好准备。

canonical_source: Yes commander, I have brought your Geweer as you requested.
current_cn: 是的，指挥官，我已经按照您的要求带来了您的蓋貝爾槍。

canonical_source: Now that I will receive your training, I swear that without your permission. I will not demonstrate nor instruct, not even the most minor detail to anyone, not even to my own family. Should I behave in a way as to break this pledge, I am resolved to face the punishments of all the gods of the country, and to receive the anger of the great martial deity Hachiman.[ib:warrior][if:convo_concentration]
current_cn: 现在我要接受你的训练，我发誓不经你的允许。我不会向任何人展示或指导，即使是最微小的细节，甚至不会向我自己的家人展示。如果我做出违背誓言的行为，我决心面对国家诸神的惩罚，并接受伟大武神八幡的愤怒。[ib:warrior][if:convo_concentration]

canonical_source: In due time. Let's not be too hasty here.
current_cn: 在适当的时候。我们不要太仓促。

canonical_source: You spent the days of your adolescence working in the fields of a farm, in a job that was far from exciting but nevertheless necessary. The years spent working the land under the sun or transporting the harvest made you much stronger and more accustomed to handling farm tools.
current_cn: 你的青春期是在农场里度过的，这份工作一点也不令人兴奋，但却是必要的。多年在阳光下耕种土地或运输收获物使你变得更强壮，更习惯于操作农具。
实木真影流九里之卷目録

canonical_source: The Shinchōgumi are a Bakumatsu policing corps formed by the shogunate in Edo, composed mainly of loyalist rōnin tasked with patrols, guard duty, and keeping order in the capital as tensions with imperial forces grow. In 1864, they fell under the command of Shonai-han
current_cn: 新徴組是江户幕府组建的幕末警察部队，主要由忠诚的浪人组成，负责巡逻、守卫并在与帝国军队的紧张关系加剧时维持首都的秩序。 1864年，他们落入庄内藩的指挥之下。

canonical_source: Master, I have completed the teachings of the most recent scroll. I ask to be tested and have my Mokuroku advanced.
current_cn: 师父，我已经完成了最新一卷的教法。我要求进行测试并让我的 目録 升级。

canonical_source: Originally the seat of the namesake clan, Ota is a castle town in Kantō in close proximity to the vital Tōkaidō road, which connects the region to the capital Kyoto, making it an important military and administrative center.
current_cn: 大田原本是同名氏族的所在地，是关东的一座城下町，紧邻连接该地区与首都京都的重要东海道道路，使其成为重要的军事和行政中心。

canonical_source: Perhaps, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, it was a mistake? If you were to relinquish the goods, it would avoid a situation that might appear, well, a bit unseemly.
current_cn: 也许，我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}，这是一个错误？如果你放弃货物，就可以避免出现可能看起来有点不体面的情况。

canonical_source: As a student of {SCHOOL}, you must reach a certain level of proficiency before the school will consider passing along their secret arts to you.
current_cn: 作为{SCHOOL}的学生，你必须达到一定的熟练程度，流派才会考虑将他们的秘术传授给你。

canonical_source: The merchant was killed. Quest failed.

Well-positioned between coastal trade routes and mountain strongholds of western Kyushu, Kumamoto has enjoyed steady growth thanks to the flow of trade and local production that made it a thriving and well-defended castle town.
current_cn: 熊本位于沿海贸易路线和九州西部山地要塞之间，地理位置优越，贸易流通和当地生产使其成为一个繁荣且防御严密的城下町，一直保持着稳定的增长。

canonical_source: I move more than most in these markets, yet my purse stays thin. Some trades are tied by law, others by who watches the coin. The goods that could change fortunes must sometimes find their way quietly, to the right hands, or they gather dust.[if:convo_annoyed]
current_cn: 我在这些市场上的移动次数比大多数人都多，但我的钱包却很薄弱。有些交易受法律约束，另一些则受监管者约束。能够改变命运的货物有时必须悄悄地到达正确的人手中，否则就会积满灰尘。[if:convo_annoyed]

canonical_source: Ah, you have come. You must be weary from the road. Let us speak at ease today.[if:convo_pleased]
current_cn: 啊，你来了。你一定很累了。今天我们就轻松聊聊吧.[if:convo_pleased]

canonical_source: Itto-ryu is a prestigious family of kenjutsu schools emphasizing the principle of the 'one sword.' Practitioners, known as Itto-ryu kenshi, focus on decisive cuts, proper distancing, and timing. During the late Bakumatsu, its instructors were sought after by domains and samurai for dueling, military training, and personal defense.
current_cn: 一刀流是著名的剑术流派体系，强调“一刀”之理。修习者称为一刀流剑士，注重果断斩击、适当距离与时机。幕末时期，一刀流教习受到各藩和武士的追捧，用于决斗、军事训练和个人防卫。

canonical_source: Settlements with this culture gain loyalty faster.
current_cn: 具有这种文化的定居点可以更快地获得忠诚度。

canonical_source: The caravan was destroyed despite your companion's efforts. Quest failed.
current_cn: 尽管你的同伴竭尽全力，商队还是被摧毁了。任务失败。

canonical_source: Conflict is inevitable against those who march under the Shogun's Banner.
current_cn: 对于那些在将军旗帜下游行的人来说，冲突是不可避免的。

canonical_source: It's good to see you again, sister.
current_cn: 很高兴再次见到你，姐姐。

canonical_source: It's good to see you again, brother.
current_cn: 很高兴再次见到你，兄弟。

canonical_source: Greetings. This caravan is under the protection of Her Majesty, Queen Victoria of the United Kingdom of Great Britain and Ireland, and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we assist you?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。该商队受到大不列颠及爱尔兰联合藩国维多利亚女王陛下的保护，并由 {SETTLEMENT} 的 {MERCHANT.LINK} 担保。我们可以如何帮助您？[if:convo_normal]

canonical_source: Sunpu has served as the seat of the powerful Imagawa clan for decades, during which the castle town has flourished as a center of governance, trade and culture, benefiting from its location along the strategic Tōkaidō road. However, the Imagawa’s power has declined significantly since their crushing defeat at the hands of Oda Nobunaga exposing Sunpu and other Imagawa domains to the thirst for conquest of neighbouring lords.
current_cn: 几十年来，骏府一直是强大的今川氏族的所在地，在此期间，这座城下町得益于其战略性的东海道道路的地理位置，作为治理、贸易和文化中心而蓬勃发展。然而，自从被织田信长惨败之后，今川的实力已显着下降，使得骏府和其他今川藩面临着征服邻国领主的渴望。

canonical_source: A Odawara, the stronghold of the powerful Hojo clan, stands as an impregnable fortress in the Kanto region. With its vast network of walls, moats, and outlying fortifications, it is considered one of the most well-defended castles in Japan. The city below is a thriving center of trade, with merchants, farmers, and artisans benefiting from Hojo governance. Odawara’s strategic location allows the Hojo to control access to eastern Japan, ensuring their dominance over the region.
current_cn: 小田原是北条氏的据点，是关东地区坚不可摧的堡垒。凭借其庞大的城墙、护城河和外围防御工事网络，它被认为是日本防守最严密的城堡之一。下面的城市是一个繁荣的贸易中心，商人、农民和工匠都受益于北条的统治。小田原的战略位置使北条氏族能够控制进入日本东部的通道，确保他们对该地区的统治地位。

canonical_source: Recruiting lords to armies costs 30% less influence.
current_cn: 招募领主加入军队的影响力降低 30%。

canonical_source: We need {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} Geweer muskets to meet our basic needs. And if you can find {RIFLE_AMOUNT} Minieru or Geberu and {CARTRIDGE_AMOUNT} of ammunition, that would be a great favor. Better weapons are a great advantage.
current_cn: 我们需要 {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT}蓋貝爾槍步枪来满足我们的基本需求。如果你能找到 {RIFLE_AMOUNT} 米涅步枪 或 恩菲爾德步槍 和 {CARTRIDGE_AMOUNT} 弹药，那将是一个很大的帮助。更好的武器是一个很大的优势。

canonical_source: Everyone complains about Edo until bandits appear on the road.
current_cn: 每个人都抱怨江户，直到路上出现强盗。

canonical_source: Our teachings are preserved across {COUNT} mokuroku scrolls.
current_cn: 我们的教义被保存在 {COUNT} 目録 卷轴中。

canonical_source: Have you brought {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}rifles{?}rifle{\\?}{.%}? I have a fat purse of {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for you as promised.
current_cn: 你带了 {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}步枪{?}步枪{\\?}{.%} 了吗？正如我所承诺的，我有一个 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 的大钱包给你。

canonical_source: I have more important business to do.
current_cn: 我还有更重要的事情要做。

canonical_source: Tamiya-ryu focuses on the long-hilted nagae katana, training practitioners in precise strikes and extended reach. The school's methods were valued for dueling and defensive combat by samurai in the late Bakumatsu era.
current_cn: 田宫流专注于长柄长武士刀，训练练习者精确打击和延伸范围。该流派的方法在幕末时代后期的武士的决斗和防御战斗中受到重视。

canonical_source: Yonkin-sanpo (Canon de Montagne de 4 La Hitte)
current_cn: 四斤山炮（4磅拉希特山炮）

canonical_source: As a youngster growing up in Japan, war was far away. You...
current_cn: 作为在日本长大的年轻人，战争离我们很遥远。你...

canonical_source: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK}, a merchant from {SETTLEMENT}, has told you about {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} recent problems with shishi radicals. {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} asked you to guard {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} foreign guest for a while and deal with any attackers.
