In return {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} offered you {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} denars for each day you spend on escort duty.{newline}You have agreed to guard him yourself until he visits {NUMBER_OF_SETTLEMENTS} settlements.
current_cn: 来自{SETTLEMENT}的商人{ISSUE_GIVER.LINK}向您讲述了{?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?}最近的尊攘激进派的问题。 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?}要求你暂时看守{?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?}外宾并处理任何袭击者。作为回报，{?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 为您每天执行护送任务提供 {GOLD}{GOLD_ICON} 第纳尔。{newline}您已同意亲自看守他，直到他访问 {NUMBER_OF_SETTLEMENTS} 定居点。

canonical_source: Very good! Here is your money. Thank you.[if:convo_grateful]
current_cn: 非常好！这是你的钱。谢谢.[if:convo_grateful]

canonical_source: The dojo appears to be half-abandoned and scarcely visited by local inhabitants, showing how unknown the martial school is.
current_cn: 道场似乎已经半废弃，当地居民也很少参观，可见这所武术流派是多么不为人知。

canonical_source: Is there any other way to solve this problem?
current_cn: 还有其他方法可以解决这个问题吗？

canonical_source: So, it is you. You are not welcome here. Any foolishness, and I will answer in the name of the school.[ib:warrior][if:convo_displeased]
current_cn: 那么，就是你了。这里不欢迎你。任何愚蠢的行为，我都会以流派的名义回答。[ib:warrior][if:convo_displeased]

canonical_source: A rifled breech-loading cannon of British manufacture, noted for its accuracy and extended range. Suited to siege, coastal, and fixed defensive positions.
current_cn: 英国制造的一种线膛后装火炮，以其精确度和射程大而闻名。适用于攻城、沿海、固定防御阵地。

canonical_source: Are you sure you wish to proceed?
I will be wielding the sword.
A hand-cranked battery gun capable of sustained, rapid fire. Intended for crew service in field and fortress defense.
current_cn: 一种能够持续快速射击的手摇电池枪。适用于野战和堡垒防御中的船员服务。

canonical_source: A light rifled cannon designed for transport by pack animals in difficult terrain. Employed to provide mobile artillery support to infantry in mountainous regions.
current_cn: 一种轻型线膛炮，专为驮畜在困难地形中运输而设计。用于为山区步兵提供机动火炮支援。

canonical_source: Thank you. Your service will be remembered.
current_cn: 谢谢。您的服务将被记住。

canonical_source: Ushiki is a castle town in eastern Kyushu built by the Daimyo Ōtomo Sōrin as the main base for his expanding domain. Located on what is virtually an island connected to the rest of Kyushu only during low tides, Ushiki dominates the eponymous bay.
current_cn: 牛城是九州东部的一座城下町，由大名大友宗凛建造，作为其扩张藩的主要基地。牛木位于一个几乎只有在退潮时才与九州其他地区相连的岛屿上，占据着同名海湾的主导地位。

canonical_source: Your father was a ranking domain samurai in the service of his daimyo. Stationed in the castle town, he spent most of his time working in the bureaucracy, alongside regular martial training.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位为他的大名服务的等级藩士。他驻扎在城下町，大部分时间都在官僚机构工作，同时也定期进行武术训练。

canonical_source: Hoki-ryu is a kenjutsu school specializing in katana techniques. Practitioners cultivate strong cutting, timing, and defensive skills. During the Bakumatsu, Hoki-ryu instructors trained samurai and domain forces, ensuring readiness in duels and military engagements.
current_cn: 伯耆流 是一所专门研究武士刀技术的剑术流派。练习者培养强大的切入、时机和防守技能。幕末时期，伯耆流教官训练武士和藩军，确保决斗和军事交战做好准备。

canonical_source: I served with a patrol force outside Osaka. We escorted tax shipments, guarded roads, and kept hot-headed young samurai from turning every argument into a blood feud.
current_cn: 我在大阪郊外的一支巡逻队服役。我们护送税收货物，守卫道路，并阻止头脑发热的年轻武士将每一次争吵变成血海深仇。

canonical_source: I need you to deliver {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}{PLURAL(RIFLES)}{?}{RIFLES}{\?}{.%} to my contact {TARGET_HERO.LINK} in {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}. Keep it quiet—what we're moving isn't exactly welcome at the market. The town's authorities and merchants might sniff around, but as long as it reaches him intact, that's all that matters.
current_cn: 我需要您将 {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}{PLURAL(RIFLES)}{?}{RIFLES}{\?}{.%} 交给我在 {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} 的联系人 {TARGET_HERO.LINK}。保持安静——我们正在开发的产品在市场上并不受欢迎。镇上的当局和商人可能会四处嗅探，但只要它完好无损地到达他手中，这才是最重要的。

canonical_source: 'And many thousand bodies lay a-rotting in the sun \n But things like that must be you know for kingdoms to be won'
current_cn: “成千上万的尸体在阳光下腐烂 但是你必须知道这样的事情才能赢得藩国”

canonical_source: A smoothbore bronze field gun valued for reliability and versatility. Capable of firing solid shot, shell, or canister in close and medium engagements.
current_cn: 一款具有可靠性和多功能性的滑膛青铜野战炮。能够在近距离和中型交战中发射实心弹、炮弹或霰弹。

canonical_source: I can take your “goods” to {TARGET_HERO.LINK} in {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} myself.
current_cn: 我可以亲自将您的“货物”带到{TARGET_SETTLEMENT}的{TARGET_HERO.LINK}。

canonical_source: I apologize, but I cannot betray my oaths.
current_cn: 我很抱歉，但我不能背叛我的誓言。

canonical_source: You refused to hand over the items. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} must be furious.
current_cn: 你拒绝交出物品。 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}一定很愤怒。
帝国即将卸任的劳工领袖

canonical_source: Your commission will be conveyed through the proper channels. You have my thanks.
current_cn: 您的佣金将通过适当的渠道传达。我对你表示感谢。

canonical_source: I feel good knowing that you're looking after the foreigner. Safe journeys, my friend!
current_cn: 知道你在照顾那个外国人，我感觉很好。旅途平安，我的朋友！

canonical_source: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK}, lord of {SETTLEMENT}, says that a {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE} named {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} is stirring up unrest in the countryside. You asked your companion to deal with {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}'s band. They should rejoin your party in {RETURN_DAYS} days
current_cn: {SETTLEMENT} 的领主 {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} 说，一个名为 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE} 正在乡村煽动骚乱。你让你的同伴来对付{MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}的乐队。他们应该在 {RETURN_DAYS} 天后重新加入您的队伍

canonical_source: Yes commander, I have brought your Geweer and cartridges as you requested.
current_cn: 是的，指挥官，我已经按照您的要求带来了您的蓋貝爾槍和弹药筒。

canonical_source: I understand. I'll hold off on the decree, then.
current_cn: 我明白。那我就暂缓执行法令吧。

canonical_source: I was also hoping to see what uniforms or military dress you handle, if any.
current_cn: 我还想看看你穿什么制服或军装（如果有的话）。

canonical_source: Thank you. {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} is always on the move, so finding him might be tricky. But don't worry, I get regular reports from the landowners around here and I'll keep you updated on his movements...[if:convo_undecided_closed]
current_cn: 谢谢。 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 总是在移动，所以找到他可能很棘手。但别担心，我会定期收到附近土地所有者的报告，我会随时向您通报他的最新动向……[if:convo_undecided_closed]

canonical_source: Chōshū occupies the western tip of Honshu, with rugged mountains and jagged coasts that have long shaped the character of its people. The Mōri clan has ruled here for generations, cultivating a culture of fierce independence and hatred of the Shogunate. Samurai from Chōshū are known for their sharp swords, quick thinking, and readiness to defy authority when necessary. In recent years, Choshu has emerged as a hotbed of political action, containing many of the most radical ishin shishi in Japan.
current_cn: 长州岛位于本州岛的西端，崎岖的山脉和锯齿状的海岸长期以来塑造了该州人民的性格。毛利氏族世代统治这里，培育了强烈的独立和仇恨幕府的文化。长州武士以其锋利的刀剑、敏捷的思维以及在必要时随时准备反抗权威而闻名。近年来，长州已成为政治行动的温床，这里聚集了许多日本最激进的维新志士。

canonical_source: Hiroshima Domain sprawls across the fertile delta of the Ota River, with the castle town at its center serving as both administrative hub and cultural heart. The Asano clan has ruled here for generations, known for disciplined samurai and a stable, well-organized administration. The domain has long fostered artisans, merchants, and schools, giving it a reputation for both martial and cultural refinement. Politically, Hiroshima maintains a careful balance: its samurai enforce order and support the shogunate when called upon, but the radicals of Choshu force them further towards the sonno-joi side.
current_cn: 广岛藩横跨太田河肥沃的三角洲，其中心的城下町既是行政中心，也是文化中心。浅野氏族世代统治这里，以纪律严明的武士和稳定、组织良好的政府而闻名。该藩长期以来培育了工匠、商人和流派，使其享有军事和文化精致的声誉。在政治上，广岛保持着谨慎的平衡：其武士执行命令并在需要时支持幕府，但长州的激进分子迫使他们进一步偏向园奴制一方。

canonical_source: One of the few Tozama daimyo to serve under the Shogunate, the Ikeda of Okayama domain are relatively sonno-joi, but still support the Shogunate. During the Boshin War, seeing the threat, the daimyo adopted a more pro-imperial successor and retired, so as to allow the domain to take the winning side without violating his own beliefs. While the domain itself avoided joining the war, many units formed in the domain would go fight in the north.
current_cn: 冈山藩的池田是为数不多的在幕府统治下任职的外样大名之一，虽然相对尊王，但仍然支持幕府。戊辰战争期间，大名看到威胁，选择了更尊王的继任者并退休，以便让藩主在不违背自己信仰的情况下占据胜利的一方。虽然藩本身避免参战，但藩内组建的许多部队都会前往北方作战。

canonical_source: My lord has commanded a death, and I shall fulfill his order. I demand a Shinken-shobu
current_cn: 我主已下令处死，我将履行他的命令。我要一份真剑菖蒲

canonical_source: Built as the fortified seat of the Azai clan to rule over the surrounding region, the castle town of Odani sits atop a steep ridge, its defenses making it a formidable stronghold, while its position along key trade routes ensure the growing prosperity of the settlement.
current_cn: 城下町小谷是浅井氏族统治周边地区的要塞，坐落在陡峭的山脊上，其防御工事使其成为一个强大的据点，而其在主要贸易路线上的位置也确保了该定居点的日益繁荣。

canonical_source: As expected, my student prevails. This dojo's training endures and proves its strength.
current_cn: 正如所料，我的学生获胜了。这个道场的训练经久不衰，并证明了它的实力。

canonical_source: The Tozama are 'outside' lords who, although they submit to the Tokugawa after the decisive battles that establish shogunal supremacy, maintain control over large, semi-autonomous domains and wield considerable local power, wealth, and military strength, yet their political influence within the inner councils of the shogunate remains limited, forcing them to act cautiously and independently in matters of national importance. Their position allows them to preserve strong local authority and maintain sizable, loyal armies, making them capable of both defending their interests and exerting pressure when opportunities arise, but always under the shadow of Tokugawa oversight and exclusion from key decision-making.
current_cn: 户泽间氏是“外部”领主，尽管他们在确立幕府至高无上的决定性战役后臣服于德川，保持对大片半自治藩的控制，并掌握相当大的地方权力、财富和军事力量，但他们在幕府内部议会中的政治影响力仍然有限，迫使他们在国家重大事务上谨慎而独立地行事。他们的地位使他们能够保留强大的地方权威并维持规模庞大、忠诚的军队，使他们能够捍卫自己的利益并在机会出现时施加压力，但始终处于德川幕府的监督和排除在关键决策之外的阴影之下。

canonical_source: Ozu sits on the western coast of Shikoku, where rocky shores and sheltered bays shape both life and defense. The Katō clan governs a domain where fishing, salt production, and local trade sustain towns and samurai alike. Its castle overlooks the sea, a reminder of past conflicts and the domain's reliance on maritime knowledge. Ozu values prudence and order, blending coastal commerce with disciplined administration to maintain stability in a small but tightly organized domain.
current_cn: 大洲坐落在四国西海岸，岩石海岸和避风海湾塑造了这里的生活和防御。加藤氏族统治着一个以渔业、制盐和当地贸易为生的藩，城镇和武士都以渔业、盐业生产和当地贸易为生。它的城堡俯瞰着大海，提醒人们过去的冲突和该藩对航海知识的依赖。小津重视谨慎和秩序，将沿海商业与纪律严明的行政管理相结合，以维持一个小而组织严密的藩的稳定。

canonical_source: You've successfully achieved the rank of Mokuroku
current_cn: 您已成功达到目録等级
步兵装备 - 交叉带和背包

canonical_source: Heki-ryu is a classical archery school, teaching yumi mastery for battlefield and ceremonial use. Practitioners develop accuracy, composure, and situational awareness. In the late Bakumatsu, Heki-ryu archers served both militarily and ceremonially, maintaining the prominence of mounted and foot archery traditions.
current_cn: 日置流 是一所古典射箭流派，教授战场和仪式使用的射箭技巧。从业者可以培养准确性、冷静和态势感知能力。在幕末末期，日置流弓箭手在军事和仪式上服役，保持了骑马和步行射箭传统的地位。

canonical_source: A fellow student of the school I see, then. Different lines, but the same principles of the blade.[ib:warrior][if:convo_concentration]
current_cn: 那么看来你也是本门的同道。线路不同，但刀片原理相同.[ib:warrior][if:convo_concentration]

canonical_source: Kyoshin Meiichi-ryu is a kenjutsu school emphasizing katana and wakizashi mastery. Practitioners cultivate precise cutting, timing, and fluid technique. In the Bakumatsu era, Kyoshin Meiichi-ryu trained loyalists and aspiring samurai in practical swordsmanship for both duels and domain service.

Ishinomaki is a bustling coastal town in the southern part of the Ōu region that has grown as an important port for trade and fishing as Matsushima Bay provides natural protection and  the Kitakami River serves as a vital route for transporting goods inland. Although its strategic location has ensured its prosperity, it also makes it an important military target for the plans of expansion of the local clans.
current_cn: 石卷是奥羽地区南部的一个繁华的沿海城镇，由于松岛湾提供自然保护，而北上市河是内陆货物运输的重要路线，因此它已发展成为重要的贸易和渔业港口。虽然其战略位置保证了其繁荣，但也使其成为当地氏族扩张计划的重要军事目标。

canonical_source: Get out of my face, you vile beggar.[if:convo_angry]
current_cn: 从我面前滚出去，你这个卑鄙的乞丐.[if:convo_angry]

canonical_source: The Kinno-to are violent Imperialists, called terrorists by some. Drawn from the ranks of the Shishi, their cause combines fierce reverence for the throne with violent action, embracing assassination, agitation, and open rebellion.
current_cn: 金野人是暴力的帝国主义者，被一些人称为恐怖分子。他们出身于士师队伍，他们的事业将对王位的强烈崇敬与暴力行动结合在一起，包括暗杀、煽动和公开叛乱。

canonical_source: The farmer caste, Hyakusho, or 'Hundred Surnames', was the formal term applied to the peasant caste. Making up some 80% of Japan's population at the time, Hyakusho lived in their own small, self-governing villages. They obeyed the Daimyo's decrees as required, but every village was in essence an autonomous entity, which governed itself, enforced its own laws, and only interacted with samurai as was required. While legally forbidden from using their own last names on official documents, Hyakusho clans not only had their own last names, passed down to all members of a household, but often 'head names', passed down to each leader of the household in turn. As such, it was not uncommon for a son, upon succeeding his father, to take up his father's name in turn while the father took on a new name in his retirement. Historically speaking, there was no legal difference between Hyakusho and {CHONIN_LINK}. However, their roles were so different that they were often considered two different classes by philosophers of the time, a split also used in the mod.{newline}{newline}Pros: None{newline}{newline}Resistrictions:{newline}Cannot command personal retinue (-33% party size from clan tier and Steward){newline}Cannot engage in commerce (No workshops or caravans){newline}Must pay agricultural tax (50% of all income from owned fiefs goes to kingdom leader instead of own clan){newline}Cannot enter keep of towns and castles unless a vassal of the owner kingdom
current_cn: 农民种姓“Hyakusho”或“百姓”是适用于农民种姓的正式术语。当时百所人约占日本人口的 80%，他们居住在自己的小型自治村庄中。他们按要求服从大名的法令，但每个村庄本质上都是一个自治实体，进行自我管理，执行自己的法律，并且只根据需要与武士互动。虽然法律禁止在官方文件上使用自己的姓氏，但百所氏族不仅有自己的姓氏，传承给家庭的所有成员，而且通常还拥有“头名”，依次传承给家庭的每个首领。因此，儿子继承父亲的姓氏，而父亲退休后又使用新名字的情况并不少见。从历史上看，Hyakusho 和 {CHONIN_LINK} 之间没有法律差异。然而，他们的角色是如此不同，以至于当时的哲学家经常将他们视为两个不同的阶级，这种分裂也在mod中使用。{newline}{newline}优点：无{newline}{newline}限制：{newline}不能指挥私人随从（氏族层和管家的政党规模为-33％）{newline}不能从事商业（没有作坊或商队）{newline}必须缴纳农业税（所有收入的50％来自拥有的封地属于王国领袖而不是自己的氏族）{newline}不能进入城镇和城堡的要塞，除非是所有者王国的封臣

canonical_source: as a servant to a wealthy family.
current_cn: 作为一个富裕家庭的仆人。
恐吓男性帝国帮派头目

canonical_source: When my lord died, his heir dismissed half the household to save money. I kept my horse and my knowledge of the roads. Those have served me better than any official seal ever did.
current_cn: 当我的主人去世时，他的继承人为了省钱解雇了一半的家庭。我保留了我的马和我对道路的了解。这些对我来说比任何官方印章都更有用。

canonical_source: This is menkyo kaiden. There is nothing left for me to teach you, and the entire tradition is sealed within this scroll. From this day, you stand as a true inheritor of the lineage.
current_cn: 这是面镜凯传。我没有什么可以教你的了，整个传统都被封印在这卷轴里。从今天起，你就是这个血统的真正继承人了。

canonical_source: Ah, welcome. It has been some time. To receive one who serves our lord is always an honor.[ib:confident][if:convo_pleased]
current_cn: 啊，欢迎。已经有一段时间了。接待一位为我们的主服务的人始终是一种荣幸。[ib:confident][if:convo_pleased]

canonical_source: The dojo appears to be richly decorated and crowded with students from across the region, demonstrating the fame of this martial school.
current_cn: 道场看起来装饰华丽，挤满了来自各地的学生，足见这所武校的名气。

canonical_source: Situated along the windswept coastline of northern Honshu, Tzuchizaki‑Minato has long served as a crucial point for maritime trade and the transport of goods between the main islands and the northern provinces.
current_cn: 土崎港位于本州岛北部多风的海岸线，长期以来一直是主要岛屿和北部省份之间海上贸易和货物运输的关键点。

canonical_source: Amagiri is a fortified town on top of the namesake Mountain, built by the Kagawa Clan as its seat in the Northern part of Shikoku. Thanks to its strategically fortified location and access to the Inland Sea coast, Amagiri is an important centre for controlling the surrounding territory and trade routes.
current_cn: 天雾是一座位于同名山山顶的防御城镇，由香川氏族建造，作为四国北部的所在地。由于其战略要塞和通往内海沿岸的通道，天雾是控制周边领土和贸易路线的重要中心。

canonical_source: Perched on a prominent hill in northern Kyushu, Tachibanayama was originally built for its namesake Tachibana clan as a fortified town, whose control over the surrounding areas remains vital for securing key trade routes and access to both land and sea.
current_cn: 立花山坐落在九州北部的一座著名山丘上，最初是为其同名立花氏族建造的一座防御城镇，立花山对周边地区的控制对于确保主要贸易路线以及陆地和海上通道的安全至关重要。

canonical_source: We're paid to guard this caravan. If you want to rob it, it's going to be over our dead bodies![rf:idle_angry][ib:aggressive]
current_cn: 我们受雇来看守这支商队。如果你想抢的话，就从我们的尸体上抢吧！[rf:idle_angry][ib:aggressive]

canonical_source: These days everyone talks about restoring this or expelling that. Fine words. But when merchants are robbed and villages burn, it is still Tokugawa officials who restore order.
current_cn: 现在大家都在谈论恢复这个或驱逐那个。好话。但当商人被抢劫、村庄被烧毁时，恢复秩序的仍然是德川官员。

canonical_source: Yes, we know where he is. It's just a matter of time to catch them.
current_cn: 是的，我们知道他在哪里。抓住他们只是时间问题。

canonical_source: The Aizu Joshigun are groups of Aizu domain women who organized themselves during the Boshin War, taking on support roles and, in many cases, joining combat alongside the domain's remaining defenders.
current_cn: 会津上司军是由会津藩女性组成的团体，她们在戊辰战争期间组织起来，担任支援角色，并在许多情况下与该藩的剩余守军一起参加战斗。

canonical_source: My lord, it is a rare honor to address you within these walls. I await your direction.
current_cn: 陛下，能在这些墙内向您讲话是一种难得的荣幸。我等待你的指示。

canonical_source: I want to speak with a prisoner (Cheat).
current_cn: 我想和一个囚犯说话（作弊）。

canonical_source: Well, I can't just sit around and drink myself to death, so I sell my sword to anyone worth following. I'm a good trainer - I don't bother with horsemen or archers, but if you've got good steady footmen I can do a lot with them.
current_cn: 好吧，我不能只是坐在那里喝酒致死，所以我把我的剑卖给任何值得追随的人。我是一名优秀的训练师——我不介意骑兵或弓箭手，但如果你有优秀稳定的步兵，我可以用他们做很多事情。

canonical_source: Have you put a stop to {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE}{.s}?[if:convo_undecided_open]
You don't have enough money to buy this scroll
current_cn: 您没有足够的钱来购买此卷轴

canonical_source: Tatsumi-ryu is a comprehensive martial school training practitioners in katana, wakizashi, yari, naginata, and shuriken. The school's broad curriculum prepared samurai for dueling, battlefield, and self-defense during the Bakumatsu period.
current_cn: 辰巳流是一位综合武术流派，训练武士刀、胁差、枪、薙刀和手里剑的练习者。流派广泛的课程为幕末时期武士的决斗、战场和自卫做好准备。

canonical_source: Ah, you wish to understand our ranks. A student begins as an Keppan, to learn the basics of the art. Once they have achieved this, they will be granted a Mokuroku, a catalogue speaking of their relation to the school and the arts they have learned.
current_cn: 啊，你想了解我们的等级。学生从 血判 开始，学习技艺的基础知识。一旦他们实现了这一目标，他们将获得一份目録，这是一份讲述他们与流派和所学技艺的关系的目录。

canonical_source: Hozoin-ryu specializes in spearmanship, particularly the cross-shaped jumonji-yari and naginata. Practitioners train in precise thrusts, fluid footwork, and battlefield awareness. By the Bakumatsu era, instructors trained domain militias and dueling students, maintaining a reputation for technical elegance and deadly efficiency.
current_cn: 宝藏院流擅长枪术，特别是十字形十文字枪和薙刀。练习者训练精确的刺击、流畅的步法和战场意识。到了幕末时代，教官们训练着藩内民兵和决斗学生，保持着技术优雅和致命效率的声誉。

canonical_source: Change did not come to Japan all at once. From the opening of the country in 1853 to the Boshin War in 1868 and the Meiji period that followed, Japanese society underwent massive, but gradual, social, military, and economic reforms. Due to this, when the reform mechanic is enabled, not all troops are available from the start. Instead, better modern troops will gradually be unlocked over time either as the years pass or as the player's kingdom passes policies.
current_cn: 日本的变革并非一蹴而就。自1853年开国、1868年戊辰战争，再到其后的明治时期，日本社会在社会、军事与经济领域经历了规模巨大但循序渐进的改革。因此，启用改革机制后，并非所有兵种从开局即可使用；随着年代推进，或玩家所属势力通过相应政策，更先进的近代化兵种将逐步解锁。

canonical_source: Settlements with the same culture gain security 25% faster.
current_cn: 具有相同文化的定居点获得安全的速度要快 25%。

canonical_source: There is nobody inside to receive you right now.
current_cn: 现在里面没有人接待你。

canonical_source: So the rumors were true. You are the one spoken of so highly. This is my first time meeting you.[ib:normal][if:convo_pleased]
current_cn: 所以传闻是真的。你是被如此高度评价的人。这是我第一次见到你.[ib:normal][if:convo_pleased]

canonical_source: Once the great imperial capital of Japan, Nara remains a center of Buddhist influence and cultural heritage. The massive temples of Tōdaiji and Kōfukuji stand as reminders of its former glory, housing powerful monastic factions.
current_cn: 奈良曾经是日本伟大的皇都，现在仍然是佛教影响和文化遗产的中心。东大寺和兴福寺的巨大寺庙让人想起它昔日的辉煌，拥有强大的寺院派系。

canonical_source: Clans lose 1 influence per day{newline}Tax income in settlements are increased by 15%{newline}Each notable yields -.15 influence per day to the settlement's owner clan
current_cn: 部落每天失去 1 点影响力{newline}定居点的税收收入增加 15%{newline}每个显着收益每天对定居点所有者部落产生 -.15 影响力

canonical_source: If you aren't going towards {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}, maybe you could have some of your men take my goods and bring back the profit? It shouldn't take more than {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_MEN_AMOUNT} men and one of your trusted lieutenants with decent grasp of trade. They can go and be back in about {RETURN_DAYS} days.[if:convo_annoyed]
current_cn: 如果你不打算{TARGET_SETTLEMENT}，也许你可以让你的一些人拿走我的货物并带回利润？这只需要 {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_MEN_AMOUNT} 人和一位你信任的、对贸易有相当了解的副官就可以了。他们可以去并在大约 {RETURN_DAYS} 天后回来。[if:convo_annoyed]

canonical_source: You have protected the foreign merchant from {SETTLEMENT} as promised. He was happy with your work.
current_cn: 您已按照承诺保护外国商人免受 {SETTLEMENT} 的侵害。他对你的工作很满意。

canonical_source: you profited from the opening of the country.
current_cn: 你们从国家的开放中获益。

canonical_source: Nakamura, is a castle town in Western Shikoku. Surrounded by rivers and mountains, it enjoys a natural defensive advantage, benefitting from the fertile lands that produce rice and timber.
current_cn: 中村是四国西部的城下町。这里依山傍水，土地肥沃，出产水稻和木材，具有天然的防御优势。

canonical_source: Sometimes to avoid being oppressed, it is better to join the oppressors. You joined a local Yakuza gang, helping to administer and police the local markets, taking a hefty cut in the process, as well as acting as an enforcer against those who owed the gang money.
current_cn: 有时为了避免被压迫，还不如加入压迫者的行列。你加入了当地的一个黑帮，帮助管理和监管当地市场，在这个过程中获得大量报酬，并充当欠黑帮钱的人的执法者。
您好，{?PLAYER.GENDER}夫人{?}先生{\\?}。我可以帮你吗？

canonical_source: As a kid you loved going into the woods and mountains with the hunters from the village, observing them and learning their skills. After several years benefiting from their guidance and teaching, you eventually became an integral part of the group as a skilled hunter yourself.
current_cn: 当你还是个孩子的时候，你喜欢和村里的猎人一起进入树林和山脉，观察他们并学习他们的技能。经过几年受益于他们的指导和教导，您最终成为了团队中不可或缺的一部分，成为一名熟练的猎人。

canonical_source: I spent years riding between castle towns carrying my lord's messages. Most were dullΓÇötax records, supply requests, invitations to banquetsΓÇöbut now and then I was entrusted with letters sealed so tightly that men would kill to read them. I never broke a seal. I never asked questions. A messenger who lives long learns when not to be curious.
current_cn: 我花了数年时间在城堡城镇之间骑行，传递我领主的信息。大多数都是乏味的税务记录、供应请求、宴会邀请函，但有时我会被委托处理密封得如此严密的信件，以至于人们会为了阅读而杀人。我从来没有打破过封印。我从来没有问过问题。长寿的使者学会什么时候不好奇。

canonical_source: One of the most powerful tozama domains of the late Tokugawa period, the Satsuma Domain commands the southern tip of Kyushu with a proud samurai tradition and an eye toward modern reform. Governed by the Shimazu clan, Satsuma fields a disciplined military bolstered by imported Western firearms and artillery, alongside fiercely loyal retainers hardened by centuries of internal strife and external ambition. Though officially loyal to the shogunate, Satsuma grows increasingly defiant, backing the sonnō jōi movement while quietly forging alliances with other anti-Tokugawa domains. With its strong economy, built on barely legal trade through the Ryukyu Islands, and its modernizing army, the Satsuma-han is poised to play a decisive role in the struggle for Japan's future.
current_cn: 萨摩藩是德川末期最强大的户座藩之一，统治着九州南端，拥有自豪的武士传统和现代改革的目光。萨摩藩由岛津氏族统治，拥有一支纪律严明的军队，由进口的西方火器和火炮支撑，还有经过几个世纪的内乱和对外野心而变得坚强的忠诚的家臣。尽管表面上忠于幕府，萨摩藩却变得越来越目中无人，支持尊王攘夷运动，同时悄悄与其他反德川势力结盟。凭借其强大的经济（建立在琉球群岛几乎不合法的贸易基础上）和现代化的军队，萨摩藩准备在日本未来的斗争中发挥决定性作用。

canonical_source: By mutual resolve, the leaders of Satsuma and Choshu have entered into a secret pact to unite their strength in service of restoring Imperial authority. From this day forward, both domains stand as one in purpose against the rule of the shogunate.
current_cn: 通过共同的决心，萨摩和长州的领导人达成了一项秘密协议，以联合他们的力量来恢复帝国的权威。从今天起，这两个藩将成为一体，共同反对幕府的统治。

canonical_source: Sprawling across southern Tōhoku, Sendai has been shaped over generations by the Date clan. Rivers, plains, and rolling hills support large towns and productive farms, while fortified castles reflect the clan's long martial history. Sendai's culture values practical governance and education, and samurai numbers are substantial. Politically, the domain remains loyal to the shogunate, but the leadership watches events in the southwest closely, balancing caution with preparation for change.
current_cn: 仙台横跨东北南部，由伊达氏族几代人塑造而成。河流、平原和连绵起伏的丘陵支撑着大型城镇和多产的农场，而坚固的城堡则反映了该氏族悠久的军事历史。仙台的文化重视务实的治理和教育，武士人数众多。在政治上，该地区仍然忠于幕府，但领导层密切关注西南部的事态发展，在谨慎与为变革做好准备之间取得平衡。

canonical_source: Hokushin Itto-ryu is the northern branch of Itto-ryu, combining classical swordsmanship with battlefield practicality. Practitioners train in katana, wakizashi, and naginata, honing timing, distance, and decisive strikes. In the late Bakumatsu, the school supplied instructors to northern domain militias and duelists in Edo.
current_cn: 北辰一刀流是一刀流的北方分支，将古典剑术与战场实用性相结合。练习者们进行武士刀、胁差和薙刀的训练，磨练时机、距离和决定性的打击。幕末末期，流派为江户的北藩民兵和决斗者提供教官。

canonical_source: Moriuchi-ryu is a mounted martial school emphasizing yari and katana techniques. Practitioners develop coordination, balance, and tactical awareness for cavalry operations. In the Bakumatsu period, Moriuchi-ryu trained domain cavalry and retainers in practical combat skills.
current_cn: 森内流是一所骑马武术流派，强调枪术和剑术。练习者培养骑兵作战所需的协调性、平衡性和战术意识。幕末时期，森内流训练藩骑兵和家臣的实战技能。

canonical_source: Dominated by the temple fortress of Ishiyama Hongan-ji, Osaka has grown into a major center of religious and economic activity. The temple fortress, controlled by the militant Ikkō-ikki, serves as the stronghold of the Jōdo Shinshū sect, resisting the rule of samurai warlords.
current_cn: 以石山本愿寺寺庙堡垒为主导，大阪已发展成为宗教和经济活动的主要中心。寺庙堡垒由好战的一光一揆控制，是净土真宗抵抗武士军阀统治的据点。

canonical_source: Master, I have laid the foundations you entrusted to me. I believe I am ready to receive the Mokuroku.
current_cn: 师父，您托付给我的基础我已经奠定了。我相信我已经准备好接收目録了。

canonical_source: You spent your adolescence working in a forge as the apprentice of a blacksmith, being educated in the production of tools for the fields and the other activities in the village. By the end of your apprenticeship, you had become yourself a skilled blacksmith capable of crafting and handling several tools
current_cn: 你的青春期是在铁匠铺里当铁匠学徒度过的，接受了田间工具生产和村里其他活动的教育。在学徒期结束时，您已经成为一名熟练的铁匠，能够制作和处理多种工具

canonical_source: Your father was an ashigaru, the lowest class of samurai. Being paid only subsistence wages, he was so poor that he was forced to sell his sword blades and take out ruinous loans. Even so, he took pride in his status as a samurai and trained you to be a capable fighter.
current_cn: 你的父亲是足轻，是最低等的武士。他的工资仅够维持生计，他非常贫穷，被迫卖掉剑刃并申请毁灭性的贷款。即便如此，他仍以自己武士的身份为荣，并将你训练成一名有能力的战士。

canonical_source: I will be willing to pay generously {BASE_REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for each day the foreigner is on the road. It will be more than I usually pay for guards, but figure maybe you can scare these radicals off. I can't afford the cost of a foreign reprisal just because some fools hate outsiders.
current_cn: 我愿意为外国人在路上的每一天慷慨地支付{BASE_REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}。这将比我通常支付的警卫费用还要高，但我想也许你可以吓跑这些激进分子。我无法承担仅仅因为一些傻瓜憎恨外来者而遭受外国报复的代价。

canonical_source: It is hereby proclaimed that the administration of the realm has been respectfully returned to the Imperial Throne. The Shogun, having fulfilled his charge, has retired from his offices. Henceforth, all affairs of state shall proceed under the direct and august authority of His Majesty.
current_cn: 特此宣布，国家行政权已重新归还给帝国王座。幕府将军完成了他的职责后，已经从办公室退休了。从此以后，所有国家事务都将在国王陛下的直接和威严的权力下进行。

canonical_source: Tosa dominates southern Shikoku, a land of steep mountains and sheltered valleys that have allowed the Yamauchi clan to cultivate a tradition of independence. The domain produces politically active samurai and reformist thinkers, who travel to Kyoto and Edo to debate modernization and imperial loyalty. Rivers carry lumber and silk to coastal ports, linking the inland valleys to trade networks. When disputes flare between coastal and inland powers, Tosa's samurai are quick to act, using both diplomacy and force to advance the clan's interests.
current_cn: 土佐主宰着四国南部，这里山峦陡峭，山谷幽静，山内氏族因此养成了独立的传统。该藩产生了政治上活跃的武士和改良主义思想家，他们前往京都和江户讨论现代化和帝国忠诚度。河流将木材和丝绸运送到沿海港口，将内陆山谷与贸易网络连接起来。当沿海和内陆列强之间爆发争端时，土佐武士会迅速采取行动，利用外交和武力来推进氏族的利益。

canonical_source: Tottori-han, ruled by the Ikeda, has long been close with the Shogunate. Their daimyo are allowed to use the Matsudaira name and crest, they have the right to carry their swords into Edo castle, and their daimyo is the half brother of the man who will one day become the last shogun, Tokugawa Yoshinobu. However, they also have many proponents of the Imperial cause within, and just the year ago a pro-Imperial samurai assassinated a pro-Shogunate official within their domain.
current_cn: 池田氏统治的鸟取藩长期以来与幕府关系密切。他们的大名获准使用松平姓氏和家纹，并有权佩刀进入江户城；而鸟取藩主还是后来成为末代将军的德川庆喜的同父异母兄弟。不过，藩内也有许多支持王政复古的一派，就在一年前，一名尊王派武士还在藩内刺杀了一名佐幕派官员。
军队每日凝聚力损失增加 20%。

canonical_source: Chūgoku, stretching across western Honshū, has become one of the most unstable regions of Japan in the Bakumatsu. Once a stronghold of loyalist domains guarding the western approaches to the capital, the region is now defined by upheaval and rebellion, chiefly in Chōshū, whose radical samurai and reformist leadership openly defy the Bakufu, clashing repeatedly with shogunate forces and other loyal domains. Neighboring territories such as Hiroshima and Okayama have been drawn into the turmoil, and Chūgoku is becoming the spark that will light the fire of war.
current_cn: 中国地区横跨本州西部，已成为日本幕末时期最不稳定的地区之一。该地区曾经是守卫通往首都的西方通道的忠诚藩的据点，但现在却充满了动乱和叛乱，主要是在长州，激进的武士和改革派领导层公开反抗幕府，与幕府军队和其他忠诚藩多次发生冲突。广岛和冈山等邻近地区已被卷入动乱，而中国正在成为点燃战争之火的火花。

canonical_source: To the merchants and businessmen of the outside world, the newly opened Japan was a goldmine. The price of gold and silver was cheaper than the rest of the world, and there was a huge market for outside products: most notably, firearms. Numerous arms dealers flocked to the archipelago, selling guns, uniforms, {FIELD_ARTILLERY_LINK}, and expertise in exchange for money and privileges. Found by walking around the keeps of any town, foreign merchants sell modern guns, artillery, and uniforms to the player. These wares each merchant offers differ by ethnicity. While all offer uniforms and antique flintlocks, British merchants offer the versatility of the many variants of the Enfield and Snider-Enfield rifles, alongside the best cannons, French merchants offer high quality rifles and cheap and light artillery, German merchants sell cheaper rifles, and American merchants sell all things repeating: revolvers, repeating rifles, and gatling guns.
current_cn: 对海外商人而言，开国后的日本意味着巨大的新市场。金银比价与海外不同，而日本又急需大量舶来品，其中最重要的便是近代枪械。各国军火商纷纷来到日本，以枪支、军服、{FIELD_ARTILLERY_LINK}和军事技术换取金钱与特权。玩家可以在各城镇主堡中找到外国商人，购买近代枪械、火炮和军服；不同国籍商人的商品各有侧重。英国商人提供多种恩菲尔德与斯奈德—恩菲尔德步枪以及性能优良的火炮；法国商人出售优质步枪和较轻便廉价的火炮；德国商人以价格较低的步枪为主；美国商人则偏重转轮手枪、连发步枪和加特林机枪等连发武器。
RBL 12磅8英担阿姆斯特朗炮 使用 {AMMO}
M1857 12 磅拿破仑 使用 {AMMO}

canonical_source: Canon de Montagne de 4 La Hitte\nUsing {AMMO}
current_cn: 4 La Hitte 山炮 使用 {AMMO}

canonical_source: Kameyama Shachū is a small, semi-private maritime venture founded by Sakamoto Ryōma to move weapons, conduct trade, and operate ships independent of the Bakufu. It will later evolve into the Kaientai, a more organized naval-style volunteer corps that carries out transport, escort, and political missions during the final years of the Bakumatsu.
current_cn: 龟山社中是坂本龙马创立的一家小型半私营海上企业，其目的是独立于幕府运送武器、进行贸易和运营船只。它后来演变成海援队，这是一支组织更加严密的海军式志愿军，在幕末最后几年执行运输、护送和政治任务。

canonical_source: You know, these goods are worth more to me than what you'll paying. I will keep them.
current_cn: 你知道，这些商品对我来说比你付的钱更值钱。我会保留它们。

canonical_source: You approach {CURRENT_SETTLEMENT}, a school of the {SCHOOL_TEXT}. {PROSPERITY_STATEMENT}
current_cn: 你来到 {CURRENT_SETTLEMENT}，这里有 {SCHOOL_TEXT} 流派。{PROSPERITY_STATEMENT}
皇家海軍陸戰隊輕步兵

canonical_source: Shingyoto-ryu teaches a combination of katana, odachi, and naginata, focusing on versatility and battlefield adaptability. Practitioners excel in both dueling and larger engagements, sustaining their relevance through the late Bakumatsu period.
current_cn: 心形刀流 教授武士刀、大刀和薙刀的组合，注重多功能性和战场适应性。练习者在决斗和大型交战中都表现出色，在幕末末期保持着他们的影响力。

canonical_source: Yes commander, I have brought your Geweer and Minieru as you requested.
current_cn: 是的，指挥官，我按照您的要求带来了您的格维尔和米涅鲁。

canonical_source: While others chose sides in the growing turmoil of the age, you kept to your own affairs. Neither strongly loyal to the Shogunate nor drawn to the Imperial cause, you learned to mind your own survival above politics. Travel and hard work taught you practical skills with common weapons and the awareness to avoid unnecessary trouble. In uncertain times, being overlooked has often been your greatest advantage.
current_cn: 当其他人在这个日益动荡的时代选择立场时，你却坚持自己的事情。你既不强烈忠于幕府，也不热衷于帝国事业，你学会了将自己的生存置于政治之上。旅行和辛苦的工作教会了你使用常用武器的实用技巧和避免不必要麻烦的意识。在不确定的时期，被忽视往往是你最大的优势。

canonical_source: You spent your adolescence on the streets of the city, often getting into trouble and growing closer and closer to the local underworld, eventually becoming a member of a gang of young criminals. After years in this environment, you have learned all the secrets of commiting crimes and getting out of the resulting trouble.
current_cn: 你在城市的街头度过了青春期，时常惹上麻烦，与当地的黑社会越来越亲近，最终成为一伙年轻犯罪团伙的成员。在这种环境中生活多年后，您已经掌握了犯罪并摆脱由此产生的麻烦的所有秘密。

canonical_source: I studied the sword to perfect myself. Now everyone wants me to choose a side.
current_cn: 我学剑是为了完善自己。现在每个人都希望我选择立场。

canonical_source: Shikoku maintains a more cautious stance than the rest of Japan. With very few large domains, the island is almost entirely dominated by the Yamauchi of Tosa and the Hachisuka of Tokushima, as well as the Date of Uwajima, a cousin of the larger main house in Sendai. Even so, these few domains are tiny compared to some of the mighty domains in the rest of Japan. The samurai of Shikoku have flocked to the sonno-joi cause en masse, much to the dismay of the more pro-Shogunate daimyo of their domains, and internal conflicts have begun to tear them apart.
current_cn: 四国比日本其他地区保持更为谨慎的立场。该岛几乎没有大型藩，几乎完全由土佐的山内和德岛的蜂须贺以及宇和岛的伊达统治，后者是仙台较大主屋的表亲。即便如此，与日本其他地区的一些强大藩相比，这几个藩仍然很小。四国的武士纷纷涌入尊王攘夷，这让他们藩中更亲幕府的大名感到沮丧，而内部冲突已经开始使他们分裂。

canonical_source: I shall fight with the naginata.
Thank you my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}. I am sure your men will take care of the problem.
current_cn: 谢谢你，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}。我相信你的人会解决这个问题的。

canonical_source: Hand over your goods, or die!
current_cn: 交出你的货物，否则就死！

canonical_source: Ah, the old days. And no doubt back then they complained about the older days. I've heard enough.
current_cn: 啊，旧时光。毫无疑问，当时他们抱怨过去的日子。我已经听够了。

canonical_source: Sakai, one of the wealthiest and most autonomous cities in Japan, thrives as a center of commerce. The city’s merchant guilds operate independently of the warring daimyōs, maintaining direct trade with China and Portuguese traders. Famous for its high-quality firearms, swords, and luxury goods, Sakai’s economy flourishes even as war ravages the surrounding regions.
current_cn: 堺是日本最富有、自治程度最高的城市之一，作为商业中心而蓬勃发展。该市的商人行会独立于交战的大名运作，与中国和葡萄牙商人保持直接贸易。堺市以其高品质的枪械、刀剑和奢侈品而闻名，尽管周边地区战火蹂躏，但堺市的经济依然蓬勃发展。

canonical_source: Indeed. Nobody is more important than a skilled swordsman.
current_cn: 的确。没有人比熟练的剑客更重要。

canonical_source: You aren't from the right social class to engage in commerce.
current_cn: 你的社会阶层不适合从事商业活动。

canonical_source: If it would not trouble you, might I look over the firearms and artillery you have for sale?
current_cn: 如果不麻烦您的话，我可以看一下你们出售的枪械和火炮吗？

canonical_source: I was wondering when I would find you, {PLAYER.NAME}. Chōshū moves, and yet somehow you are always close to the fault lines when things begin to break. Convenient... or intentional, I wonder. I am {LORD.NAME}.[if:convo_grave][ib:aggressive]
current_cn: 我想知道什么时候能找到你，{PLAYER.NAME}。长州在移动，但不知何故，当事情开始破裂时，你总是接近断层线。我想知道是方便……还是故意的。我是 {LORD.NAME}.[if:convo_grave][ib:aggressive]

canonical_source: You can have one of my companions and {REQUIRED_TROOP_AMOUNT} of my men to take your “goods” to {TARGET_TOWN}
current_cn: 你可以让我的一名同伴和我的手下{REQUIRED_TROOP_AMOUNT}把你的“货物”带到{TARGET_TOWN}

canonical_source: Shinto Munen-ryu is a kenjutsu school emphasizing adaptability, speed, and fluid techniques with katana and wakizashi. Practitioners were trained for dueling and skirmishes, preparing samurai and retainers for the unpredictable conflicts of the Bakumatsu era.
current_cn: 神道无念流是一所剑术流派，强调武士刀和胁差的适应性、速度和流畅技术。练习者接受决斗和小规模冲突训练，为武士和家臣应对幕末时代不可预测的冲突做好准备。

canonical_source: Not yet commander. I'm still working on it.
current_cn: 还不是指挥官。我还在努力。

canonical_source: I wish to test our school’s techniques against others. I ask for a Taryū-shiai.
current_cn: 我想与其他流派一起测试我们流派的技术。我要一份 他流试合。

canonical_source: I can't let you in. My {?SETTLEMENT_OWNER.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\\?} {SETTLEMENT_OWNER.NAME} would be furious.
current_cn: 我不能让你进来。我的 {?SETTLEMENT_OWNER.GENDER}Lady{?}Lord{\\?} {SETTLEMENT_OWNER.NAME} 会生气的。

canonical_source: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, we have heard rumors that you have purchased foreign firearms from {QUEST_GIVER.NAME}.[ib:demure] Surely this cannot be true. Our laws require that only Japanese-made firearms may be bought or sold here.
current_cn: 我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}，我们听说您从{QUEST_GIVER.NAME}.[ib:demure]购买了外国枪支，这当然不是真的。我们的法律规定，这里只能买卖日本制造的枪支。

canonical_source: As a new era dawned on Japan, you joined one of the many local militias springing up throughout the nation. Despite your lack of professional training, you did become skilled with a firearm.
current_cn: 随着日本新时代的到来，您加入了全国各地涌现的众多地方民兵之一。尽管你缺乏专业训练，但你确实熟练地使用了枪械。
您因 {SCHOOL_NAME_2} 失去了 {AMOUNT} 声望

canonical_source: You have no right to go around, under arms, spreading sedition. Disperse!
current_cn: 你无权携带武器到处散布煽动叛乱。分散！

canonical_source: What do you want, you degenerate?[if:convo_stern]
The Tenchūgumi are a small band of imperial loyalists who launched an armed uprising in Yamato in 1863, believing they are carrying out heaven's punishment against enemies of the emperor.
current_cn: 天中组是一小群忠于帝国的人，他们于 1863 年在大和发动了武装起义，他们相信自己正在对天皇的敌人执行上天的惩罚。

canonical_source: Are you sure you wish to proceed? It is not to late to retreat.[ib:warrior][if:convo_grave]
current_cn: 您确定要继续吗？现在撤退还不算晚.[ib:warrior][if:convo_grave]

canonical_source: A scroll depicting the techniques of Hōzōin-ryū school, a spear martial arts specialised in the use of the Jumonji sickle spear to enable diverse offensive and defensive techniques.
current_cn: 描绘宝藏院流派技法的卷轴，宝藏院流派是一种专门使用十文字镰刀枪来实现多种进攻和防御技术的枪术。

canonical_source: To stand before a lord of his own domain... forgive any discourtesy on my part.[if:nervous][if:convo_nervous]
current_cn: 站在自己藩的领主面前……请原谅我的任何失礼。[if:nervous][if:convo_nervous]

canonical_source: I spoke too openly in council. Now I travel without a stipend, without a master, and without patience for men who mistake caution for wisdom.
current_cn: 我在议会中发言过于公开。现在，我旅行时没有津贴，没有主人，对那些误认为谨慎为智慧的人没有耐心。

canonical_source: Sets the number of Armstrong Guns you have in custom battles
current_cn: 设置您在自定义战斗中拥有的阿姆斯特朗枪的数量

canonical_source:
'Oh the maidens of {RANDOM_TOWN} are merry and fair 
 Plotting their mischief with flowers in their hair 
 Were I still a young man I sure would be there 
 But now I'll take warmth over trouble'
current_cn: “哦，{RANDOM_TOWN} 的少女们快乐而美丽  用头发上的花朵策划她们的恶作剧  如果我还是个年轻人，我肯定会在那里  但现在我会用温暖战胜麻烦”

canonical_source: Tanegashima-ryu is a firearms school teaching the use of matchlock arquebuses. Practitioners learn coordinated volleys and battlefield deployment. In late Tokugawa Japan, Tanegashima-ryu instructors were vital in domain militias, bridging traditional martial culture and early modern warfare.
current_cn: 种子岛流是一所枪械流派，教授火绳枪的使用。练习者学习协调齐射和战场部署。在日本德川幕府末期，种子岛流教官在藩兵中发挥着至关重要的作用，在传统武术文化和早期现代战争之间架起桥梁。

canonical_source: Tennen Rishin-ryu is a kenjutsu school focusing on katana, wakizashi, and occasional yari use. Practitioners were famously associated with the Shinsengumi, combining practical swordsmanship with rigorous discipline in the late Bakumatsu era.
current_cn: 天然理心流是一所剑术流派，专注于武士刀、胁差，偶尔也会使用枪。在幕末时代末期，练习者与新选组有着密切的联系，将实用的剑术与严格的纪律相结合。

canonical_source: You have delivered the goods from {QUEST_GIVER.NAME}.
That's just robbery under the cover of law. I'm not giving you anything.
current_cn: 这只是打着法律幌子的抢劫行为。我不会给你任何东西。

canonical_source: His band has been going about from village to village. Find him and stop him. You can tell him he's guilty of sedition, and if he doesn't disperse, then you can use force.[if:convo_thinking][ib:hip2]
current_cn: 他的乐队一直在各个村庄巡回演出。找到他并阻止他。你可以告诉他他犯了煽动罪，如果他不驱散，你就可以使用武力。[if:convo_thinking][ib:hip2]

canonical_source: I thank you. I will see that the matter is recorded and reported properly.
current_cn: 我谢谢你。我会确保此事得到妥善记录和报告。

canonical_source: Your clan is now at war with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}'s realm. Your agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} was canceled.
current_cn: 你的氏族现在正与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的藩交战。您与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的协议已取消。

canonical_source: You have collected all the weapons that the retainer requested. Return to their party and deliver the firearms
current_cn: 您已收集了家臣要求的所有武器。返回他们的队伍并交付枪支

canonical_source: I do not seek to make Japan into the West. I only wish to learn whatever can strengthen her. So I travel where knowledge can be found, serving any lord wise enough to value skill over tradition alone.
current_cn: 我并不寻求让日本成为西方国家。我只想学习任何能让她坚强的东西。因此，我旅行到能找到知识的地方，为任何明智的、重视技能而不是传统的领主服务。

canonical_source: Trusted to carry messages between villages and estates, you spent years running dusty roads and learning the terrain by heart.
current_cn: 你被信任在村庄和庄园之间传递信息，你花了数年的时间在尘土飞扬的道路上行驶并熟记地形。

canonical_source: Greetings. This caravan travels under the authority of His Imperial Majesty, Napoleon III of the French Empire, and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we be of service?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。这支商队在法兰西帝国拿破仑三世陛下的授权下行驶，并由 {SETTLEMENT} 的 {MERCHANT.LINK} 担保。我们可以提供什么服务？[if:convo_normal]

canonical_source: Sets the number of La Hitte Mountain Guns you have in custom battles
current_cn: 设置您在自定义战斗中拥有的拉希特山炮数量

canonical_source: In your adolescence you were sent to a workshop as the apprentice of the local carpenter, learning the different ways of working wood and stone and how to use them for the construction of buildings essential to village life. To conclude your apprenticeship you lead the construction of the new village warehouse, proving your grasp of the fields of mathematics and engineering.
current_cn: 在你的青春期，你被送到一个作坊当当地木匠的学徒，学习木材和石头的不同加工方法，以及如何使用它们来建造乡村生活所必需的建筑物。为了结束你的学徒生涯，你领导了新村仓库的建设，证明了你对数学和工程藩的掌握。

canonical_source: I have not joined any conspiracy. Not yet. But if a man truly intends to restore honor to the realm, I would hear him out before I hear another speech from a Tokugawa bureaucrat.
current_cn: 我没有参与任何阴谋。还没有。但如果一个人真的想恢复国家的荣誉，我会在听到德川官僚的另一次演讲之前先听他说完。

canonical_source: I choose the staff for this duel.
current_cn: 我选择这次决斗的工作人员。

canonical_source: Tell me about the licensing system
current_cn: 告诉我有关许可制度的信息

canonical_source: you supported unity between court and shogunate.
current_cn: 你支持朝廷和幕府的统一。
以飞脚的身份发送消息。

canonical_source: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, that would be very good. The artisans won't like it but hard-working merchants like me will be grateful to you.
current_cn: 我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}，那就太好了。工匠们不会喜欢它，但像我这样勤劳的商人会感激你的。

canonical_source: I want to visit the lord's hall.
current_cn: 我想去参观领主的大厅。

canonical_source: All right then. I'll have a look at the prison.
current_cn: 那就好吧。我要去监狱看看。

canonical_source: When the Black Ships came to Japan's shores, you knew you had to take a stance...
current_cn: 当黑船来到日本海岸时，你知道你必须采取立场......

canonical_source: Right to not pay agricultural taxes

Fukashi is a castle town built amongst the mountains of Shinano to protect the domains of the Ogasawara clan until it was taken over by its parent clan following a famous siege by Takeda Shingen, who subsequently converted it into one of the outposts of the expanding Takeda clan.
current_cn: 深志是一座建在信浓山脉之间的城堡城镇，旨在保护小笠原氏族的藩，直到武田信玄著名的围城战后被其母氏族接管，随后将其转变为不断扩张的武田氏族的前哨基地之一。

canonical_source: Aye, real honor is as scarce as hen's teeth these days.
current_cn: 是啊，现在真正的荣誉就像母鸡的牙齿一样稀缺。

canonical_source: You spent your youth as a Hikyaku, a member of the Bakufu's courier network. You constantly travelled back and forth along the highways of Japan, always speeding to your next destination.
current_cn: 你的青年时代是作为一名飞脚度过的，他是幕府快递网络的一员。你不断地沿着日本的高速公路来回穿梭，总是飞驰着前往下一个目的地。

canonical_source: Well, try to bring it soon.[if:convo_thinking][ib:closed]

Kyoto, once the unrivaled capital of Japan, emerged almost completely destroyed by the struggles for control over the central power. The authority of the Ashikaga Shogunate has crumbled, leaving the city at the mercy of the warring daimyos, while the Imperial Court sits back and watches helplessly. Nevertheless, Kyoto remains the depository of secular traditions and while its days as the true centre of power seem to be over, its religious and cultural influence persists.
current_cn: 京都曾经是日本无与伦比的首都，但由于中央权力的控制权斗争而几乎完全被摧毁。足利幕府的权威已经崩溃，这座城市任由交战的大名摆布，而朝廷则袖手旁观。尽管如此，京都仍然是世俗传统的保存地，虽然它作为真正权力中心的时代似乎已经结束，但它的宗教和文化影响仍然存在。

canonical_source: Well done, {PLAYER.LINK}. Your engagements with {OPPONENT_COUNT} students were executed with composure and intent. Maintain this focus, and your proficiency will continue to advance.
current_cn: 干得好，{PLAYER.LINK}。你与 {OPPONENT_COUNT} 名学生的交手沉着而专注。保持这种专注，你的技艺会继续精进。

canonical_source: You must have misunderstood me. Go in peace.
current_cn: 你一定误会我的意思了。平静地走吧。

canonical_source: Aizu Kotetsu is a feared street boss who serves as an unofficial enforcer for the Aizu clan in Kyoto. His crew handles the dirty work the samurai cannot, using local influence and hard violence to protect Aizu interests in the back alleys of the capital.
current_cn: 会津虎彻是一位令人畏惧的街头老大，是京都会津氏族的非官方执法者。他的手下处理武士无法处理的肮脏工作，利用当地影响力和暴力来保护首都后巷的会津利益。
很好。拿着这个目録。你的名字以及你所获得的教诲都写在上面。请保管好它，并记住所写的内容将您与这所流派联系在一起。

canonical_source: Thank you, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\\?}, I think they will be enough.
current_cn: 谢谢您，{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\\?}，我想它们就足够了。

canonical_source:
'A warrior brave you might surely be 
 With your blade and your helm and your bold fiery steed 
 But I'll give you a warning you'd be wise to heed 
 Don't toy with the fishwives of {RANDOM_TOWN}'
current_cn: “你肯定会成为一名勇敢的战士 用你的剑、你的头盔和你勇敢的烈马 但我会给你一个警告，你最好注意 不要玩弄{RANDOM_TOWN}的鱼妇”

canonical_source: That's your right, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}. But if you can't get the support of the artisans here when you next need it, well, don't say no one said anything.
current_cn: 这是你的权利，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}。但是，如果您下次需要时无法获得这里工匠的支持，那么，请不要说没有人说什么。

canonical_source: The capital in name of Japan, Kyoto is the seat of the Emperor. Once the power center of Japan, its decline during the late Sengoku period and throughout the Edo period have left the city a shell of its former self. However, the turmoil of the Bakumatsu has brought the city back to relevance, as Daimyo clash in the halls of government and samurai and ronin clash in the streets of the city.
current_cn: 日本名义上的首都，京都是天皇的所在地。曾经是日本的权力中心，但在战国时代后期和整个江户时代，它的衰落使这座城市只剩下昔日的外壳。然而，幕末的动乱使这座城市重新回归现实，大名在政府大厅里发生冲突，武士和浪人在城市的街道上发生冲突。

canonical_source: How virtue has crumbled since the old days.
current_cn: 自古以来，道德已经崩溃了。

canonical_source: 20% less relationship loss from kingdom decisions.
current_cn: 藩国决策造成的关系损失减少 20%。

canonical_source: {VALUE}% hit points to defensive siege engines in the governed settlement.
current_cn: {VALUE}% 生命值指向受管辖定居点中的防御攻城引擎。

canonical_source: Don't worry. I will send my best men to deal with this.
current_cn: 不用担心。我会派我最好的人来处理这件事。

canonical_source: Respectfully, you're making a big mistake and I think you're going to regret it.[if:convo_furious]
current_cn: 恕我直言，你犯了一个大错误，我想你会后悔的。[if:convo_furious]

canonical_source: We have heard rumors that you have purchased foreign firearms from {QUEST_GIVER.NAME}. Well, our laws require that only domestic firearms may be bought or sold here.[if:convo_annoyed][ib:hip]
current_cn: 我们听说你从 {QUEST_GIVER.NAME} 那里购买了外国枪械。嗯，本地法律规定这里只能买卖国产枪械。[if:convo_annoyed][ib:hip]

canonical_source: I found a purse with {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} a few paces away. I reckon it belongs to you.
current_cn: 我在几步外发现了一个带有 {AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} 的钱包。我认为它属于你。

canonical_source: Recruiting and upgrading traditional troops are 10% cheaper.
current_cn: 招募和升级传统部队便宜 10%。

canonical_source: A foreign merchant needs an escort for protection against ishin shishi radicals.
current_cn: 外国商人需要护卫来抵御异端邪教激进分子。

canonical_source: Conflict is inevitable against those who claim to march under the Imperial Banner.
current_cn: 对于那些声称在帝国旗帜下游行的人来说，冲突是不可避免的。

canonical_source: The dojo appears to be well-maintained and attracting a modest number of students from the province, showing that the school is averagely well known.
current_cn: 道场似乎维护得很好，吸引了少量来自该省的学生，这表明这所流派的知名度一般。

canonical_source: Gassantoda is a castle town in San'in that traces its origins back to the Kamakura period and before that to the Heian period when a fortress was built to protect trade routes and the renowned local steel production. More recently, Gassantoda became the stage for the last stand of the once dominant Amago clan against the ascendant Ōuchi and Mōri clans, with the conquest by Mōri Motonari marking the definitive shift of power in the region.
current_cn: 月山都田是山阴的一座城下町，其历史可以追溯到镰仓时代，更早的是平安时代，当时建造了一座堡垒来保护贸易路线和当地著名的钢铁生产。最近，月山田田成为曾经占主导地位的天子氏族对抗崛起的大内氏族和毛利氏族的最后一战的舞台，毛利元成的征服标志着该地区权力的最终转移。

canonical_source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}, a retainer of the {QUEST_GIVER_FACTION} has told you that they need smoothbore Geweer for their upcoming military campaign. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} wanted you to deliver {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT} Geweer guns and although it's not necessary, to provide {RIFLE_AMOUNT} Minieru rifles and {CARTRIDGE_AMOUNT} cartridge boxes. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} would appreciate it.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}，{QUEST_GIVER_FACTION} 的一名随从告诉您，他们需要滑膛蓋貝爾槍来应对即将到来的军事行动。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 希望你提供 {SMOOTHBORE_AMOUNT}蓋貝爾槍枪，尽管没有必要，但提供 {RIFLE_AMOUNT} 米涅步枪和 {CARTRIDGE_AMOUNT} 弹盒。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 将不胜感激。

canonical_source: 100% more relationship gain from kingdom decisions.
current_cn: 藩国决策带来的关系增益增加 100%。

canonical_source: The castle town of Kurokawa was built by the Ashina clan as its seat in the southernmost part of Ōu region, an isolated area that ensured that Kurokawa could grow while avoiding the worst of the conflicts between neighbouring lords.
current_cn: 黑川城下町是由芦名氏族在奥地区最南端建造的，作为其所在地，这是一个与世隔绝的地区，确保黑川能够发展，同时避免邻近领主之间最严重的冲突。

canonical_source: Most men think the world ends at Japan's shores. I know better.
current_cn: 大多数人认为日本海岸就是世界的尽头。我更了解。

canonical_source: You have been defeated in this deadly contest, {PLAYER.LINK}. Your skill was noted, yet the outcome is clear. Your life shall be spared, but consider this a grave lesson.
current_cn: 你在这场致命的较量中失败了，{PLAYER.LINK}。你的技巧被注意到了，但结果是显而易见的。你的生命将被保全，但请将此视为一个严重的教训。

canonical_source: You lost the battle against {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} and failed to help {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} as promised.
current_cn: 你输掉了与 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的战斗，也未能按照承诺帮助 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}。

canonical_source: Ah! I was looking for this all day. How good of you to bring it back {?PLAYER.GENDER}madam{?}sir{\\?}. Well, now that I know what an honest {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}man{\\?} you are, there can be no harm in letting you inside for a look. Go in.... Just so you know, though -- I'll be hanging onto the keys, in case you were thinking about undoing anyone's chains.
current_cn: 啊!我一整天都在找这个。你把它带回来真是太好了{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}先生{\\?}。好吧，现在我知道你是一个多么诚实的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}男子{\\?}，让你进去看看也没什么坏处。进去……不过，让你知道——我会抓住钥匙，以防你想解开任何人的锁链。

canonical_source: Located in north-western Kyushu, Yanagawa is strategically located on the banks of the Chikugo River, at the crossroads of trade routes connecting much of the region, which facilitates both trade and military movements.
current_cn: 柳川位于九州西北部，战略性地位于筑后川沿岸，位于连接该地区大部分地区的贸易路线的十字路口，这有利于贸易和军事活动。

canonical_source: The challenge has been met and repelled. This dojo stands, our honor intact, and my students remain under my guidance. Remember this lesson, {PLAYER.LINK}.
current_cn: 挑战已被迎接并被击退。这个道场依然存在，我们的荣誉完好无损，我的学生们仍然在我的指导下。记住这个教训，{PLAYER.LINK}。

canonical_source: I would like to begin learning new techniques
You know, you'd think this place could serve proper sake, instead of this piss... Sorry, where were we? Ah yes, my story.
current_cn: 你知道，你会认为这个地方可以提供正宗的清酒，而不是这些尿……抱歉，我们说到哪儿了？啊，是的，我的故事。

canonical_source: Congratulations, {PLAYER.LINK}. You have concluded today's series of exercises with distinction. Consistency, focus, and diligence are the hallmarks of a competent martial artist; continue to embody them.
current_cn: 恭喜你，{PLAYER.LINK}。你出色地完成了今天的一系列训练。稳定、专注与勤奋是一名优秀武者的标志；继续保持。

canonical_source: I aim to challenge the strength of this dojo itself. I seek a Dōjō-yaburi.
current_cn: 我的目标是挑战这个道场本身的实力。我寻找道场破。

canonical_source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} sends {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} regards for a fine job done with the {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} promised.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 向 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?} 致以问候，祝贺 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 所承诺的工作做得很好。

canonical_source: Himeji was originally built in the early Muromachi period by the Akamatsu clan as a small fortified outpost atop Himeyama Hill and along the western route to capital Kyoto, but underwent several demolitions and reconstructions until it reached its present form as a mighty castle town barring the way to would-be invaders.
current_cn: 姬路最初是由赤松氏族于室町时代早期建造的，作为姬山山顶和通往首都京都的西线沿线的一个小型防御哨所，但经历了多次拆除和重建，直到成为现在的招式，成为一个强大的城堡城镇，阻挡了潜在的入侵者。

canonical_source: Thank you. You can find the foreigner just outside the settlement.
current_cn: 谢谢。你可以在定居点外面找到那个外国人。

canonical_source: Thank you for your teachings, sensei
The merchant was killed by Shishi radicals. Your agreement with {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} is failed.
current_cn: 商人被尊攘激进派杀害。您与 {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} 的协议失败。

canonical_source: You've recently fought in this settlement
current_cn: 您最近曾在该定居点发生过战斗
您已为 {SCHOOL_NAME} 赢得 {AMOUNT} 声誉

canonical_source: You have failed to deliver {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}rifles{?}rifle{\\?}{.%} to {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} in time as {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} asked you.
current_cn: 您未能按照 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的要求及时将 {REQUESTED_AMOUNT} {.%}{?(REQUESTED_AMOUNT > 1)}步枪{?}步枪{\\?}{.%} 交付给 {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}。

canonical_source: You cannot enter an enemy lord's hall.
current_cn: 你不能进入敌方领主的大厅。

canonical_source: You displayed considerable skill and discipline in today's exercises. There remain lapses in timing and precision, but your effort against {OPPONENT_COUNT} peers is noted and serves as a foundation for further improvement.
current_cn: 你在今天的训练中展现出了相当出色的技巧和纪律性。你的时机把握和精准度仍有不足，但你与 {OPPONENT_COUNT} 名同门切磋时所付出的努力值得肯定，并为进一步提高打下了基础。

canonical_source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} says that a {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE} named {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} is stirring up unrest in the countryside. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} asked you to disperse {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}'s band using whatever means necessary before the movement gets enough support.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 说，一个名为 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_TITLE} 正在乡村煽动骚乱。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 要求您在运动获得足够支持之前使用任何必要的手段驱散 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的乐队。

canonical_source: We are preparing for a major engagement, but my arsenal is dangerously lacking in modern firearms. Without rifles and ammunition, my troops will be hopelessly outmatched. I cannot spare any of my own captains for this task, so I need someone else to secure a sufficient supply and deliver it to me without delay. Can you do this?
current_cn: 我们正在准备一场重大交战，但我的武器库严重缺乏现代枪支。没有步枪和弹药，我的部队将毫无希望地处于劣势。我无法抽出自己的任何一个队长来完成这项任务，所以我需要其他人来确保足够的补给并立即将其交付给我。你能做到吗？

canonical_source: Modern troops are unlocked by reformist policies, and can be relocked again.
current_cn: 现代军队可以通过改良主义政策解锁，也可以再次重新锁定。

canonical_source: That's the right call. Thank you for listening to the voice of reason.
current_cn: 这是正确的决定。感谢您聆听理性的声音。

canonical_source: I feel safe knowing that you're looking after us. Please continue to follow us my friend!
current_cn: 知道你在照顾我们，我感到很安全。请朋友继续关注我们！

canonical_source: You spent your youth as a hunter, searching for large game to kill and sell, providing for yourself and your village with your yumi bow. What you did fell on the edge of the law, but it was a living.
current_cn: 你作为一名猎人度过了你的青年时代，寻找大型猎物来杀死和出售，用你的尤米弓养活你自己和你的村庄。你的所作所为虽然触犯了法律，但却是一种谋生手段。

canonical_source: Give me the keys to the cells -- now!
current_cn: 把牢房的钥匙给我——现在！
额外尺寸奖励（类似福利的效果）

canonical_source: There is no need to struggle against those who share the same cause as us.
current_cn: 没有必要与那些与我们志同道合的人作斗争。

canonical_source: You have entered into the {CASTE} class
You were sent to study with a scholar to deepen your knowledge of the classics, studying etiquette, Confucianism, and rhetoric in order to be a cultured member of society.
current_cn: 你被送去跟一位学者学习，加深你对经典的了解，学习礼法、儒家思想、修辞学，以成为一个有文化的社会成员。

canonical_source: Sets the number of Gatling Guns you have in custom battles
current_cn: 设置您在自定义战斗中拥有的加特林机枪数量

canonical_source: I can share my story with you, if you have the time.
current_cn: 如果你有时间的话，我可以和你分享我的故事。

canonical_source: The laws of {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} dictate that only Japanese-made firearms may be bought or sold by in town. Now the merchants wish to smuggle the guns out to sell in other towns.
current_cn: {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} 的法律规定，只有日本制造的枪支才可以在镇上买卖。现在，商人希望将枪支走私到其他城镇出售。

canonical_source: That's the right call. You seem a responsible type.[if:convo_nonchalant]
current_cn: 这是正确的决定。你看起来是一个负责任的类型.[if:convo_nonchalant]

canonical_source: I seek to measure my skill and learn from it. I request a Tameshi-ai.
current_cn: 我寻求衡量自己的技能并从中学习。我要一份为爱。

canonical_source: When Commodore Perry arrived, I said we should modernize our troops. When Choshu began arming with Western weapons, I said we should do the same. They called me reckless. Then they bought rifles themselves and pretended it had been their idea all along.
current_cn: 当佩里准将到达时，我说我们应该对我们的军队进行现代化改造。当中国开始装备西方武器时，我说我们也应该这样做。他们说我鲁莽。然后他们自己买了步枪，并假装这一直是他们的主意。

canonical_source: Built in the Kamakura period to guard the highways between Kyoto and the Shogunal capital, Kiyosu has long been the seat of the Oda clan of Owari and the site of political intrigue and military conflicts surrounding the clan, at least until the young lord Oda Nobunaga chose to move his seat to Gifu. Although the relocation of the court weakened its position, Kiyosu remains an important fortified city bustling with activity.
current_cn: 清洲建于镰仓时代，是为了守卫京都和幕府首都之间的高速公路，长期以来一直是尾张织田氏的所在地，也是围绕该氏族的政治阴谋和军事冲突的场所，至少在年轻的领主织田信长选择将其所在地迁往岐阜之前是这样。尽管宫廷的搬迁削弱了它的地位，清须仍然是一个热闹的重要防御城市。

canonical_source: Thank you.[if:convo_relaxed_happy] I hope your men deal with them as soon as possible.
current_cn: 谢谢.[if:convo_relaxed_happy] 我希望你的人尽快处理他们。

canonical_source: After too many duels over matters that had nothing to do with technique, I left. Steel cuts the same no matter whose crest is painted on the scabbard.
current_cn: 在与技术无关的事情上进行了太多的决斗后，我离开了。无论刀鞘上画的是谁的徽章，钢铁的切割效果都是一样的。

canonical_source: Yes... {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} sent word to us. We are expecting the {.%}{RIFLES}{.%} that {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}she{?}he{\\?} had.
current_cn: 是的... {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 给我们发了消息。我们期待 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 拥有的 {.%}{RIFLES}{.%} 。

canonical_source: You have to bring in amount {REQUIRED_AMOUNT} more to fulfill your end of the deal.
current_cn: 您必须多存入 {REQUIRED_AMOUNT} 金额才能完成交易。

canonical_source: Can't let down your guard around here. Too many bastards up to no good.
current_cn: 在这里不能放松警惕。混蛋太多了，没啥好处。

canonical_source: The Shinsengumi are a corps of loyalists formed to protect the Shogunate's interests in Kyoto. Renowned for their strict discipline and unmatched swordsmanship, they strike fear into rebels and ronin alike. Their loyalty is absolute, and their blades swift.
current_cn: 新选组是为了保护幕府在京都的利益而组建的忠诚者团体。他们以严格的纪律和无与伦比的剑术而闻名，让叛军和浪人都感到恐惧。他们的忠诚是绝对的，他们的刀锋迅捷。

canonical_source: Come on now. I thought you were the boss here.
current_cn: 现在来吧。我还以为你是这里的老板呢

canonical_source: Loyalty is a fine word. It is unfortunate how often it is mistaken for obedience to whoever holds a seal. Very well, then stay where you stand, {PLAYER.NAME}. Just do not pretend the ground beneath you is not already shifting.
current_cn: 忠诚是一个很好的词。不幸的是，人们经常错误地认为服从持有印章的人。很好，那就留在原地吧，{PLAYER.NAME}。只是不要假装你脚下的地面还没有发生变化。

canonical_source: Greetings. This caravan operates under the protection of His Majesty, King William III of the Netherlands, and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we assist you?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。该商队在荷兰国王威廉三世陛下的保护下运营，并由 {SETTLEMENT} 的 {MERCHANT.LINK} 提供担保。我们可以如何帮助您？[if:convo_normal]

canonical_source: I am still waiting for news from {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}. Thanks again for sparing your men.
current_cn: 我还在等待 {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} 的消息。再次感谢您饶恕了您的人。

canonical_source: Nestled in the mountains of southern Tōhoku, Aizu has long been a fortress of the Tokugawa. Its river valleys support fertile rice fields, while dense forests provide timber and fuel for the region's castles and towns. Generations of Matsudaira rulers shaped the domain into a stronghold of martial tradition, where warriors trained from youth and the people prized honor and duty. Temples, local crafts, and educational institutions thrive alongside military life, giving Aizu a culture both disciplined and deeply rooted in centuries of history.
current_cn: 会津坐落在东北南部的山区，自古以来就是德川家族的要塞。河谷孕育着肥沃的稻田，茂密的森林为该地区的城堡和城镇提供木材和燃料。一代又一代的松平统治者将这个藩打造成军事传统的据点，武士们从小就开始训练，人民也珍视荣誉和责任。寺庙、当地工艺品和教育机构与军事生活一起蓬勃发展，赋予会津一种纪律严明、根深蒂固的文化。

canonical_source: Kubota stretches across the northern plains toward the Sea of Japan, where the Satake clan balances tradition with pragmatism. Its winters are bitter, but the land yields rice and supports horse breeding, sustaining both townspeople and samurai. The domain is famous for retaining the old ways: its warriors are said to be the last in Japan to fight fully armored. Though deeply conservative, Kubota leans toward the imperial cause, guided by practical concerns rather than ideology, blending old martial habits with careful political calculation.
current_cn: 久保田横跨北部平原直至日本海，佐竹氏族在这里平衡传统与实用主义。这里的冬天很寒冷，但土地出产水稻并支持马匹繁殖，养活了城镇居民和武士。该藩以保留古老的方式而闻名：据说，这里的武士是日本最后一批全副武装的战士。尽管久保田非常保守，但他更倾向于帝国事业，以实际考虑而不是意识形态为指导，将古老的军事习惯与谨慎的政治算计融为一体。

canonical_source: Spread across river valleys and rugged hills, Morioka has been the seat of the Nanbu clan for centuries. The domain's winters are harsh, but its villages and fortified towns reflect careful planning and resilience. Morioka's samurai maintain long-standing martial traditions, while the local economy depends on a mix of agriculture and horse breeding. Centuries of governance have forged a community where survival and endurance shape both politics and everyday life.
current_cn: 盛冈遍布河谷和崎岖的山丘，几个世纪以来一直是南部氏族的所在地。该藩的冬天很严酷，但它的村庄和设防城镇反映了精心的规划和恢复力。盛冈的武士保持着悠久的军事传统，而当地经济则依赖于农业和马匹养殖的结合。几个世纪的治理已经形成了一个社区，生存和耐力塑造了政治和日常生活。

canonical_source: Shonai occupies a long strip along the Sea of Japan, where fertile farmland and maritime trade enrich the Sakai clan. Unlike many northern neighbors, Shonai adapts quickly, modernizing weapons and training without abandoning its traditions. Its castle towns hum with commerce, and local craftsmanship flourishes alongside the growing military reforms. The domain's leaders remain deeply loyal to the shogunate, yet their readiness and organization make Shonai one of the most capable forces in the north.
current_cn: 庄内占据了日本海沿岸的狭长地带，肥沃的农田和海上贸易使酒井氏族富裕起来。与许多北方邻国不同，庄内能够迅速适应，在不放弃传统的情况下实现武器和训练的现代化。其城下城镇商业繁荣，当地手工艺随着军事改革的不断推进而蓬勃发展。该藩的领导人仍然对幕府深表忠诚，但他们的准备和组织使庄内成为北方最有能力的军队之一。

canonical_source: Yonezawa is a smaller, mountainous domain under the Uesugi clan, with a history of careful stewardship after past losses. Its towns cling to hillsides and valleys, sustaining a tight-knit community of farmers and samurai. Local culture emphasizes tradition, efficiency, and scholarly pursuits, and the samurai are respected as much for their administrative skill as for martial ability. Politically, Yonezawa treads carefully, maintaining loyalty while watching the ambitions of larger neighbors.
current_cn: 米泽是上杉氏族统治下的一个较小的山区藩，在过去的损失之后有着精心管理的历史。它的城镇紧邻山坡和山谷，维持着由农民和武士组成的紧密社区。当地文化强调传统、效率和学术追求，武士的行政技能和军事能力同样受到尊重。在政治上，米泽行事谨慎，在保持忠诚的同时关注更大邻国的野心。

canonical_source: The nobles aren't trying to defend a wicked cause, but they cannot risk the domain's destruction by its enemies.
current_cn: 贵族们并不想捍卫邪恶的事业，但他们不能冒藩被敌人毁灭的风险

canonical_source: 'For all the coin aboard the Black Ships \n For all the tribute of the Great Ming \n For all the jade of Yunnan’s hills...'
current_cn: “为了黑船上所有的钱币 为了大明所有的贡品 为了云南山上所有的玉石……”

canonical_source: The Fudai are hereditary vassals of the Tokugawa who enjoy long-standing trust and occupy critical administrative and military roles within the shogunate, overseeing strategically located domains that, while often smaller in size, provide essential political and military leverage to maintain the Tokugawa order; their loyalty is relied upon to enforce shogunal policies and manage affairs across the country, giving them consistent access to influence and power, yet they remain tightly constrained by the carefully maintained balance of authority that the shogunate imposes to prevent any one ally from becoming too dominant.
current_cn: 普代是德川幕府的世袭封臣，享有长期信任，并在幕府内担任重要的行政和军事角色，负责监管具有战略意义的藩，这些藩虽然规模通常较小，但却为维持德川秩序提供了重要的政治和军事影响力；他们的忠诚是执行幕府政策和管理全国事务的依靠，使他们能够持续获得影响力和权力，但他们仍然受到幕府精心维持的权力平衡的严格限制，而幕府是为了防止任何一个盟友变得过于主导而强加的。

canonical_source: Muranaka has long served as a local stronghold in Western Kyushu, functioning as a minor seat of governance under the protection of the Aso clan, whose authority once extended across the central highlands. With the Aso clan’s power sharply declined under pressure from the Shimazu to the south and the Ōtomo to the east, Muranaka is now left vulnerable.
current_cn: 村中长期以来一直是西九州的地方据点，在麻生氏的保护下充当小统治所在地，其势力一度遍及中部高地。由于麻生氏的势力在南部的岛津河和东部的大友河的压力下急剧下降，村中现在变得脆弱不堪。

canonical_source: Thus always spoke the wicked to the just! We can only pray that the Heavens help the righteous cause. Now stay out of my way.[if:convo_undecided_closed][ib:closed]
current_cn: 恶人总是这样对义人说话！只能祈求老天爷保佑正义事业。现在别挡我的路。[if:convo_undecided_closed][ib:closed]

canonical_source: Originally a fortified temple complex of the Kaga Ikko movement, Oyama has evolved into a significant stronghold in the Hokuriku region and its strategic and religious value has drawn the attention of powerful neighbors.
current_cn: 大山最初是加贺一光运动的一座坚固的寺庙建筑群，现已发展成为北陆地区的重要据点，其战略和宗教价值引起了强大邻国的关注。

canonical_source: Located in the inland reaches of Shikoku, Kurose is a strategically placed castle town that provides control over the inland routes and a valuable defensive position against neighbouring domains.
current_cn: 黑濑位于四国的内陆地区，是一座战略位置优越的城下町，可以控制内陆路线，并且是对抗邻近藩的宝贵防御阵地。

canonical_source: Tōkai, stretching along the southern coast, is the home of the Tōkaidō, the most important of the Five Routes that link Edo to the rest of central Honshū. The Tōkaidō specifically links Edo and Kyoto, and is vital for maintaining the Shogun's control of the Imperial Court. Tōkai is almost entirely Tenryō land, alongside a handful of smaller Fudai domains, with the sole large domain being the Tokugawa branch in Owari. These domains largely remain loyal to the Shogun, but will be some of the first to roll over against the Imperial forces when they marched to Edo.
current_cn: 东海沿着南部海岸延伸，是东海道的所在地，东海道是连接江户和本州中部其他地区的五道中最重要的一条。东海道专门连接江户和京都，对于维持幕府将军对皇室的控制至关重要。东海几乎完全是天领藩，还有一些较小的谱代藩，唯一的大藩是尾张的德川分支。这些藩在很大程度上仍然忠于幕府将军，但当帝国军队进军江户时，它们将是最先反抗的藩。

canonical_source: Built as the fortified residence of the Nagano clan, the castle town of Minowa has long been a critical stronghold for the control of the surrounding region, which made it a mandatory target in the confrontation between the Uesugi and Takeda clans, until the forces of Takeda Shingen seized Minowa resulting in the demise of the Nagano clan and the death of all its members.
current_cn: 作为长野氏的堡垒住宅，三之轮城下町长期以来一直是控制周边地区的重要据点，这使得它成为上杉氏和武田氏之间对抗的强制性目标，直到武田信玄的军队占领了三之轮，导致长野氏的灭亡和所有成员的死亡。

canonical_source: You served your master directly as a Kosho, a young page. In this role, you did chores, guarded your lord, did secretarial work, and filled whatever role your lord needed.
current_cn: 你作为一名年轻侍从直接侍奉你的主人。在这个角色中，你做家务，看守你的主人，做秘书工作，并担任你的主人需要的任何角色。

canonical_source: Yes, that's sedition all right. Disperse now or face the consequences.
current_cn: 是的，这就是煽动叛乱。立即散去，否则后果自负。

canonical_source: My foreign guest wishes to go on a trade mission, but I fear he will be murdered before along the way. So I am looking for some good fighters who can escort him until he finds his footing and visits a couple of settlements.
current_cn: 我的外国客人想去出差，但我担心他会在途中被谋杀。所以我正在寻找一些优秀的战士来护送他，直到他站稳脚跟并访问几个定居点。

canonical_source: Yes, things come up, but my agreement with {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} was for a fixed amount of goods. I don't want to negotiate a new deal. Please come back when you can get the full amount.[if:convo_nervous2][ib:closed]
current_cn: 是的，事情发生了，但我与 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 的协议是固定数量的货物。我不想谈判新协议。请在拿到全额后回来。[if:convo_nervous2][ib:closed]

canonical_source: Greetings. This caravan is under the authority of the President of the United States of America and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we be of service?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。该商队受美利坚合众国总统管辖，并由 {SETTLEMENT} 的 {MERCHANT.LINK} 担保。我们可以提供什么服务？[if:convo_normal]

canonical_source: What? Does no one respect messengers anymore?
current_cn: 什么？难道没有人再尊重使者了吗？

canonical_source: Originally built as a small fortified residence for the Mōri clan this coastal castle town grew in importance along with the expansion of its inhabitants' power, while its hilltop location ensures control over the surrounding territories and sea routes.
current_cn: 这座沿海城堡小镇最初是为毛利氏族建造的小型防御住所，随着居民势力的扩张，其重要性也日益增强，而其山顶位置确保了对周围领土和海上航线的控制。

canonical_source: Very well. I will arrange for you to spar with a fellow student. Remember, this is to deepen your understanding, not to prove superiority.[rb:positive][rf:convo_focused_happy]
current_cn: 很好。我会安排你和一位同学切磋。请记住，这是为了加深理解，而不是为了证明优越性。[rb:positive][rf:convo_focused_happy]

canonical_source: There's been a real surge of radical activity around here recently. I don't know if it's because the lords are away fighting or something else, but it's a miracle if a foreigner can make three leagues beyond the gates without being set upon by shishi. As the host of one such merchant, I must ensure his safety.
current_cn: 最近这里的激进活动确实激增。不知是诸侯外出打仗，还是别的什么原因，洋人能走出门外三里而不被师师攻击，那就是奇迹了。作为这样一个商人的主人，我必须确保他的安全。

canonical_source: Situated on the coast of Echigo Province, Niigata is a prosperous port town benefiting from maritime trade and fertile agricultural lands. The Shinano River provides an essential route for transporting rice and goods inland. The town falls under the influence of Uesugi Kenshin, whose strong rule ensures stability in the region. Fishermen, salt merchants, and shipbuilders contribute to Niigata’s economy, making it an important asset for Kenshin’s war efforts.
current_cn: 新泻位于越后省海岸，是一个繁荣的港口城镇，受益于海上贸易和肥沃的农业土地。信浓川是向内陆运输大米和货物的重要路线。该镇受到上杉谦信的影响，他的强有力的统治确保了该地区的稳定。渔民、盐商和造船厂为新泻的经济做出了贡献，使其成为剑心战争的重要资产。

canonical_source: After listening to the town artisans, you decided to keep the restrictions on the sale of firearms. Your decision made the artisans happy but disappointed the {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}.
current_cn: 听了镇上工匠的意见后，您决定保留对枪支销售的限制。你的决定让工匠们高兴，但让 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 失望。

canonical_source: My {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}, we heard that you wish to issue a decree allowing the sale of foreign weapons. This will devastate the business of our smithies who have toiled for generations. Please reconsider this.
current_cn: 我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}，我们听说您希望颁布一项允许出售外国武器的法令。这将毁掉我们几代人辛苦劳作的铁匠们的生意。请重新考虑这一点。

canonical_source: Built during the Kamakura period, the castle town of Yonezawa has served as the seat of the Date clan since they drove out the previous lords and from here they plan the domination of neighbouring domains.
current_cn: 米泽城建于镰仓时代，是伊达氏族的所在地，他们驱逐了前代领主，并从这里计划统治邻近的藩。

canonical_source: I am reviewing available firearms and artillery. Show me what you can provide.
current_cn: 我正在审查可用的枪支和火炮。告诉我你能提供什么。

canonical_source: Let me tell you something - I'm sick of cowardice, sick of those who don't come forth to serve their Emperor.
current_cn: 让我告诉你一件事——我厌倦了懦弱，厌倦了那些不出来侍奉他们的皇帝的人。

canonical_source: Where others saw crisis, you saw opportunity. The coming of foreign ships brought strange goods, new markets, and unprecedented demand. Carefully avoiding political entanglements, you built quiet connections with those willing to trade, and your purse grew heavier while others argued about the fate of the realm.
current_cn: 在别人看到危机的地方，你看到机会。外国船只的到来带来了陌生的货物、新的市场和前所未有的需求。你小心翼翼地避免政治纠葛，与那些愿意进行贸易的人建立了安静的联系，当其他人争论国家的命运时，你的钱包变得越来越重。

canonical_source: Like all chonin children, you spent most of your time aiding your parents. You also...
current_cn: 和所有小忍孩子一样，你大部分时间都花在帮助父母上。你也花了你的时间...

canonical_source: Kyūshū is the core of Japan's reform in the Bakumatsu. Due to its isolation at the southwest of Japan, the island remained largely untouched by the Tokugawa when they founded the Bakufu, leaving the island largely under the control of powerful tozama daimyo, like the Shimazu of Satsuma, the Nabeshima of Saga, and the Hosokawa of Kumamoto. As the Shogun's authority continues to wane, the daimyo of Kyūshū have seen their chance, rapidly rearming with modern weapons in the hopes of becoming the dominant power in this new era.
current_cn: 九州是幕末日本改革的核心。由于地处日本西南部，该岛与世隔绝，在德川幕府创建时基本上没有受到德川氏的影响，该岛基本上处于强大的外样大名的控制之下，如萨摩的岛津、佐贺的锅岛和熊本的细川。随着幕府将军的权威不断衰落，九州的大名们看到了机会，迅速用现代武器重新武装，希望成为这个新时代的主导力量。

canonical_source: I don't want to break the law. You can take the guns.
current_cn: 我不想触犯法律。你可以拿枪。

canonical_source: Hidden deep within the mountainous interior of the Tosan region, Sakurabora has long served as the fortified residence of the Anekouji, guarding key approaches into central Japan. Its elevated position offers commanding views of the rugged valleys below, making it a valuable asset in controlling travel and communication through the region.
current_cn: 樱洞隐藏在东山地区的山区腹地深处，长期以来一直是姊小寺的防御住所，守卫着进入日本中部的重要通道。其地势较高，可以俯瞰下方崎岖山谷的景色，使其成为控制该地区旅行和通讯的宝贵资产。

canonical_source: Like all peasant children, you helped out in the fields. You also...
current_cn: 像所有农民的孩子一样，你在田里帮忙。你也花了你的时间...

canonical_source: Yuzuki is a fortified port town in western Shikoku, built by the Kōno clan as as a gateway to maritime commerce. Despite its modest size, Yuzuki has prospered thanks to the Kōno clan's unofficial alliance with local pirates and the castle's defensive position.
current_cn: 柚木是四国西部的一座港口城镇，由河野氏族建造，作为海上贸易的门户。尽管规模不大，柚月却因河野氏族与当地海盗的非正式联盟以及城堡的防御地位而繁荣起来。

canonical_source: I will fight with the spear.

current_cn: 携带大刀进入城内的权利

canonical_source: Located in the northernmost reaches of Honshu, Tosaminato serves as a key trade hub with the Ainu people of Hokkaido although the harsh winters and isolation make it difficult to defend, leaving it vulnerable to raids. Once a thriving port and administrative center of the Andō clan, Tosaminato has declined following the clan’s expulsion.
current_cn: 土佐港位于本州最北端，是北海道阿伊努人的重要贸易枢纽，尽管严冬和与世隔绝使其难以防御，容易遭受袭击。土佐港曾经是安藤氏族的繁荣港口和行政中心，随着安藤氏族被驱逐而衰落。

canonical_source: I am thinking of a different scroll.
current_cn: 我正在考虑另一种卷轴。

canonical_source: Sensei, if it pleases you, I wish to request a hands-on lesson with a fellow student. I hope to test my skills and learn from the experience.
current_cn: 老师，如果您愿意的话，我想请求和一位同学一起上一堂实践课。我希望测试我的技能并从经验中学习。

canonical_source: You were convinced by {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} to let him gather support. {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} will be very upset about this.
current_cn: 你被 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 说服让他获得支持。 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 会对此感到非常不安。

canonical_source: Let me try to talk some sense into you...
current_cn: 让我试着和你谈谈一些道理......

canonical_source: Once a student has learned most of our arts, they are granted the rank of Menkyo, and have the right to teach our techniques and represent our school in formal matches. Finally, there is the rank of Menkyo-Kaiden, signifying complete mastery of our arts. At this point, there is nothing left to learn.
current_cn: 一旦学生学会了我们流派的大部分技艺，他们就会被授予免许的等级，并有权教授我们的技术并代表我们流派参加正式比试。最后，还有免许皆传的等级，象征着我们完全掌握了本流派的技艺。到了这一步，就已无可学之处。

canonical_source: This is the retirement retreat location.
You have failed to escort the caravan to its destination.
current_cn: 你未能护送商队到达目的地。

canonical_source: Okazaki, the birthplace of the rising lord Tokugawa Ieyasu, is a vital castle town in Mikawa Province. Under Tokugawa rule, it has been reinforced as a military base, securing the clan’s control over the region. The castle town is flourishing, with a growing population of samurai, merchants, and craftsmen. Its position along the Tōkaidō road makes it an essential stop for travelers and military movements.
current_cn: 冈崎是新晋领主德川家康的出生地，是三河国的重要城下町。在德川家族的统治下，它作为军事基地得到了加强，确保了德川氏族对该地区的控制。城下町十分繁荣，武士、商人和工匠的人口不断增加。它沿着东海道的位置使其成为旅行者和军事行动的重要停靠站。

canonical_source: The duel is lost. You have prevailed, {PLAYER.LINK}. Depart now, that I may properly attend to the consequences of this contest and honor those who have fallen.
current_cn: 这场决斗你败了。不过胜者是你，{PLAYER.LINK}。现在请离去，让我妥善处理这场比试的后果，并悼念那些倒下的人。

canonical_source: You need to be the owner of this settlement!
current_cn: 您需要成为该定居点的所有者！

canonical_source: I accept this commission with humility. I will ensure it is carried out with due care.
current_cn: 我谦虚地接受这个委托。我将确保以应有的谨慎态度进行这项工作。

canonical_source: The thunder of foreign cannon along Japan's coasts demanded action. In your domain, new militias and shore batteries were raised in haste. You threw yourself into drilling men, moving supplies, and preparing for the invasion many believed inevitable.
current_cn: 日本沿海的外国炮火轰鸣，要求采取行动。在你的管辖范围内，新的民兵和海岸炮台正在匆忙中组建。你全身心投入到训练人员、运送物资以及为许多人认为不可避免的入侵做准备的工作中。

canonical_source: I was born the son of a village headman, but I studied in a domain school where the teachers spoke of loyalty to the Throne and the corruption of Edo.
current_cn: 我出生于一个村长的儿子，但我在一所藩校学习，那里的老师谈论对王位的忠诚和江户的腐败。

canonical_source: All right then. I'll try that.
current_cn: 那就好吧。我会尝试一下。

canonical_source: Consequences? You would shed the blood of {RULER.NAME}'s loyal servants just for raising their voices against a wicked cause?[if:convo_confused_normal][ib:closed]
current_cn: 结果？你会仅仅因为{RULER.NAME}的忠诚仆人大声反对邪恶的事业而让他们流血吗？[if:convo_confused_normal][ib:closed]

canonical_source: No, I don't want to shed your blood.

Sedition? You have been misinformed. My men and I are loyal servants of {RULER_NAME_AND_TITLE}.
