We are simply going about informing the people that our {RULER_TITLE} is surrounded by bad advisers who are advocating for the treasonous {ALIGNMENT} cause. We petition {RULER.NAME} to listen to us and join the righteous movement.[if:convo_normal][ib:hip]
current_cn: 煽动叛乱？你被误导了。我和我的手下都是 {RULER_NAME_AND_TITLE} 的忠实仆人。我们只是要告诉人们，我们的 {RULER_TITLE} 周围都是坏顾问，他们鼓吹叛国的 {ALIGNMENT} 事业。我们请求{RULER.NAME}听我们的意见并加入正义运动。[if:convo_normal][ib:hip]

canonical_source: You were sent to work as a young servant at the estate of a rich landowner from the city. Gradually progressing from menial tasks to more complex ones, you eventually became a sort of administrator of the estate, managing its stocks and liaising with the guests of your master. Once your service with the wealthy landlord was over, you were a young adult able to administer a fortune and deal with the city's high society.
current_cn: 你被派到城里一个富有的地主的庄园里当年轻仆人。逐渐从琐碎的任务发展到更复杂的任务，你最终成为庄园的管理员，管理其库存并与主人的客人联络。一旦你为富有的房东服务结束，你就成为了一个能够管理财富并与城市上流社会打交道的年轻人。

canonical_source: Tōsan, the mountainous heart of central Japan, is highly conservative. Made up almost entirely of Tenryō land and a handful of Fudai daimyo, Tōsan has no great lords of their own, leading to their growing irrelavance in this period, as the powerful daimyo in the fringes of Japan increasingly dominate politics. Even so, Tōsan is vital to the Shogunate's continued dominance, providing a great deal of their manpower and influence.
current_cn: 东山是日本中部的山区中心，非常保守。东山几乎完全由天领藩和少数普代大名组成，没有自己的大领主，导致他们在这一时期变得越来越不重要，因为日本边缘的强大大名越来越主宰政治。即便如此，东山对于幕府的持续统治至关重要，为幕府提供了大量的人力和影响力。

canonical_source: Your mokuroku is has been amended to reflect your newly learned techniques. See that your conduct proves you worthy of what has been added.
current_cn: 您的目録已被修改以反映您新学到的技术。确保你的行为证明你配得上所添加的东西。

canonical_source: I'll find them and put a stop to what they're doing.
current_cn: 我会找到他们并制止他们的所作所为。

canonical_source: The castle town of Hinoe sits on the west coast of Kyushu on the Shimabara Peninsula. Built in the early Kamakura period, Hinoe has since served as the home base and major source of profits for the Arima clan, who from here controlled maritime trade routes and more recently the Nanban foreign trade.
current_cn: 日野江城下町位于九州西海岸的岛原半岛。日野江建于镰仓时代早期，自此成为有马氏族的大本营和主要利润来源，有马氏族从这里控制海上贸易路线，以及最近的南蛮对外贸易。

canonical_source: If you start a rebellion, you're just going to get a lot of samurai around here killed...
current_cn: 如果你发动叛乱，你只会让这里的很多武士被杀……

canonical_source: We're not holding anyone in here right now. There's no reason for you to go in.[ib:closed]
current_cn: 我们现在没有关押任何人。你没有理由进去.[ib:closed]

canonical_source: Sorry, but we don't know you. We can't just let anyone in. (Not enough renown)
current_cn: 抱歉，我们不认识你。我们不能随便让任何人进来。（知名度不够）

canonical_source: A castle town nestled deep in the mountains of South-western Kyushu, Hitoyoshi has served as the seat of the Sagara clan since the Kamakura period. It is said that during the construction work a moon-shaped stone was unearthed, thus giving rise to the alternative folk name of moon castle. Popular tales aside, Hitoyoshi stands as an imposing fortification that has only once been attacked by an enemy and with a fatal outcome.
current_cn: 人吉是一座坐落在九州西南部山区深处的城下町，自镰仓时代以来一直是相良氏的所在地。据说，在修建过程中，挖出了一块月亮形状的石头，因而有了“月亮堡”的俗名。撇开流行的故事不谈，人吉是一座雄伟的防御工事，只被敌人袭击过一次，并造成了致命的后果。

canonical_source: Your father was a kabuki actor whose dramatic performances drew large crowds in the pleasure districts of the great cities. Though adored by common townsfolk and celebrated for his striking stage presence, he was nevertheless dragged down by his status among the Eta-Hinin, the lowest social class in Japan. Fame and applause brought your family notoriety and a modest living, but admiration rarely translated into respect.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位歌舞伎演员，他的戏剧表演在大城市的游乐区吸引了大批观众。尽管他受到普通市民的崇拜，并因其引人注目的舞台表现而闻名，但他仍然因其在日本社会最低阶层的地位而受到拖累。名气和掌声给你的家庭带来了恶名和简朴的生活，但钦佩很少转化为尊重。

canonical_source: As a youth you assisted clerks and brokers at the bustling rice exchange, carrying ledgers and observing tense negotiations. There you learned both the honest mathematics of trade and the quieter tricks used by seasoned dealers.
current_cn: 年轻时，您在熙熙攘攘的大米交易中协助职员和经纪人，搬运账本并观察紧张的谈判。在那里，你既学到了诚实的贸易数学，也学到了经验丰富的经销商所使用的更安静的技巧。

canonical_source: I have learned much by observing your dojo. I will take my leave now.
current_cn: 通过观察你们的道场，我学到了很多东西。我现在就告辞了。

canonical_source: Don't worry, I'll escort the foreigner myself.
current_cn: 你放心，我会亲自护送外国人的。

canonical_source: You could change this law, my {?PLAYER.GENDER}lady{?}lord{\\?}. All of us would be grateful. and we're willing to donate {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} to show our thanks...
current_cn: 你可以改变这条法律，我的{?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}。我们所有人都会感激不尽。我们愿意捐赠 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 以表示感谢......

canonical_source: Your discipline in sparring with {OPPONENT_COUNT} peers is evident. Each encounter should be regarded as a lesson. Take these observations to heart and let them guide your continued training.
current_cn: 你与 {OPPONENT_COUNT} 名同门对练时展现出的自律有目共睹。每一次交手都应视为一次学习。牢记这些经验，让它们指引你继续修行。

canonical_source: You have bested my student, {PLAYER.LINK}. Take your victory, but know that this dojo will not yield so easily next time.
current_cn: 你打败了我的学生{PLAYER.LINK}。取得你的胜利，但要知道，这个道场下次不会那么轻易屈服。

canonical_source: Positioned near the confluence of several key trade routes in the Chūgoku region, the castle town of Sanbonmatsu has become a target for expanding warlords. While its military importance seems negligible, its location along vital supply routes makes it a key target for forces looking to consolidate control over the region.
current_cn: 三本松城下町位于中国地区几条主要贸易路线的交汇处，已成为军阀扩张的目标。虽然其军事重要性似乎可以忽略不计，但其位于重要供应路线上的位置使其成为寻求巩固对该地区控制的部队的关键目标。

canonical_source: You are looking among the various dojos of {CURRENT_SETTLEMENT}
current_cn: 你正在 {CURRENT_SETTLEMENT} 的各个道场中寻找

canonical_source: You have collected enough smoothbores that the retainer requested. Return to their party and deliver the firearms
current_cn: 您已收集了保持器所要求的足够的滑膛。返回他们的队伍并交付枪支

canonical_source: You have achieved the rank of Menkyo-Kaiden
current_cn: 您已达到免许皆传的等级

canonical_source: You have achieved the rank of Menkyo

In 1866, something thought unthinkable occurred: the Shogunate lost a war against Choshu. The Second Choshu Expedition had been intended to remind Japan of the Bakufu's strength, and to deal with the rebellious domain once and for all. Instead, the 150,000 strong army of the Shogunate was routed by the 4000 men of Choshu and their modern rifles, losing thousands of men and inflicting only a few hundred casualties in return. With this failure, and the ascension of Tokugawa Yoshinobu as Shogun, Japan entered a furor of reform. Yoshinobu himself worked to reform the Bakufu army, establishing the Hoheitai, Yugekitai, and Denshutai, while many other domains were incentivized to adopt proper modernized infantry.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are mostly unlocked with the Standard Uniforms policy instead.
current_cn: 1866年，幕府遭遇了此前难以想象的失败：第二次长州征讨本意在于重申幕府权威并彻底压服长州，结果十五万幕府军却被约四千名装备近代步枪的长州军击溃，幕府损失数千人，而对方伤亡仅数百。战败之后，德川庆喜又继任将军，日本由此进入军制改革的高潮。庆喜着手整顿幕府军，编成步兵队、游击队与传习队；其他各藩也受到刺激，开始建立真正意义上的近代步兵。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种主要由“统一军服”政策解锁。

canonical_source: Enables the caste system, must be enabled from the start of the campaign.
current_cn: 启用阶级制度，必须从战役开始时启用。

canonical_source: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} wants you to stop the {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME}'s movement before it turns into a strong resistance.
current_cn: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} 希望您在 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 的运动变成强大阻力之前阻止它。

canonical_source: Splendid. I will never forget your service, my friend.
current_cn: 灿烂。我永远不会忘记你的服务，我的朋友。

canonical_source: What? Does no one respect their lords anymore?
current_cn: 什么？没有人再尊重他们的主人了吗？

canonical_source: My father traded through Nagasaki, where I first saw Dutch books, foreign instruments, and machines unlike anything made in Japan. While other boys practiced the sword, I struggled through foreign texts, determined to understand the secrets they contained.
current_cn: 我父亲在长崎做生意，在那里我第一次看到荷兰书籍、外国乐器和不同于日本制造的机器。当其他男孩练习剑时，我努力阅读外国文本，决心了解其中所包含的秘密。

canonical_source: Emperor Komei had opposed the entirety of the outside world, advocating fiercely for Sonno-joi. However, his son was not so inflexible. Following Komei's death of smallpox in early 1867, the teenaged emperor and his advisors began a series of reforms of their own, establishing the new Imperial guard, while other pro-Imperial forces, such as the Jinshotai of Tosa, began coalescing into a modern army of their own. At the same time, Choshu began reforming their remaining Shotai militias into proper units of their own, in preparation for the turmoil everone knew was coming.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are unlocked with the Standard Uniforms or Officer Academies policies instead.
current_cn: 孝明天皇强烈排斥外国势力，并支持尊王攘夷。然而，他的继承者并没有如此固执。1867年初孝明天皇因天花去世后，年少的新天皇及其近臣也开始推行改革，组建新的朝廷近卫部队；与此同时，土佐迅冲队等尊王派武装逐渐汇合为一支近代军队。长州也开始把残余的诸队民兵改编为正规部队，为所有人都已预感到的动乱做准备。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种由“统一军服”或“军官学校”政策解锁。

canonical_source: You have failed to deliver the weapons in time.
current_cn: 你们未能及时交付武器。

canonical_source: Even as Japan reformed around them, many of the northernmost domains, as well as a few in Kansai, remained stagnant. The foolishness of this policy became apparent when the Boshin War broke out in early 1868, as the samurai of these domains suffered catastrophic defeats at the hands of peasants armed with modern rifles. These domains, most notable including Kubota on the Imperial side and Sendai on the Shogunate side, began to rapidly reorganize in an attempt to stave off defeat from those invading their domains.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are unlocked with the Standard Uniforms or Western Drill policies instead.
current_cn: 当日本各地陆续改革时，北方许多藩以及关西少数藩仍停滞不前。1868年初戊辰战争爆发后，这种选择的代价迅速显现：旧式武士部队在装备近代步枪的农兵面前遭到惨败。以官军一方的久保田藩和幕府一方的仙台藩为代表，这些藩不得不仓促重组军队，以求抵御进入本藩领地的敌军。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种由“统一军服”或“西式操练”政策解锁。

canonical_source: Lay out the patterns and specifications of the uniforms you supply.
current_cn: 列出您提供的制服的图案和规格。

canonical_source: You need to move along. I'm on duty right now and I can't spare any coin. May Heaven provide.
current_cn: 你需要继续前进。我现在正在值班，一分钱都没有。愿天堂提供。

canonical_source: Well, I can't just sit around and drink myself to death, so I sell my sword to anyone worth following. I'm a good scout, anything you want me to find I will.
current_cn: 好吧，我不能只是坐在那里喝酒致死，所以我把我的剑卖给任何值得追随的人。我是一名优秀的侦察员，任何你想让我找到的东西我都会做。

canonical_source: Perched atop a steep mountain, the castle town of Kasugayama was originally a possession of the Nagao clan, but has served as the seat of the powerful Uesugi clan since Uesugi Kenshin, born a Nagao,  took over. Kenshin turned Kasugayama into a center of military power in Echigo from which he departed several times at the head of his armies to challenge the Takeda clan.
current_cn: 春日山城下町坐落在陡峭的山顶上，原本是长尾氏的藩，但自长尾出身的上杉谦信接管以来，一直是强大的上杉氏的所在地。谦信将春日山变成了越后的军事中心，他多次率领军队出征挑战武田氏。

canonical_source: Yamagata has been the seat of the Mogami since before they adopted this name, its location marked by the many mountains and rivers that shield it and at the same time make it an important connection centre for the surrounding regions.
current_cn: 山形在最上氏族采用这个名字之前就一直是他们的所在地，它的位置被许多山脉和河流所保护，同时也使其成为与周边地区的重要联系中心。

canonical_source: {VALUE}% build speed for fortifications, aqueducts and barrack projects in the governed settlement.
current_cn: 受管辖定居点中防御工事、渡槽和营房项目的 {VALUE}% 建造速度。

canonical_source: Well, I have indeed been misinformed. You may go on your way...
current_cn: 嗯，确实是我被误导了。你可以继续你的路了...

canonical_source: Greetings. These goods are secured by His Majesty, King Wilhelm I of Prussia and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we help you?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。这些货物由普鲁士国王威廉一世陛下担保，并由 {MERCHANT.LINK} 或 {SETTLEMENT} 担保。我们能为您提供什么帮助？[if:convo_normal]

canonical_source: At the start of 1865, the Shogunate began a dedicated push to modernize their military. Beforehand, they had created the Sampeitai, or 'Three-Arms Corps', but that had been an unmitigated disaster. Prompted by the Kinmon Incident and Choshu's own civil war, the Shogunate's new reforms, forming units based on Samurai social rankings, ended in failure just as their previous ones had, but it started off the era of massive military reforms in Japan, which had been before isolated to a few small domains. These reforms unlock the Hoheitai and most of their equivalents, alongside units of unique organizations like the Mimawari-gumi and Shinsengumi.{newline}{newline}If using policy based reforms, these troops are unlocked with the Western Drill policy instead.
current_cn: 1865年初，幕府开始有计划地推进军制近代化。此前设立的“三兵队”并未取得成功。禁门之变与长州内部的武装冲突进一步暴露了旧军制的问题；幕府随后尝试依武士身分等级重新编组部队，结果仍不理想，却由此开启了此后席卷日本的大规模军事改革。此前，这类改革主要只见于少数藩。此阶段将解锁步兵队及其多数同类兵种，也包括见回组、新选组等特殊组织的部队。{newline}{newline}若启用政策制改革，则这些兵种改由“西式操练”政策解锁。

canonical_source: Growing up as a poor samurai, you had very little to do. You spent most of your time...
current_cn: 作为一个贫穷的武士，你几乎无事可做。你花了大部分时间...

canonical_source: Sorry. I don't have anything for you this time.
current_cn: 对不起。这次我没有什么可以给你的。

canonical_source: As a kid you went almost every day to train with a ronin who stayed in your village for a few years and who seemed to like you enough to teach you how to fight for free. When your mentor finally left the village by the time you had become a young adult, you were a discreet and robust fighter.
current_cn: 当你还是个孩子的时候，你几乎每天都会和一个浪人一起训练，他在你的村庄呆了几年，而且似乎很喜欢你，愿意免费教你如何战斗。当你的导师最终在你成年时离开村庄时，你是一个谨慎而坚强的战士。

canonical_source: Kaga Domain stretches across Hokuriku, a land of fertile plains, bustling towns, and the glittering rivers that feed into the Sea of Japan. The Maeda clan has ruled for generations, amassing wealth that rivals even the shogunate in scale, and even their lesser retainers are as wealthy as Daimyo. However, Kaga is also deeply unwilling to reform, for fear of being targetted by the Shogunate.
current_cn: 加贺藩横跨北陆，这里有肥沃的平原、繁华的城镇和注入日本海的波光粼粼的河流。前田氏世代统治，积累的财富规模甚至可以与幕府相媲美，就连他们的小家臣也和大名一样富有。然而，加贺也极不愿意改革，害怕成为幕府的目标。

canonical_source: Nagaoka is far more modernized than most Shogunate domains, reforming under the leadership of Kawai Tsugunosuke. Nagaoka is the rare exception to the northern refusal to modernize, being one of the few domains in Hokuriku and Tohoku to fully modernize, at one point owning 2/3 of the Gatling Guns in Japan.
current_cn: 长冈比大多数幕府藩现代化得多，在河井继之助的领导下进行改革。长冈是北方拒绝现代化的罕见例外，是北陆和东北为数不多的完全现代化的藩之一，一度拥有日本 2/3 的加特林机枪。

canonical_source: Obama Domain hugs the northern coast of Wakasa Bay, where the town's harbor has long connected the mountains to the sea. The Sakai clan rules here with a careful hand, balancing the needs of merchants, fishermen, and samurai. The domain is known for its skilled boatmen and fortified castle that watches over both river traffic and coastal approaches.
current_cn: 小滨藩紧邻若狭湾的北海岸，该镇的港口长期以来一直将山脉与大海连接起来。酒井氏族小心翼翼地统治着这里，平衡着商人、渔民和武士的需求。该藩以其熟练的船夫和监视河流交通和沿海通道的坚固城堡而闻名。

canonical_source: The location of the main branch of the Yuki Matsudaira, Fukui-han is a wealthy modernized domain. In the 1850s, they instituted one of the first vaccination programs in Japan, and they've modernized their military, phasing out their archery corps in favor of riflemen. Their lord had an eye for talent, with statesmen like Yokoi Shōnan, Hashimoto Sanai and Yuri Kimimasa rising out of Fukui.
current_cn: 福井藩是松平由纪总支所在地，是一个富裕的现代化藩。 1850 年代，他们制定了日本最早的疫苗接种计划之一，并实现了军队现代化，逐步淘汰了射箭部队，转而采用步枪兵。他们的主公对人才很挑剔，横井湘南、桥本三井和由里公政等政治家都从福井崛起。

canonical_source: You have conducted yourself with diligence in today's sparring, {PLAYER.LINK}. While errors were present, your attentiveness to form is commendable. Continue to refine your technique.
current_cn: 今天的对练中，你表现得很勤奋，{PLAYER.LINK}。虽然还有一些失误，但你对招式的注意值得称赞。继续磨炼你的技艺。

canonical_source: I will issue a decree to remove the restrictions on the sale of firearms.
current_cn: 我将颁布法令取消枪支销售限制。

canonical_source: The court noble caste, Kuge, or 'Ducal House', were in name the highest ranking caste and the rulers of Japan, from the capital of Kyoto. Mostly descended from the Imperial Family, the Kuge theoretically drafted laws and advised the Emperor. However, ever since the Heian era and later the short lived Kenmu Restoration prior to the Muromachi Era, the court nobles have been irrelevant in Japan. While they had a great deal of sway, and their words could be influential, they had no actual political power, and most court nobles instead made their living as tutors for the sons of wealthy merchants and high ranking samurai. Many would teach sons of the daimyo themselves. However, in the Bakumatsu they did regain some power as the emperor asserted himself, before being folded into the new nobility as the caste system was abolished.{newline}{newline}Pros:{newline}Right to command a personal retinue (+50% party size from clan tier and Steward){newline}Highly Influential (Earns an extra 2 influence daily){newline}{newline}Resistrictions: None
current_cn: 宫廷贵族种姓“Kuge”或“公爵府”名义上是最高等级的种姓，也是日本的统治者，来自首都京都。库格大多是皇室后裔，理论上起草法律并为皇帝提供建议。然而，从平安时代到室町时代之前的短暂的宪武维新，宫廷贵族在日本已经无关紧要了。虽然他们有很大的影响力，他们的言论也可能有影响力，但他们没有实际的政治权力，大多数宫廷贵族反而以给富商和高级武士的儿子当家庭教师为生。许多人会亲自教导大名的儿子。然而，在幕末，他们确实随着皇帝的主张而重新获得了一些权力，然后随着种姓制度的废除而被并入新的贵族。{newline}{newline}优点：{newline}指挥个人随从的权利（氏族级别和管家的政党规模+50％）{newline}高度影响力（每天额外获得2点影响力）{newline}{newline}限制：无

canonical_source: Thanks to your high social rank, you were able to train in Bajutsu, learning the sword and bow. While your position was more symbolic than anything, you still learned well.
current_cn: 由于你的社会地位很高，你能够接受巴术训练，学习剑和弓。虽然你的立场比任何事情都更具象征意义，但你仍然学到了很多东西。

canonical_source: You have successfully delivered the weapons as requested.
current_cn: 您已按照要求成功交付了武器。

canonical_source: you studied the knowledge of the West.
Merchants can't sell foreign firearms in {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT}
current_cn: {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} 商人不能出售外国枪械

canonical_source: The true rulers of Japan, the Daimyo were the mighty feudal lords of Japan. In the Edo period some 250 Daimyo houses existed, divvying up Japan among themselves. The poorest daimyo controlled at least 10,000 kokudaka of land, meaning that it produced roughly the equivalent of 1,500,000 kg of rice per year in goods, while the wealthiest was worth well over 1 million koku. The Daimyo themselves were subject solely to the Shogun, who could in theory revoke their land and titles at will, though the actual reality was somewhat different when it came to the largest daimyo. In practice, they were independent rulers, so long as they paid lip service to the Shogun and kept the peace. The player will automatically become a daimyo upon taking over or creating a kingdom.{newline}{newline}Pros:{newline}Leader of a kingdom{newline}Right to command a personal retinue (+50% party size from clan tier and Steward){newline}Highly Influential (Earns an extra 2 influence daily){newline}{newline}Resistrictions: None
current_cn: 日本真正的统治者大名是日本强大的封建领主。在江户时代，大约有 250 个大名房屋，将日本瓜分在一起。最贫穷的大名控制着至少 10,000 石的土地，这意味着它每年生产大约相当于 1,500,000 公斤大米的货物，而最富有的大名的价值远超过 100 万石。大名本身仅受将军管辖，理论上将军可以随意撤销他们的土地和头衔，但对于最大的大名来说，实际情况有些不同。实际上，只要他们口头上效忠幕府将军并维持和平，他们就是独立的统治者。玩家在接管或创建王国后将自动成为大名。{newline}{newline}优点：{newline}王国领袖{newline}指挥个人随从的权利（氏族等级和管家的队伍规模+50%）{newline}高度影响力（每天额外获得2点影响力）{newline}{newline}限制：无

canonical_source: Okou is a castle town located in a a key strategic location in the southern part of Shikoku, that has been serving as the ancestral seat of the Chōsokabe clan since the Kamakura period. Okou recently played a crucial role in the consolidation of power by Chōsokabe Motochika.
current_cn: 大高城是位于四国南部战略要地的城下町，自镰仓时代以来一直是长宗我部氏的祖地。大高城在长宗我部元亲巩固势力的过程中发挥了重要作用。
这是一个公正的决定，我的 {?PLAYER.GENDER}女士{?}领主{\\?}。

canonical_source: (One of the artisans in the town comes to talk as you are preparing to depart.)
current_cn: （当你准备离开时，镇上的一位工匠过来说话。）
收集的 米涅步枪 金额（可选）

canonical_source: Chance to recruit various Shotai units from towns and villages
current_cn: 有机会从城镇和村庄招募各种诸队部队

canonical_source: You have lost the track of the merchant. Your agreement with {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} is failed.
current_cn: 你已经失去了商人的踪迹。您与 {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} 的协议失败。

canonical_source: You're doing a good thing, {?PLAYER.GENDER}madame{?}sir{\\?}. Our great cause will remember your kindness
current_cn: 你做得很好，{?PLAYER.GENDER}夫人{?}先生{\\?}。我们伟大的事业会铭记您的恩情

canonical_source: Greetings. This caravan travels under the authority of the President of the Third French Republic and is guaranteed by {MERCHANT.LINK} of {SETTLEMENT}. How may we be of service?[if:convo_normal]
current_cn: 问候。该车队在法兰西第三共和国总统的授权下行驶，并由 {SETTLEMENT} 的 {MERCHANT.LINK} 担保。我们可以提供什么服务？[if:convo_normal]

canonical_source: Originally developed from a small fishing village as a fortified residence for a local noble of the Heian Period, Edo was later fortified to become the castle town that currently towers over the Musashino Plateau and Edo Bay. The recent turmoil in Kantō has seen Edo shift between the different warring Clans and has severely hampered its development, but the city still retains its enormous potential.
current_cn: 江户最初是由一个小渔村发展而来，作为平安时代当地贵族的防御住所，后来经过强化，成为如今高耸于武藏野高原和江户湾的城下町。最近关东的动乱导致江户在不同的交战氏族之间转移，严重阻碍了它的发展，但这座城市仍然保留着巨大的潜力。

canonical_source: You have defeated {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} and helped {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} as promised. You received {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} in return for your service.
current_cn: 你已经按照承诺击败了 {MALE_LESSER_NOBLE_NAME} 并帮助了 {QUEST_GIVER.LINK}。您收到 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 作为您服务的回报。

canonical_source: You have heard of the Zokuron-ha, no doubt. Men who no longer serve our lord, but instead interpret his will until it no longer resembles his own. It is a quieter coup than steel in the night, but no less real.{newline}{newline}Chōshū cannot afford to be governed by shadows wearing official seals. So I have begun what some will call an uprising, but is in truth an attempt to save our lord.{newline}{newline}I am not here to beg you, {PLAYER.NAME}. I am here because {?PLAYER.GENDER}women{?}men{\\?} like you do not stand safely on the fence forever. You either act while there is still something worth acting for... or you watch it rot past saving.[if:grave][ib:warrior]
current_cn: 毫无疑问，你听说过 Zokuron-ha。这些人不再侍奉我们的主，而是解释他的意志，直到它不再像他自己的意志。这是比夜里的钢铁更安静的政变，但同样真实。{newline}{newline}长州不能被戴着官方印章的阴影所统治。所以我开始了一些人所说的起义，但实际上是为了拯救我们的领主。{newline}{newline}我不是来这里求你的，{PLAYER.NAME}。我来这里是因为 {?PLAYER.GENDER}women{?}men{\\?} 像你一样不会永远安全地站在栅栏上。你要么在仍有值得为之行动的事情时行动……要么眼睁睁地看着它腐烂而无法挽救。[if:grave][ib:warrior]

canonical_source: I have not betrayed my lord. I merely refused to flatter fools.
current_cn: 我没有背叛我的主。我只是拒绝奉承傻瓜。

canonical_source: No city in Japan is greater than Edo, the seat of the Shogunate. From here reign the Tokugawa shoguns, and it is here that over one million people live in the peace that is the Edo period. The center of Japan in many ways, Edo is the center of culture, administration, the economy, and the military. The influence it had upon Japan in this period cannot be overstated, and it is here that the deals and alliances that led to the fall of the Bakufu were formed.
current_cn: 日本没有哪个城市比幕府所在地江户更伟大。德川幕府从这里统治，这里有超过一百万人生活在江户时代的和平之中。江户在很多方面都是日本的中心，是文化、行政、经济和军事的中心。它在这一时期对日本的影响不容小觑，导致幕府垮台的交易和联盟就是在这里形成的。

canonical_source: A fairly new and small domain, Jozai is highly loyal to the Shogunate. They would fight throughout the entire war, only surrendering upon hearing that the Shogun would keep a fief after the war. Jozai was one of only two domains to be stripped of their holdings during the Boshin war.
current_cn: 城宰是一个相当新的小藩，对幕府高度忠诚。他们将在整个战争中战斗，只有在听说幕府将在战后保留封地时才投降。定西是戊辰战争期间仅有的两个被剥夺财产的藩之一。

canonical_source: Despite being ruled by one of the Gosanke of the Tokugawa, Mito Domain is a hotbed of Sonno-joi and anti-Shogunate sentiment in the Bakumatsu. Throughout this period, agitators from Mito constantly undermine the Shogunate and push other domains to adopt the ideology. While not as influential as Satsuma and Choshu would come to be, it cannot be denied that Mito was one of the cores of the Sonno-joi.
current_cn: 尽管水户藩由德川家族的一位后御三家统治，但它却是幕末园子里和反幕府情绪的温床。在此期间，水户的煽动者不断破坏幕府并推动其他藩采用这种意识形态。尽管水户的影响力不如萨摩和长州，但不可否认的是，水户是尊王攘夷的核心之一。

canonical_source: Owari is ruled by the seniormost of the Gosanke of the Tokugawa. Owari-han is a powerful and wealthy domain, behind only the Kaga, Satsuma, and Sendai domains, and the most powerful of the Tokugawa houses besides the Shogunate itself. Despite their family ties, however, Owari would go on to support the Imperial forces during the Boshin War.
current_cn: 尾张由德川五御三家的最高统治者统治。尾张藩是一个强大而富有的藩，仅次于加贺藩、萨摩藩、仙台藩，是除了幕府本身之外德川家族中最强大的。然而，尽管他们有家族联系，尾张还是在戊辰战争期间继续支持帝国军队。

canonical_source: The Tokugawa may be the Shoguns, but they are also daimyo. At its core, the Bakufu is simply a domain so powerful that all others must bow to it. This power is maintained via Tenryo, land directly under the control of the Tokugawa. Containing some of the wealthiest cities and areas of Japan, most of Tokai, Tosan, and Kanto was Tenryo, as was significant chunks of Kyushu, Chugoku, and Kansai.
current_cn: 德川可能是幕府将军，但他们也是大名。从本质上讲，幕府只是一个如此强大的藩，以至于所有其他人都必须向它屈服。这种权力是通过德川直接控制的土地天领维持的。天领涵盖了日本一些最富裕的城市和地区，东海、东山和关东的大部分地区以及九州、中国和关西的大部分地区都是天领。

canonical_source: The people of Kanto, the spiritual homeland of the samurai class, live in a predominantly flat region that is perfect for extensive agriculture and the breeding of its renowned battle steeds, which yield abundant harvests and allow Kanto to field and maintain cavalry forces more easily. Imbued with the secular martial tradition in which they have their roots, the lords of Kanto can more easily raise large armies to face their enemies, but their great emphasis on military preparedness makes it more expensive to pay the wages of their soldiers.{newline}{newline}Foreign Merchant: Dutch
current_cn: 关东是武士阶级的精神家园，这里的人民生活在一个以平坦为主的地区，这里非常适合粗放农业和饲养著名的战马，这些战马可以带来丰沛的收成，使关东更容易部署和维持骑兵部队。关东领主深受世俗军事传统的影响，可以更轻松地召集大军对抗敌人，但他们对军事准备的高度重视导致支付士兵的工资更加昂贵。{newline}{newline}外国商人：荷兰人

canonical_source: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} a merchant from {QUEST_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} has complained to you about not being able to sell their stock of foreign guns because of the unfair local laws. {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} will pay {REWARD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} for you to take the guns to another town. You agreed to take {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} guns to {TARGET_HERO.LINK} in {TARGET_SETTLEMENT}.
current_cn: {QUEST_GIVER.LINK} 一位来自 {QUEST_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} 的商人向您抱怨，由于当地法律不公平，他们无法出售他们库存的外国枪支。 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 将支付 {REWARD_AMOUNT}{GOLD_ICON} 让你把枪带到另一个城镇。您同意将 {?QUEST_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?} 枪带到 {TARGET_SETTLEMENT} 的 {TARGET_HERO.LINK}。

canonical_source: Your father was a humble but skilled swordsmith who through his physical strength and mastery of his art was able to transform raw metal into sharp blades, making him well known in his domain for the quality of his creations. Even as a child, by helping him in the forge, you were able to absorb some of his craftmanship and harden your body.
current_cn: 你的父亲是一位谦虚但技艺高超的剑匠，凭借他的体力和精湛的技艺，他能够将原始金属转化为锋利的刀片，使他在他的藩中因其创作的质量而闻名。即使在小时候，通过帮助他锻造，你也能够吸收他的一些手艺并锻炼你的身体。

canonical_source: Good. I did not misjudge you, {PLAYER.NAME}. Chōshū will need men who act, not hesitate.
current_cn: 好的。我没有误判你，{PLAYER.NAME}。长州需要毫不犹豫地行动的人。

canonical_source: “The one who controls Gifu controls Japan” is a common saying that emphasises the strategic location of this castle town. Once a possession of the Saitō clan and recently seized by Oda Nobunaga, who chose to rename it after the legendary mountain where most of ancient china was unified and the birthplace of Confucious, signalling to everyone his intention to unify the whole of Japan.
current_cn: “谁控制了岐阜，谁就控制了日本”是一句俗话，强调了这座城下町的战略位置。曾经是斋藤氏族的藩，最近被织田信长占领，并选择以统一古代中国大部分地区的传奇山和孔子的诞生地来重新命名它，向所有人表明他想要统一整个日本的意图。

canonical_source: The Genji loyalists have been crushed, and the Shogunate’s authority stands unshaken. The reformist leaders have been executed or driven into hiding, while the conservative factions reassert their dominance in Choshu. Any hope of Choshu once again opposing the Shogunate is gone.
current_cn: 源氏的忠诚者已被镇压，幕府的权威丝毫没有动摇。改革派领导人要么被处决，要么被迫躲藏起来，而保守派则重新确立了他们在长州的统治地位。长州再次反抗幕府的希望已经破灭。

canonical_source: Ezo (modern Hokkaidō), home to the Ainu, remained a remote frontier. In the late Bakumatsu, the Matsumae Domain managed small garrisons and fortified trading posts to assert shogunate influence, while Ainu communities maintained autonomous governance. The region was a delicate frontier where indigenous autonomy, limited shogunate oversight, and foreign concerns, particularly Russian encroachment, intersected.
current_cn: 北陆位于本州北部海岸，是日本最繁荣的地区之一。北陆是日本一些最富有的藩的所在地，尤其是加贺前田，它是全日本最富有的藩，北陆出产大量用于喂养本州中部的大米。北陆几乎完全忠于幕府，大多数藩要么在未来的戊辰战争中保持忠诚，要么拒绝站在一边。然而，他们不愿改革，使得北陆地区处于次要地位，与西南和北部较贫穷但更火热的地区相比，其重要性较低。

canonical_source: You may have a point, but don't think that we will give up demanding our rights. We will return home, but we will pursue our grievances some other way.
current_cn: 你也许有道理，但不要认为我们会放弃要求我们的权利。我们会回家，但我们会以其他方式表达我们的不满。

canonical_source: This scroll nows grants you a menkyo. The school permits you to teach what you have learned, and this scroll bears that authority. Even so, there remain teachings not lightly entrusted.
current_cn: 这个卷轴现在给你一个免许。流派允许你教授你所学到的东西，而这卷轴就拥有这种权威。即便如此，仍有一些教义不被轻易信任。

canonical_source: The Shōgitai are a corps of elite retainers who rose to defend the Shogunate in its final days. Trained in both traditional and modern warfare, they embody the spirit of the old samurai while adapting to the new age. Their resolve in battle is legendary.
current_cn: 将军队是一支由精锐扈从组成的军团，他们在幕府末日奋起保卫幕府。他们接受过传统战争和现代战争的训练，在适应新时代的同时体现了旧武士的精神。他们在战斗中的决心是传奇的。

canonical_source: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} a merchant from {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} has complained to you about not being able to sell foreign made firearms in the town. {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}She{?}He{\\?} will pay {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} for you to take the guns to another town. You have tasked {COMPANION.LINK} and {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_TROOP_COUNT} men to smuggle {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}her{?}his{\\?} goods to a “friend” in {TARGET_TOWN}. They will return to you in {RETURN_DAYS} days with a sizable sum of {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}.
current_cn: {ISSUE_GIVER.LINK} 来自 {ISSUE_GIVER_SETTLEMENT} 的商人向您抱怨无法在镇上销售外国制造的枪支。 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她{?}他{\\?} 将支付 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON} 让你把枪带到另一个城镇。您已指派 {COMPANION.LINK} 和 {ALTERNATIVE_SOLUTION_TROOP_COUNT} 人员将 {?ISSUE_GIVER.GENDER}她的{?}他的{\\?} 货物走私给 {TARGET_TOWN} 的“朋友”。他们将在 {RETURN_DAYS} 天后返回给您，并携带相当大的金额 {REWARD}{GOLD_ICON}。

canonical_source: You spent your adolescence days training your sword skills together with other kids. Whether it was with real blades or improvised ones, in actual practice or imaginary duels, you improved your slashes and parries with no need to roll around.
current_cn: 你在青春期与其他孩子一起练习剑术。无论是使用真正的刀片还是临时的刀片，在实际练习或想象的决斗中，你都可以提高你的砍击和招架，而无需翻滚。

canonical_source: Living on the outskirts of his village, your father was a skilled hunter, well-versed in tracking and chasing his prey through the woods and mountains. and taking it down with a swift stroke of his bow. Even if the rewards of his labour were barely enough for a humble life in the countryside, your father passed on much of his knowledge to you.
current_cn: 你的父亲住在村庄的郊区，是一位熟练的猎人，擅长在树林和山脉中追踪和追逐猎物。并用他的弓迅速一击将其击倒。即使他的劳动报酬仅够在乡村过着卑微的生活，你的父亲还是把他的大部分知识传授给了你。

canonical_source: I seek a match, under the customs of the dojo.
current_cn: 我按照道场的惯例寻求一场比试。
允许切换野战火炮弹药
